title: Software Engineering, Staff
description:
**Overview**
Medallia is the pioneer and market leader in Experience Management. Our award-winning SaaS platform, Medallia Experience Cloud, leads the market in the management of experiences, insights, and actions for candidates, customers, employees, patients, and residents alike.
  
  
We believe that every experience is a memory that can last a lifetime. Experiences shape the way people feel about a company. And they greatly influence how likely people are to advocate, contribute, and stay. At Medallia, we are committed to creating a world where organizations are loved by their customers and their employees.
  
  
We empower exceptional people to create extraordinary experiences together.
  
  
Bring your whole self.
  
  
The Role and Team
  
  
At Medallia, our Platform team builds and operates the critical backend services that power how surveys are executed, distributed, processed, and collected across our platform.
  
  
Our systems sit at the core that support large-scale, highly available workloads across many enterprise customers. The team owns services and capabilities related to survey execution, distribution, response processing, webhooks, messaging integrations, and the streaming pipelines that turn raw collection events into reliable, reportable data.
  
  
As our platform continues to scale, we are evolving these systems to improve performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency while building out key parts of the platform from the ground up on a modern, cloud-native stack.
  
  
We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer who enjoys solving challenging backend and distributed systems problems, working with high-throughput streaming services, and building reliable software that operates at enterprise scale.
  
  
You will work closely with experienced engineers, Product Management, QA, and other platform teams to design and deliver capabilities that directly impact how millions of surveys and responses are processed across the platform.
  
  
This role is based remotely in Pune. Candidates for this position are required to reside within the Pune metropolitan area. Relocation support is not available at this time.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive resolution on open, cross-cutting architectural questions — Nexus has several live ones at any given time (e.g., which store owns a given workload and why, how a materialization strategy should be chosen and validated, how a new enrichment type should integrate without violating existing invariants). You're expected to drive these to a documented, defensible decision — not just have an opinion on them.
* Own the integrity of the platform's core data invariants across teams — multi-tenant isolation via the composite entity key model, the rule that enrichments never rewrite interaction data, and that row-level access is enforced on views rather than scattered through application logic. When a new feature threatens one of these, you're the engineer who catches it before it ships.
* Design the pipeline and schema evolution patterns other teams build against — e.g., how a dataset schema can evolve without migrations or downtime, how a new interaction type gets onboarded, how an enrichment's output reaches reporting without duplicating or destabilizing existing views. Lead technical design for major cross-team initiatives — examples at this scale: extending the platform to ingest data originating from Medallia's existing products (MEC) alongside Nexus-native data, designing how AI agents (survey-building assistants, conversational feedback collection) integrate with the core data model via MCP/A2A without becoming a second, inconsistent source of truth.
* Evaluate and make build-vs-buy and store-selection decisions with real stakes — e.g., assessing whether a given workload belongs on a relational store, a wide-column store, or an OLAP engine, and what the actual operational and consistency trade-offs are, backed by a POC or benchmark rather than a hunch.
* Mentor senior and mid-level engineers on distributed systems design, data modeling for multi-tenant correctness, and how to reason about trade-offs in a system where "simple and wrong" fails silently and expensively.
* Represent engineering in architecture and design reviews across team boundaries, and be a primary author of the architecture documentation the rest of the organization builds against.
* Get hands-on when it matters — staff-level scope doesn't mean stepping back from code. You'll personally build the hardest, highest-leverage pieces of a cross-cutting initiative, especially where the design risk is too high to hand off before it's proven out.
* Improve how the platform is operated at scale — reliability, observability, and incident response patterns that work across both the application and data layers, not just within one service's boundary.
* Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly, and set the bar for how your teams evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, and long-term maintainability.

**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications:
  
  
  

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership beyond your own individual contributions — driving decisions, designs, or initiatives that other engineers and teams built on top of.
* Deep expertise in distributed systems — you can reason rigorously about consistency models, failure modes, data consistency guarantees, and the real trade-offs behind an architectural decision, not just the vocabulary.
* Strong backend engineering background, ideally spanning more than one language/stack (e.g., Java and TypeScript/Node.js, or equivalent) — this role operates across Nexus Core and the Data Platform, and needs to be credible in both.
* Demonstrated experience with event-driven and streaming architectures (Kafka or equivalent, plus a stream processor such as Flink, Spark Streaming, or Kafka Streams).
* Deep experience with relational and/or wide-column data stores at scale, including schema design for systems that can't tolerate downtime or destructive changes.
* Proven experience designing for multi-tenant SaaS correctness — tenant isolation, authorization models, and the discipline required when a design mistake doesn't just cause a bug, it causes a data leak between customers.
* A track record of making and defending hard technical trade-off decisions in writing — RFCs, design docs, or equivalent — and bringing skeptical stakeholders to alignment.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical direction without direct management authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication — at this level, your technical judgment is only as useful as your ability to convey it clearly to engineers, product, and leadership.

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  
  

* Experience designing row-level or policy-based authorization systems, especially ones enforced at the data/view layer rather than purely in application code.
* Experience with identity resolution systems — matching, merging, and the operational cost of getting profile/entity resolution wrong at scale.
* Experience integrating LLM-based agents or tools into a production platform, especially using protocols like MCP (Model Context Protocol) or agent-to-agent (A2A) coordination.
* Experience leading a platform migration or hybrid-integration effort — e.g., bringing a legacy system's data into a new platform without forcing customers through a disruptive migration.
* Background in customer experience management, survey platforms, or voice-of-customer systems.
* Experience as a technical lead on a greenfield platform build, with scars to show for the early architectural bets that worked and the ones that didn't.

At Medallia, we celebrate diversity and recognize the value it brings to our customers and employees. Medallia is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age (40 and over), disability, genetic information, veteran status or military service, or any other status protected by state or local law. Individuals with a disability who need an accommodation to apply please contact us at ApplicantAccessibility@medallia.com. For information regarding how Medallia collects and uses personal information, please review our Privacy Policies. Applications will be accepted for 30 days from the date this role was posted or until the role has been filled.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
Use analytical and quantitative methods to understand, predict, and enhance supply chain processes. Responsible for analyzing performance, identifying problems, and developing recommendations to improve the organization's Supply Chain.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Provide analytical support to one or more functional areas Use common processes tools, and information systems to enable supply chain analysis. Ensure data integrity of all analytics and reports. Analyze and interpret Key Performance Indicators to identify areas for improvement and action plans. Participate in six sigma and supply chain improvement projects Use existing business systems to provide analytics and reporting that are capable and repeatable.
  
  
**Competencies**
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  
  
Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.
  
  
Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  
  
Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.
  
  
Materials Planning System Utilization - Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day-to-day operations.
  
  
Plan for Every Part (PFEP) - Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.
  
  
Analysis and Troubleshooting - Extracts, transforms, models, interprets, and presents planning data with the goal of mining useful information, troubleshooting, suggesting conclusions, and supporting value creating decision making.
  
  
Inventory Management and Optimization - Uses analytics and algorithms to determine the optimal level of inventory investment across the end-to-end supply chain within specific constraints (warehouse space, customer delivery, etc.); provides guidance and expertise on planning parameter refinement; develops inventory strategies to support Cummins' strategy and not just a business unit strategy.
  
  
Material Planning - Uses advanced tools (e.g. Advanced Planning Command Centre, Business Intelligence (BI) Dashboards etc.) to take a decision related to parts availability, inventory optimization and root cause analysis.
  
  
Materials KPI Management - Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end-customer impact; strategically balances trade-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
College, university, or equivalent degree required.
  
  
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
**Experience**
Minimal to intermediate level of experience required.
  
  
**Shift: EMEA shift (12:30pm to 9:30pm) Hybrid working (3 days from office)**
**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of Supply Chain Management concepts
* Hands-on experience in SQL (intermediate level)
* Proficiency in Power BI (dashboarding, DAX, data modeling)
* Experience working with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Data Lakes
* Understanding of database systems like Oracle
* Ability to connect and work with multiple data sources
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
* Good project management & communication skills to interact with cross-functional teams

**Note:**
Candidates with a strong mix of supply chain understanding and data analytics expertise will be preferred.

**Role Category**

**Job Type**
Exempt - Experienced

title: Vice President / Database Administration Manager
description:

As a leading global investment management firm, AB fosters diverse perspectives and embraces innovation to help our clients navigate the uncertainty of capital markets. Through high-quality research and diversified investment services, we serve institutions, individuals, and private wealth clients in major markets worldwide. Our ambition is simple: to be our clients’ most valued asset-management partner.
  
  
With over 4,400 employees across 51 locations in 25 countries, our people are our advantage. We foster a culture of intellectual curiosity and collaboration to create an environment where everyone can thrive and do their best work. Whether you're producing thought-provoking research, identifying compelling investment opportunities, infusing new technologies into our business, or providing thoughtful advice to clients, we’re looking for unique voices to help lead us forward. If you’re ready to challenge your limits and build your future, join us.
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
We are seeking a
***PUNE***
based
***VP Database Operations Manager***
to join our
***GTI ( Global Technology Infrastructure)***
in Global Technology & Operations.
  
  
**Team/Group Description**
This position operates in a fast-paced, innovative, and globally distributed environment with On-Call responsibilities for critical incidents. If you are a passionate technical leader with deep SQL Server, Oracle and Azure expertise, strong automation capabilities, and a desire to drive excellence within the DBMS Operations group, this role offers an outstanding opportunity to lead enterprise database strategy and deliver transformative business value
  
  
**Role Description**
The Enterprise Database Operations Lead is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the database administration team and ensuring the high availability, security, performance, and scalability of enterprise database platforms across the global organization. This role combines hands-on expertise in relational database management systems (strong emphasis on Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL in Azure, Oracle and Sybase) with strategic oversight and team management to drive operational excellence, innovation, and alignment with business objectives in a fast-paced, mission-critical environment.
  
  
**Applications And Business Or Enterprise Functions The Role Supports**

This role underpins support for mission-critical enterprise RDBMS systems, that include financial trading systems, accounting, brokerage, business intelligence and advanced analytics, regulatory compliance and data governance, customer-facing applications, and disaster recovery/business continuity operations. By maintaining robust, high-availability database infrastructures, optimizing performance at scale, and enabling seamless data integration, the role minimizes business disruptions, supports real-time global decision-making, powers enterprise-wide reporting and analytics, and enables strategic initiatives such as cloud platform modernization, large-scale data platform modernization / migrations, and adoption of advanced data services
  
  
**Key Job Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**

* Leading, managing, and mentoring a team of Database Administrators within the DBMS Operations group, including performance evaluations, coaching, resource planning, and fostering a high-performance, collaborative culture centered on knowledge sharing and continuous technical growth.
* Serving as the organization’s primary subject matter expert on database platforms, diagnosing and resolving complex issues, establishing and enforcing best practices, and ensuring rapid, effective incident response to maintain minimal business impact.
* The candidate will be responsible to manage scalable, resilient database solutions, including advanced high-availability configurations, disaster recovery strategies, and integration of modern technologies—in close partnership with the broader DBMS Engineering group and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Developing and maintaining sophisticated automation frameworks using advanced scripting (PowerShell, T-SQL) and tools (SQL Agent & ControlM scheduler) to streamline critical operations such as backups, patching, monitoring, alerting, capacity management, and routine maintenance.
* Collaborating intensively with application development, infrastructure, and business teams to optimize database design, query and indexing strategies, performance tuning, and application-database integration while safeguarding data integrity and compatibility.
* Driving proactive performance and tuning, capacity planning, monitoring, and bottleneck resolution using enterprise-grade tools to deliver optimal system efficiency and reliability.
* Championing knowledge transfer, technical training, and continuous improvement initiatives within the DBMS Operations group; analyzing performance metrics and trends to identify and implement impactful enhancements.
* Providing strategic technical guidance and roadmap input to the enterprise application teams on database platform evolution, including Azure cloud adoption (IaaS/PaaS), platform upgrades/migrations, and evaluation of emerging data technologies to support long-term organizational objectives.

**What Makes This Role Unique Or Interesting**
This role combines strong technical leadership with operational responsibility inside the Global Technology infrastructure team, giving you real influence over our enterprise-scale data infrastructure.
  
  
You'll gain deep expertise in advanced data server management, large-scale automation, and modern observability/logging systems — while guiding a talented team through complex, high-impact challenges.
  
  
With global scope, mission-critical systems, and the chance to shape the future of our DBMS strategy, this position bridges hands-on operations with strategic business impact. It's both highly rewarding and intellectually stimulating.
  
  
**Professional development value of this role**
Working within Global Technology Infrastructure group this role accelerates growth in advanced technical domains (SQL Server high availability/business intelligence stack, Azure PaaS/IaaS database services, enterprise automation, performance and tuning, Database Virtualization - such as Delphix) and observability, while significantly strengthening leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic planning capabilities. You will gain experience leading in a sophisticated, global operations environment, handling enterprise-scale complexity, and driving innovation in cloud and data platform modernization. These experiences position the candidate exceptionally well for future advancement into senior roles such as Senior DBMS Architect, Cloud Data Platform Lead, or broader data/infrastructure leadership positions.
  
  
**Job Qualifications (The Ideal Candidate Should Have The Following)**
The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
  
  

* Demonstrated success leading large-scale, global or multi-site database environments with strong emphasis on high availability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and mission-critical system reliability.

**Qualifications, Experience, Education**
The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
* 8+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in database administration and engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership or team lead role managing database professionals in an enterprise setting.

**Skills**

* Proficiency across RDBMS platforms (Microsoft SQL Server primary; Oracle, PostgreSQL, with some knowledge of Sybase & IQ, Redis Cache experience beneficial)
* Expert knowledge of SQL Server technologies, including Failover Clustering, AlwaysOn Availability Groups, Log Shipping, SSIS (Integration Services), SSRS (Reporting Services), and SSAS (Analysis Services).
* Advanced programming skills in PowerShell and T-SQL for sophisticated automation, scripting, and query optimization; familiarity with .NET development is advantageous.
* Strong experience with performance monitoring and management tools (e.g., SCOM, Foglight, or equivalent enterprise solutions). Knowledge in database virtualization techniques such as Delphix
* Deep understanding of Windows Server, Linux and Solaris operating systems.
* Proficiency with Cloud (Azure) technologies, including IaaS and PaaS database offerings, virtual machine sizing, disk and storage management, and related cloud infrastructure components.
* Knowledge of Splunk and other logging/observability technologies for centralized monitoring, alerting, and root-cause analysis.
* Advanced SQL skills for complex data manipulation, performance tuning, indexing strategies, query plan analysis, and optimization.

**Soft Skills And Other Requirements**

* Exceptional communication skills, with proven ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences (engineers, architects, executives, and non-technical stakeholders), produce clear documentation, and facilitate productive cross-team collaboration.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, rapid adaptability in high-pressure situations, and the ability to balance independent initiative with effective teamwork.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Microsoft SQL Server-related certifications, Azure Database Administrator Associate (or equivalent), Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), or relevant Azure/AWS cloud database certifications.

title: Data Migration Consultant
description:
About us
  
We're a technology company focused on Enterprise Delivery and Engineering. We work and partner with global organisations to deliver enterprise cloud solutions, while our engineering teams design, build, operate, and manage modern web applications, AI-driven tools, and scalable cloud infrastructure — for both our clients and our own platforms.
  
Led by hands-on, technically experienced founders, we move quickly, make decisions efficiently, and value the impact of every individual contribution. Since 2016, we've built a strong track record and are now entering an exciting phase of growth — making this a great time to join the business.
  
About the role
  
We're looking for a Data Migration Consultant to own the full migration lifecycle on Oracle implementation and upgrade projects. You will extract, cleanse, transform, load and reconcile data, and build reports and tools that give clients confidence in their data.
  
What you'll do
  
Lead data migration from legacy and Oracle EBS systems to Oracle Fusion Cloud: extraction, transformation, loading and validation.
  
Analyse source data, find quality issues, and define cleansing, de-duplication and enrichment rules with business users.
  
Prepare and load data using FBDI, HDL/HSDL, ADFdi, REST/SOAP APIs and standard import programs.
  
Build mapping documents, transformation logic and cross-reference (lookup) tables.
  
Develop BI Publisher (BIP) reports and data models for extraction, pre-load validation and post-load reconciliation.
  
Run mock conversions, track load errors, resolve root causes and maintain migration defect logs.
  
Prepare reconciliation reports and get business sign-off at each migration cycle.
  
Plan and support cutover activities, including migration runbooks and timings.
  
Write efficient SQL and PL/SQL for data profiling, transformation and validation.
  
Produce clear documentation: data migration strategy, mapping specs, test results and cutover plans.
  
Work with functional consultants, technical teams and client stakeholders across time zones.
  
About you
  
Essential
  
3+ years of Oracle data migration experience on EBS and/or Fusion Cloud projects.
  
Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills, including complex queries, performance tuning and bulk processing.
  
Hands-on experience building BI Publisher reports (data models, templates, bursting, scheduling).
  
Practical experience with data cleansing, profiling and quality checks.
  
Working knowledge of FBDI, HDL and/or ADFdi load methods.
  
Understanding of core data objects in at least one area: Financials (GL, AP, AR, FA), SCM (Items, Suppliers, Customers, POs) or HCM (Workers, Assignments).
  
Experience with migration reconciliation and audit-ready sign-off processes.
  
Good communication skills and the ability to explain data issues to business users.
  
Desirable
  
Oracle APEX experience.
  
Exposure to OTBI and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
  
Experience with ETL tools or scripting (Python, shell) for automation.
  
Experience on EBS-to-Fusion migration or EBS R12 upgrade projects.
  
Oracle certification in Fusion Cloud, Database SQL or APEX.
  
Qualifications
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  
Practicalities
  
Employer: EIDOSGLOBAL PRIVATE LIMITED.
  
Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India. Office based.
  
Employment type: Full-time.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

title: GTM Analyst
description:
Zywave | Confidential

Senior Analytics Engineer, GTM

Role Overview

Zywave is seeking a Senior Analytics Engineer, GTM to own and improve the revenue data foundation across Salesforce, Snowflake, and other GTM systems. This role focuses on data cleanliness, source-of-truth alignment, hierarchy integrity, metric logic, reconciliation, and reportable data models.

This senior individual contributor will work deeply in Snowflake and SQL, understand Salesforce data structures, consolidate data from multiple systems, and create trusted datasets for reporting and analytics. The role is distinct from a reporting analyst: it owns the underlying data layer that makes reporting accurate, scalable, and trusted.

Reporting Relationship

This role will report to the VP, Revenue Operations

•

Key partners include Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Client Success Operations, Finance, Marketing Operations, Business Applications, Data / BI, Sales and CS leadership

Primary Responsibilities

GTM Source-of-Truth Data Model

•

Build and maintain trusted GTM data models in Snowflake that support reporting across Sales, CS, Finance, Marketing Operations, and Revenue Operations.

•

Consolidate Salesforce and other GTM system data into a single, reportable source of truth.

•

Create governed datasets for pipeline, bookings, forecast, renewals, expansion, churn, hierarchy, product, territory, and sales performance reporting.

•

Define transformation logic, business rules, joins, filters, exclusions, and documentation needed to make data usable and repeatable.

Salesforce and Snowflake Reconciliation

•

Reconcile Salesforce and Snowflake data so core revenue metrics match across systems.

•

Investigate differences between Salesforce reports, Snowflake tables, BI dashboards, and Finance reporting.

•

Identify whether discrepancies stem from source-system issues, integration failures, transformation logic, timing differences, field mapping, hierarchy logic, or reporting filters.

•

Build QA checks and reconciliation processes that proactively flag mismatches before they reach leadership reporting.

Data Cleanliness, Standardization, and Governance

•

Lead data cleanup and standardization across GTM systems and reporting layers.

•

Identify duplicate, incomplete, inconsistent, stale, or misclassified revenue data.

•

Create repeatable rules for data normalization, account hierarchy, territory assignment, product mapping, opportunity classification, renewal logic, and lifecycle status.

•

Maintain mapping tables, data dictionaries, metric definitions, lineage documentation, and QA logic.

Multi-System Consolidation

•

Consolidate data from Salesforce and GTM sources such as marketing automation, customer success, sales engagement, forecasting, product usage, enrichment, quote/order, or finance platforms.

•

Understand ingestion pipelines, sync timing, API limitations, and transformation dependencies in partnership with technical teams.

•

Turn raw and inconsistent source data into reliable analytical datasets with clear lineage from source systems to final reporting tables.

•

Reduce manual pulls, spreadsheet workarounds, and conflicting reports by improving the trusted data foundation.

Reporting Enablement, AI

•

Build datasets, semantic layers, and curated views that allow analysts and business users to create trusted dashboards.

•

Validate that reporting outputs match approved source-of-truth logic before dashboards are published.

•

Use AI tools to accelerate SQL development, QA checks, documentation, anomaly detection, data mapping, and automation.

•

Support U.S.-based stakeholders during U.S. business hours and translate technical data issues into clear business language.

•

Proactively flag risks, gaps, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs before they impact reporting.

What Success Looks Like

•

Better alignment between Salesforce, Snowflake, BI dashboards, and Finance reporting.

Zywave | Confidential

•

A clearer GTM source of truth for pipeline, bookings, forecast, renewals, expansion, churn, territory, hierarchy, and customer reporting.

•

Fewer conflicting reports and fewer manual reconciliation exercises.

•

Cleaner account hierarchy, ownership, product, territory, and opportunity classification logic.

•

Better documentation of lineage, metric definitions, transformation rules, caveats, and automated data-quality checks.

•

Improved trust in leadership reporting and operating cadences.

Required Qualifications

•

5+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, data operations, BI engineering, RevOps analytics, or a related data role.

•

Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience in Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse.

•

Experience building curated reporting tables, analytical datasets, data models, semantic layers, or BI-ready views.

•

Strong understanding of Salesforce data structures, including accounts, leads, contacts, opportunities, products, quotes, activities, users, roles, and hierarchy-related data.

•

Experience reconciling data across multiple systems and resolving source-of-truth conflicts.

•

Experience with data quality, governance, lineage, documentation, metric definition, QA, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.

•

Ability to translate business requirements into technical data logic

•

Ability to work U.S. business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

•

Experience in B2B SaaS, insurtech, fintech, HR tech, benefits technology, broker technology, carrier technology, or another workflow-heavy software environment.

•

Experience with transformation frameworks and BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, Looker, Domo, or similar platforms.

•

Experience with GTM systems such as Salesforce, LeanData, Marketo, Clari, Gong, Outreach, Salesloft, Gainsight, CPQ, order management, or data enrichment tools.

•

Experience supporting pipeline, bookings, renewal, churn, customer lifecycle, territory, account hierarchy, or revenue performance reporting.

•

Experience creating data dictionaries, source-to-target mappings, QA checks, transformation documentation, metric governance, and AI-assisted data workflows

Date: Oct 30, 2026

Location:
  
  
Pune, MH, IN Bangalore, KA, IN Bangalore, KA, IN Hyderabad, TG, IN Hyderabad, IN Pune, IN
  
  
YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.
  
  
At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.
  
  
**We are looking forward to hire Oracle EBS Professionals in the following areas :**
**Experience**
Experience 6 - 8 Years
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Oracle EBS (E-Business Suite) Techno-Functional Consultant acts as a vital bridge between business requirements and technical execution. The individual who will be analyzing processes, and building or modifying custom technical components (RICEW, Integrations etc.) to support and enhance system operations.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Production Support & Troubleshooting: Aalyze, and resolve day-to-day technical incidents within defined SLAs.

title: Enterprise Applications Analyst
description:
**Job Purpose**
Navitas Semiconductor (Nasdaq: NVTS) is a high-growth, publicly traded technology company seeking an Enterprise Applications Analyst to support and enhance its portfolio of business-critical enterprise applications, including CRM (Microsoft Dynamics CRM), Ship & Debit (Model N), and ERP (Microsoft Dynamics Business Central, Tensoft). The ideal candidate is a hands-on business systems analyst who bridges functional and technical needs across these platforms, translates business requirements into scalable system solutions, and helps connect applications and trading partners through modern integration tooling. This role partners closely with Sales, Finance, Operations, and Supply Chain in the dynamic environment of a fast-growing semiconductor company.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Duties**

* Support, configure, and maintain enterprise applications across CRM (Microsoft Dynamics CRM), Ship & Debit (Model N), ERP (Microsoft Dynamics Business Central, Tensoft), and other business-critical systems
* Serve as a functional and technical analyst supporting channel data management, Ship & Debit, pricing, rebates, and quote-to-cash / order-to-cash processes
* Elicit, document, and analyze business requirements and translate them into system configuration, functional specifications, and process designs
* Design, build, and maintain integrations between CRM, ERP, Ship & Debit, and external partner/channel systems using middleware and integration platforms (e.g., Boomi, Power Automate, MuleSoft) and API/EDI frameworks
* Ensure master data accuracy and consistency (customers, distributors, products, price lists) across connected systems, and troubleshoot data and integration issues through to resolution
* Develop and maintain reports and dashboards using SQL and Power BI to support business analytics, operational reporting, and data-driven decision-making
* Coordinate with software vendors, systems integrators, and internal teams to resolve escalated application and integration failures
* Participate in enterprise application projects, upgrades, and digital transformation initiatives, including UAT planning and execution
* Maintain IT and application controls in compliance with SOX and applicable regulatory requirements
* Create and maintain configuration documentation, knowledge base articles, standard operating procedures, and end-user training materials
* Identify recurring issues and recommend process, configuration, or system improvements
* Any and all other duties, as assigned

**Qualifications**
**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:**

* Strong functional understanding of CRM and ERP business processes, including order-to-cash, quote-to-cash, and channel/distribution management
* Experience with CRM platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics CRM.
* Experience with ERP platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics Business Central and Tensoft
* Familiarity with Ship & Debit, channel data management, or rebate management platforms such as Model N
* Understanding of integration and middleware concepts, with exposure to iPaaS/automation tools such as Boomi, Microsoft Power Automate, or MuleSoft
* Working knowledge of API (REST/SOAP) and EDI (e.g., 850, 855, 856, 810) integration patterns
* Data analysis and query skills (e.g., SQL, Excel) for validation, reconciliation, and reporting
* Experience using AI-powered tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, AI assistants) to accelerate analysis, documentation, and support efficiency
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple demands and prioritize effectively
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
* Maintains accountability for actions (ownership of work) and is extremely reliable
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work across business and technical audiences

**Requirements**
Basic
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience as a business systems / enterprise applications analyst supporting CRM and/or ERP platforms
* Demonstrated experience implementing, configuring, or supporting enterprise SaaS applications

**Preferred**

* Experience with CRM platforms (Microsoft Dynamics CRM)
* Experience with ERP platforms (Microsoft Dynamics Business Central, Tensoft)
* Experience with Ship & Debit or channel data management platforms (e.g., Model N)
* Experience in the semiconductor or high-tech manufacturing industry
* Integration experience with Boomi, Power Automate, MuleSoft, or a similar iPaaS/middleware platform
* Experience with EDI standards (ANSI X12) and REST/SOAP API integrations
* Experience maintaining IT application controls in compliance with SOX

Trinamix offers a collaborative work environment and opportunities for professional growth. If you are passionate about transforming supply chain processes and have the required expertise, we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

title: Senior AI/DS Engineer
description:
**Designation :**
Senior AI/DS Engineer

**Required Experience:**

5-6 years overall with AI/ML, data science or applied AI; at least 5 years of hands-on AI/ML/data-science work and 2+ years of technical/team leadership.

**Job Description:**

Aventior is looking for a hands-on Team Lead - AI & Data Science to lead customer-facing AI and analytics engagements from discovery through production and ongoing improvement.

The role combines technical direction, people leadership, customer communication and delivery ownership. You will turn business problems into clear requirements, assess feasibility and data readiness, shape pragmatic AI/GenAI solutions, guide engineers and data scientists, and deliver secure, measurable outcomes in production.

The strongest candidate is equally comfortable discussing business value with a customer, explaining technical options and trade-offs, reviewing code or model quality, and managing scope, risks and delivery commitments.

**Key Responsibilities**

:

**1. Customer engagement, discovery and requirement gathering -**

●Lead customer and stakeholder discovery sessions, interviews and workshops to understand business goals, users, existing workflows, pain points, data sources, constraints and success criteria.

●Translate business needs into clear problem statements, functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies and measurable KPIs.

● Assess data availability, data quality, integration constraints, privacy/security requirements and technical feasibility before recommending an approach.

● Present solution options and trade-offs in business-friendly language, including build-versus-buy, model selection, expected value, risks, cost, latency and operational implications.

● Lead proof-of-concept planning, demos, review meetings and customer sign-off; manage clarifications, scope changes, priorities and expectation setting throughout the engagement.

**2. AI solution architecture and technical leadership**

● Own solution design across data ingestion and preparation, model or LLM selection, retrieval, orchestration, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and operational monitoring.

● Choose fit-for-purpose approaches for the business problem rather than defaulting to a particular model, vendor, framework or architecture pattern.

● Establish engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, testing practices, reusable components, documentation and secure development practices.

● Remain hands-on for critical design decisions, prototypes, complex debugging and performance/cost optimisation while enabling the team to execute independently.

**3. Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows**

● Design and deliver LLM-powered applications using commercial APIs and/or managed or open models; apply prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling and workflow orchestration as appropriate.

● Build and improve RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid retrieval, reranking, access-aware retrieval, source attribution and grounded answer generation.

● Select and apply agentic patterns only where they add value; define tool permissions, bounded actions, state transitions, approval steps, retries and safe failure behavior.

● Create systematic evaluation approaches for task success, groundedness, retrieval relevance, factuality, safety and user experience; use representative test sets, regression tests and human review where needed.

●Improve quality, latency and cost through retrieval/model comparisons, prompt and context tuning, caching, routing, token-usage controls and production feedback loops.

**4. Applied machine learning and data science**

● Guide the framing, development and validation of appropriate ML/statistical solutions such as classification, regression, forecasting, anomaly detection, clustering, NLP or optimization.

● Establish baselines and evaluation criteria; interpret results, investigate failure modes, check for data leakage and communicate limitations and confidence clearly.

● Partner with data engineers and analysts on data profiling, feature engineering, data pipelines, dataset quality, reproducibility and reliable access to data.

● Guide specialist computer-vision, OCR/intelligent document processing or multimodal work when required by the project portfolio; deep specialist research methods are not a blanket requirement for this role.

**5. Production engineering, cloud and MLOps / LLMOps**

●Build or guide production services and integrations using Python and REST APIs (FastAPI or equivalent), with appropriate validation, authentication, error handling, testing and documentation.

●Deploy and operate solutions in AWS or the agreed cloud platform. Relevant AWS services may include S3, SageMaker, Bedrock, RDS, Glue, EventBridge, Redshift, Lambda and container/orchestration services, depending on the architecture.

●Implement or oversee CI/CD, containerization, environment management, model/prompt/version tracking, automated tests, release controls, rollback and operational handover.

●Monitor application health and business/model quality, including latency, throughput, availability, cost, token consumption, retrieval quality, feedback signals and model/data drift where applicable.

● Own incident triage and root-cause analysis with engineering/platform teams; define fallback paths and support processes for customer-facing AI capabilities.

**6. Delivery management and stakeholder alignment**

●Own the delivery plan from discovery to launch: estimates, milestones, sprint/backlog priorities, resource needs, dependencies, risks, testing, UAT, release readiness and transition to support.

●Maintain a clear decision, action and risk log; provide concise progress updates; escalate issues early and propose options instead of only reporting blockers.

●Coordinate across customer teams, product/business analysts, data engineering, software engineering, QA, cloud/DevOps, security and domain experts.

●Ensure acceptance criteria and agreed business outcomes are met, and capture lessons learned and post-launch improvements

**7. Team leadership, governance and responsible AI**

● Coach and mentor AI engineers and data scientists; support work allocation, technical growth, feedback, code/model reviews and consistent quality standards.

●Apply appropriate data governance, privacy, access control, PII handling, audit logging, human review and responsible-AI safeguards based on use-case risk.

●Identify GenAI-specific risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool access, unintended data exposure, unsupported outputs and misuse; document mitigations and residual risks.

●Build reusable patterns, documentation and team practices that improve delivery predictability across multiple customer engagements

**Required Qualifications and experience:**

●5-6 years of relevant software engineering, AI/ML, data science or applied                        

AI experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on delivery experience.

●At least 2 years leading a technical team, delivery workstream or project; demonstrated ownership of technical decisions and outcomes.

●At least 2 years in customer-facing or stakeholder-facing delivery, with evidence of running discovery workshops, clarifying requirements, presenting options and managing expectations.

●Strong Python engineering and practical SQL/data skills; understanding of testing, APIs, code quality and software engineering fundamentals.

●Strong applied ML/statistical reasoning and model evaluation skills, including the ability to choose baselines, validate results and explain limitations.

●At least 2 years building GenAI/LLM applications, including practical RAG experience; able to explain architecture, evaluation, failure modes and production trade-offs. At least one production deployment is strongly preferred.

●Working experience with AWS or the target cloud platform, and with model/application deployment, CI/CD, observability and production support.

●Experience with REST APIs using FastAPI or an equivalent Python web framework, and with at least one vector database or semantic-search technology when RAG is in scope.

●Strong communication, facilitation, documentation, mentoring and problem-solving skills.

●Hands-on experience with agentic/tool-using workflows, multimodal LLMs, VLMs, or more than one model provider.

●Computer vision, OCR, intelligent document processing, object detection, image segmentation or document-understanding experience where relevant to the client pipeline.

●Experience with model fine-tuning, embedding adaptation, open-source model serving or GPU/inference optimization.

●Familiarity with evaluation and tracing tools such as LangSmith, OpenTelemetry, Phoenix or equivalent; equivalent tools are acceptable.

●Experience in consulting, professional services or multi-client delivery environments.

●Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Statistics or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may be considered.

**Company Website:**

https://aventior.com/

title: Senior Engineer, Software Engineering - Java [T500-30537]
description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.**

**About DIRECTV:**

Since our inception in 1994, DIRECTV has been part of millions of American households, delivering favorite shows, sports, and premium content anytime, anywhere. We believe media entertainment is meant to be enjoyed, so we continuously evolve to provide personalized, best-in-class options that exceed expectations. We champion excellence, embrace emerging technologies, and offer industry-leading video services that feel made for each viewer.

**About DIRECTV India GCC:**

DIRECTV India, an independent capability center is our exciting new chapter in Pune where exceptional technical and AI talent come together to solve meaningful challenges and build what’s next. It’s a high-impact, high-visibility environment built to deliver on business-critical priorities. Here, your work directly shapes entertainment technology that reaches millions, while you grow your career in one of the world’s most dynamic talent markets.

**Our Purpose:**

We’re here to reimagine what’s possible in entertainment, delivering experiences that meet the viewer’s needs, timing, and preferences. With nearly three decades at the forefront, we stay focused on our people, partners, and customers, creating innovative experiences that fit seamlessly into their lives, wherever and however they choose to watch. Driven by values we truly live, we channel curiosity, care, and commitment into innovation, aggregating, curating, and delivering entertainment with exceptional services that bring the future closer every day.

**Our Values and Culture:**

We built our culture with our people, not for them. Our values unite every teammate which forms a culture grounded in care, challenge, and delivery. They are more than just principles; they are how we operate.

Anchored in a 30-year legacy of innovation and community, we’re building a future better than yesterday – for our colleagues, our customers, and our company.

**Functional EVP:**

Shape how customers discover and choose DIRECTV

Work at the intersection of software, digital experiences and customer growth. You’ll help develop the technology behind acquisition journeys, enabling prospective customers to discover DIRECTV, understand their options and take the next step with confidence. The work combines engineering depth with a clear connection to how people first engage with the DIRECTV experience.

**Position Summary:**

To help drive this next chapter, we're seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our Customer Acquisition Engineering organization. This role develops and supports modern digital applications that power customer-facing experiences across DIRECTV platforms. You will collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions while helping advance technology modernization initiatives across the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong full-stack engineering expertise, a passion for building exceptional customer experiences, and a commitment to software quality, performance, and continuous innovation.

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Software Development:**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and support Java-based microservices powering customer purchase journeys across digital and agent-assisted channels — package selection, cart, checkout, and order submission.
* Build data solutions using distributed data stores.
* Work with catalog, pricing, promotions, eligibility rules, and product dependencies.
* Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and production troubleshooting.

**Technology & Delivery:**

* Integrate with enterprise APIs and backend platforms spanning catalog, pricing, ordering, billing, subscriptions, identity, and CRM, as well as third-party and vendor APIs.
* Implement resilient, event-driven workflows with robust error handling across multi-system transactions.
* Improve service reliability, performance, security, and maintainability.
* Support Agile planning, automated testing, CI/CD, and operational readiness, including deployment runbooks, release windows, and hotfix cycles.

**Engineering Excellence:**

* Promote reusable service and integration patterns.
* Document technical solutions and share knowledge across teams.
* Identify opportunities to simplify distributed-system integrations

**Qualifications:**

**Required Experience:**

* 4–6 years of progressive software engineering experience.
* Experience developing Java-based microservices and distributed applications in production.
* Experience with distributed data stores and API-led integration across enterprise systems.
* Experience working in Agile software development environments.
* Strong collaboration, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

**Required Technical Skills:**

* Java-based microservices
* RESTful API integration
* Spring Boot

**Preferred Skills & Experience:**

* Digital commerce or e-commerce experience — catalog, pricing, ordering, billing, or payments.
* Cloud-native application architecture on AWS; containerized workloads with Kubernetes.
* Event-driven and asynchronous messaging (Kafka or comparable).
* Experience with NoSQL databases such as MongoDB or Apache Cassandra.
* API integration platforms such as MuleSoft Anypoint.
* Automated testing frameworks and modern CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Experience in a PCI-scoped or comparable regulated environment.

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science and engineering or equivalent

**Note:**
This position is based in Pune, and applications are currently being considered from candidates based in Pune.

**Talent Value Proposition statement:**

At DIRECTV India, we're building a culture with our people, not for them, grounded in the values of We Care, We Challenge, and We Deliver. We will focus on building a better future than yesterday for our colleagues, customers, and company. As part of our team, you'll help shape the future of enterprise data platforms, enable advanced analytics and AI innovation, and contribute to business-critical capabilities that impact millions of customers. If you're ready to bring your expertise, leadership, and passion for innovation to a team redefining entertainment technology, we'd love to have you join us on this journey.

Headquartered in El Segundo, California, DIRECTV has been a household name in sports and entertainment for 30 years. We've grown our global footprint with DIRECTV India, a capability center in Pune built to support our operations and speed up how we build new technology. Here, our teams work on the platforms and products that bring together satellite and streaming, so customers get their favorite content without the hassle of switching between apps or inputs. From AI-driven personalization to content built around what people actually want to watch, we're shaping what entertainment looks like next, and Pune is a big part of that.

DIRECTV is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on business requirements, qualifications, merit, and performance, without discrimination on the basis of legally protected characteristics under applicable laws.

title: Lead Engineer - Core Commerce Platform
description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. You will be part of the Core Commerce Platform organisation responsible for delivering the omnichannel commerce capabilities that power the purchase journey, inventory availability, delivery promise, order processing & fulfilment and post-purchase experiences across channels. The organisation plays a critical role in ensuring products are available to buy, orders can be fulfilled reliably, and commitments made to consumers are delivered consistently. Through a portfolio of commerce platform capabilities, the organisation enables seamless omnichannel experiences while supporting efficient, scalable, and resilient commerce operations across the global digital ecosystem.
  
  
As an OMS Lead Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the team building and supporting omni-channel commerce capabilities. You will own technical architecture, engineering standards, and key technology decisions while ensuring solutions are scalable, reliable, resilient, and aligned with the broader commerce platform strategy. Working closely with the Engineering Manager, Product Owners and Retail Tech Teams, you will deliver scalable, resilient, and secure omni-channel commerce capabilities. You will champion engineering best practices, code quality, observability, and continuous improvement across the team.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Own the technical architecture, engineering standards, and key technology decisions for OMS platforms and related integrations.
* Design and build scalable, resilient, API-first and event-driven services supporting omnichannel commerce use cases such as Click & Collect (BOPIS), Ship-from-Store, Endless Aisle, and Delivery Promise. Partner with Product Owners, Architects, Retail Technology, Supply Chain, and Business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Drive integration of OMS with Commerce Platforms, ERP, WMS, Payments, Logistics, and Customer Service systems.
* Ensure inventory visibility, order processing, fulfilment, and returns workflows are accurate, reliable, and scalable across channels and regions.
* Champion engineering excellence through code quality, automated testing, secure development practices, and continuous improvement.
* Establish and promote best practices in microservices, cloud-native architecture, observability, performance optimization, and reliability engineering.
* Mentor and coach engineers, providing technical guidance, architecture reviews, and hands-on support for complex initiatives.

* Deep understanding of the end-to-end order lifecycle, including order capture, sourcing, fulfilment, shipment, returns, exchanges, and post-purchase processes.
* Proven experience customizing and extending OMS capabilities to support evolving business requirements, omnichannel fulfilment models, and enterprise integrations.
* Strong knowledge of omnichannel commerce operations, including Ship-from-Store (SFS), Buy Online Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), Ship-to-Store, Curbside Pickup, Endless Aisle, and associated order routing strategies.
* Solid understanding of inventory management, sourcing optimization, fulfilment orchestration, and order allocation concepts across stores, DCs, and third-party fulfilment networks.
* Proven experience integrating OMS platforms with Commerce, WMS, ERP, POS, Payment, 3PL, Carrier, and Customer Service systems to enable end-to-end order visibility and orchestration.
* Experience designing OMS-centric microservice architectures with clear domain boundaries across Order Management, Inventory, Sourcing, Fulfilment, Returns, and Customer Service capabilities.
* Hands-on experience with Kafka or similar event-streaming platforms for event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and enterprise-scale system integrations.
* Experience with performance engineering, scalability testing, and optimization of high-throughput, business-critical commerce platforms.
* Experience defining and implementing capacity planning, resiliency, and scaling strategies to support peak trading events and global commerce operations.
* Experience driving technical architecture, establishing engineering standards, mentoring engineers, and influencing technical direction across cross-functional teams.

title: Google Cloud Database Administrator
description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
  
  
Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
  
  
**Job Description**
On a day-to-day basis, this individual will be responsible for administrating and implementing database solutions while providing system operational support, administration, problem resolution, and perform software installations and upgrades on our database systems concentrating on Google Cloud Platform and other cloud-based solutions (up to 30%). The Database Administrator will be expected to exhibit strong troubleshooting techniques while striving to maintain a high level of customer satisfaction. Other duties also include monitoring performance and capacity on our database systems.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:
  
  

* Responsibility for all enterprise database technology deployed in the cloud including various versions of Microsoft SQL Server and other database platforms including features such as the core database engine, reporting, data loading and transformations, business intelligence, replication technologies and other modules. Perform configuration and maintenance of database platforms, including patching.
* Monitor database instances for performance, utilization, and capacity. Work with application teams when appropriate to address issues.
* Manage maintenance plans, backups, and automated jobs.
* Responsible for the database platform security model, including using Active Directory-integrated accounts in a multi-forest environment where appropriate.
* Responsible for query writing and optimization.
* Responsible for database schema design.
* Develop, administer, and optimize Google BigQuery datasets, tables, views, partitioning, clustering, permissions, scheduled queries, and data pipelines to support reporting, analytics, and operational workloads.
* Responsible for advising report writers and their deployment in various reporting solutions or writing reports when needed.
* Support BigQuery SQL development, performance tuning, cost optimization, data governance, access controls, and integration with Google Cloud services, business intelligence tools, and enterprise data platforms.
* Use typical database, cloud, monitoring, and DevOps tools such as Google Cloud Console, BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Dataflow, Dataproc, Looker, Tableau, SQL Server Management Studio, Visual Studio Code, Git, CI/CD release tools, PowerShell, Python, and ticketing or incident management platforms.
* Apply experience with AI agents and automation tools to improve database operations, including monitoring, incident triage, knowledge retrieval, documentation generation, operational workflows, and data-driven self-service capabilities.
* Responsible for performing traces and profiling to analyze and troubleshoot problems.
* Determine the best way to improve performance, whether through hardware adjustments, server configuration changes, or index and query changes.
* Understanding of software development methodologies, software development lifecycle management, and working in an Agile/SCRUM environment with software development teams, providing consultative advice on database design and query optimization, including indexes.
* Familiarity with DevOps tools for managing releases.
* Familiarity with code repository tools for managing SQL objects as code with version control.
* On-call support for after-hours issues required. Leverage automated alerting to be notified of issues as they happen. Tune alerts to reduce noise.
* Responds to incoming phone, email, or web-reported technical issues from internal users related to network and infrastructure, and assists in troubleshooting database issues as well as application issues for which the database may be a contributing factor.
* Identifies severity and impact and documents details in the Help Desk call tracking system.
* Performs database monitoring to ensure service level agreements are met and alerts appropriate IT staff and management of any downtime.
* Works in partnership with all IT teams to find solutions, and/or escalates issues to appropriate IT groups for resolution.
* Communicates status and updates to end users in a timely and consistent manner.
* Sets priorities for open issues and escalates issues to the correct department for resolution.
* Follows through with closure of user issues.
* Recreates problems in development environments for troubleshooting and resolution when needed.
* Creates and documents workarounds.
* Assist in training.

**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**
The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.
  
  

* 7+ years of experience in database administration in a cloud-based enterprise environment, preferably across multiple versions of cloud providers using multiple database platforms.
* Administrative knowledge of Active Directory and other forms of database security
* Scripting and automation experience
* Demonstrated excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Demonstrated strong customer service and analytic skills
* Demonstrated ability to think through sets of complex problems, create and implement appropriate solutions
* Proven ability to establish and maintain effective professional working relationships
* Ability to think and work independently
* Ability to adapt and learn in a fast-paced, changing environment.
* Administrative experience with at least one of Azure, Google Cloud, AWS
* Experience using or supporting AI agents, copilots, or intelligent automation solutions for database administration, cloud operations, monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, or analytics use cases.
* Linux experience a plus.
* Administration experience in backup technologies that can be used to back up various database platforms. Additional experience in Disaster Recovery technologies a plus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 10+ Years of experience preferred spanning more than one environment
* MongoDB and other non-Microsoft SQL Server database technologies a plus
* Data Warehousing experience a plus
* Hands-on Google Cloud database administration experience, including BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, IAM, performance tuning, cost optimization, and data governance.
* Experience using or supporting AI agents, copilots, or intelligent automation solutions to improve database administration, cloud operations, monitoring, incident triage, documentation, analytics, and self-service workflows.
* PowerShell scripting and automation experience a plus

**Additional Information**
**OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:**
**Patient Minded**
I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.
  
  
**Client Delight**
I own every client experience and its impact on results.
  
  
**Take Action**
I am empowered and empower others to act now.
  
  
**Grow Talent**
I own my development and invest in the development of others.
  
  
**Win Together**
I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.
  
  
**Communication Matters**
I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.
  
  
**Embrace Diversity**
I create an environment of awareness and respect.
  
  
**Always Innovate**
I am bold and creative in everything I do.
  
  
Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.
  
  
From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

title: Safety System Administrator (Required Argus Safety Systems, system configuration and safety data migration experience)
description:
**Company Description**
Medicine moves forward here. So will you.
  
  
At PrimeVigilance, patient safety is not one part of the job. It is why we exist.
  
  
We are a global pharmacovigilance specialist. Our teams help clients navigate complex regulations while keeping patient safety at the center of every decision, from early development through to post-marketing surveillance. Increasingly, the value we create is not only in processing safety data but in interpreting it: spotting the signal that matters early and turning it into insight our clients can act on.
  
  
That work takes curious minds, problem-solvers and experts who care about getting it right. It also takes a culture worth staying for. Across Europe, North America, South America, Asia and Australia, we work in an environment built on kindness, flexibility, growth and belonging, where colleagues support one another and good ideas are heard wherever they come from.
  
  
If you want a role with real purpose, global reach and the chance to keep growing while you help protect patients, you will feel at home here. We would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
This role requires working as part of the Safety & MI System Administrator Team performing database administration activities; supporting creation and upgrade of database instances; change control and data migration activities; first line user support and troubleshooting; and training users on databases.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**
The Safety System Administrator is primarily responsible for:
  
  

* Maintenance of database libraries
* Involvement in system validation activities
* Interrogating the database and generating outputs for internal and client use
* Training and providing database access to internal and client users

**Principle Functions For the Client (may include but is not limited to the following)**

* Set up and maintenance of project specific database libraries including:
* Products
* Licenses
* Studies
* Reporting destinations
* Documenting and validating any change to the project specific database
* Support during legacy data transfer e.g., validation
* Supporting/providing guidance to the Project Manager / Client / Project Start Up Team during the development of project specific data handling guidelines (to ensure project specific guidelines are necessary and will not impact line listings and report generation)
* Prepare line listings and tabulations and other database outputs for use in aggregate reports, signal detection, reconciliation and other activities as required
* Provide case processing metrics required for invoicing (e.g., number of submissions, number of spontaneous vs initial cases processed)
* Provide database training to clients
* Providing and documenting client / internal team access upon receipt of an approved access request.

**For the Company (may include but is not limited to the following)**

* Coordinate user access (including maintenance and revoking access)
* Maintain database procedures including core data handling conventions
* Provide database training and certification to PrimeVigilance users
* Provide user support
* Involvement in root cause investigation of database related deviations and ensure timely and complete documentation of resulting actions in line with Quality procedures
* Provide case processing quality and compliance metrics to the Quality Team
* Identify areas for improvement and address via training, clarifying changes to data handling guidelines, user guides etc.
* Execute business continuity periodic testing for database failure
* Ensure that existing software bugs, user requests, changes to regulatory requirements etc., are considered and appropriate changes are made and validated as required
* Support IT, database vendor and technical colleagues in troubleshooting and implementing software fixes and enhancements as required

**Other Supportive Responsibilities**
Assist PrimeVigilance senior management on an as needed basis. Potentially provide chargeable consulting / training activities to clients regarding Argus, and if required LSSMV.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Educated to degree standard
  
  
Demonstrated work experience within Argus Safety Systems.
  
  
**Additional Information**
When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.
  
  
We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.
  
  

* Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
* Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
* Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
* Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.

title: Data Modeler
description:
**About The Role**
**As a
**Data Modeler at TVH**
, you will play a central role in shaping how our global organization structures, understands, and leverages its data. Operating across
**all core business domains**
(e.g., Customer, Supplier, Item, Product, Equipment, HR, Finance, Commercial, Operations, …), you will design, develop, and maintain high-performing Logical Data Models (LDM) and Physical Data Models (PDM) that power enterprise reporting, analytics, and operational applications.**
**You will translate diverse cross-domain business requirements into clear, standardized, and scalable data structures. Working closely with Domain Architects, Data Engineers, and Data Stewards, you will ensure our logical abstractions align perfectly with business reality while our physical implementations maximize database performance and data accessibility.**
****Key Responsibilities****

* Enterprise Logical & Physical Data Model Design:

+ Design, construct, and maintain normalized Conceptual and Logical Data Models (LDM) across all enterprise domains, establishing clear entities, attributes, relationships, and business definitions.
+ Translate LDMs into optimized Physical Data Models (PDM) tailored for target database platforms, balancing storage efficiency, index strategies, and query performance.
+ Reverse-engineer legacy source systems and translate complex domain requirements into normalized, reusable data structures.
+ Produce and manage comprehensive data documentation, including ERDs (Entity-Relationship Diagrams), data dictionaries, and data mapping lineage.

* Domain Alignment & Standards Governance:

+ Drive consistent data modeling standards, naming conventions, and design patterns across all domain modeling initiatives.
+ Partner with Data Governance teams to incorporate standardized business glossaries and enterprise metadata standards directly into model structures.
+ Conduct data model reviews with technical and business teams to ensure cross-domain consistency and avoid data duplication.

* Cross-Functional Technical Collaboration:

+ Work hand-in-hand with Domain Architects to ensure domain models fit seamlessly into TVH’s target data architecture strategy.
+ Collaborate with Data Engineers to guide the physical realization of models and support optimized ETL/ELT pipeline design.
+ Partner with Data Analysts, Data Stewards and Business Partners to validate logical assumptions, clarify business logic, and refine domain models as needs evolve.

* Model Optimization & Quality:

+ Profile source data using SQL to uncover structural edge cases and validate cardinality before finalizing logical designs.
+ Refine physical schemas for cloud data warehouses, adjusting partitioning, clustering, and denormalization strategies to meet performance SLAs.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience focused specifically on Logical Data Modeling (LDM) and Physical Data Modeling (PDM) across multiple business domains.
* Deep expertise in diverse modeling paradigms: Relational/Entity-Relationship (3NF), Dimensional Modeling (Star/Snowflake), and Denormalization concepts.
* Strong proficiency in SQL for deep source system profiling, data mapping, and schema validation.
* Hands-on experience with modern cloud data warehouses (preferably GCP BigQuery, Snowflake, or Databricks) and relational database platforms.
* Proficiency with enterprise data modeling tools (e.g., Erwin, PowerDesigner, SqlDBM, or similar).
* Solid understanding of Data Warehousing principles, metadata management, and ETL/ELT architecture.
* Fluent in English with excellent communication skills to articulate complex logical structures to both business stakeholders and engineering teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Data Vault 2.0 modeling methodologies for enterprise scale.
* Exposure to real-time or streaming data modeling patterns (Event-driven architectures).
* Understanding of data privacy impact on data design (e.g., handling PII attributes across global domains).
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum distributed software delivery teams.
