title: Team Lead, Field Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
As a Field Engineer, Team Lead you will serve as a player-coach — guiding a team of field engineers while personally executing the most complex, mission-critical technical work yourself. Operating at the intersection of engineering and client success, you are both the technical anchor for your team and Addepar's technical vanguard in the field, translating complex business requirements into production-grade integrations, automations, and data solutions.
  
  
You will be the technical expert across Addepar's full solution suite — from API integrations and automation frameworks to advanced data platforms (including our white-labeled Databricks offering, ADX) and AI-driven tooling. At the same time, you will develop your people-management skills: providing daily guidance, coordinating work allocation, and turning the vision set by leadership into reality while keeping your team aligned to our core processes. This role combines a forward-deployed delivery model with hands-on technical depth and functional leadership of a high-performing engineering team.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**Important Note: This role will require you to work from Pune office 3 days a week in UK shift i.e. 2:30 PM to 11:30 PM IST. (hybrid role)**
**What You’ll Do**

* Serve as a player-coach: provide functional leadership and daily operational guidance to a team of field engineers while remaining a hands-on technical contributor on the most complex engagements
* Architect, build, and deliver custom integrations, automations, and data pipelines using Addepar's APIs, ADX (Databricks), and modern engineering tools
* Manage the team's work allocation and coordinate activities across simultaneous client engagements, ensuring results are delivered on schedule and in collaboration with cross-functional partners
* Guide the team through issue resolution, proactively escalate blockers, and maintain alignment with client and internal stakeholders
* Design and implement production-grade solutions that dramatically improve client onboarding efficiency, reduce time-to-value, and enable operational scale
* Build intelligent automation leveraging AI, LLMs, and machine learning to solve complex data transformation, validation, and reconciliation challenges
* Serve as the technical owner for ADX implementations, designing robust data infrastructure within Databricks to streamline client data onboarding and analytics
* Write and review production-quality Python code for ETL pipelines, API integrations, data validation frameworks, and automation tooling
* Translate ambiguous client requirements into flexible, scalable technical solutions through deep discovery, prototyping, and iterative delivery
* Support career development by providing continuous feedback loops on technical and project execution, mentoring engineers as they grow
* Identify and drive opportunities to improve tools, workflows, and automation for greater team efficiency, and develop internal frameworks and best practices that accelerate delivery
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Services teams to identify opportunities for productization and influence the platform roadmap
* Act as a technical advisor and trusted partner to clients, proactively identifying opportunities to drive additional value

**Who You Are**

* Experience: Minimum 8+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or forward-deployed technical roles, with demonstrated experience guiding, mentoring, or leading other engineers
* Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Python with experience building production-grade applications, APIs, and data pipelines; strong understanding of REST APIs, authentication patterns, and integration architecture
* Data Platforms: Hands-on experience with Databricks, Spark, and distributed data processing frameworks; proficiency in SQL and experience working with large-scale datasets across relational and NoSQL databases
* Pipelines & Automation: Experience designing and implementing ETL/ELT pipelines for complex data transformations; familiarity with AI/ML tools and experience implementing LLM-driven automation solutions
* Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of financial data domains including portfolio management, performance analytics, and multi-asset class portfolios
* Engineering Practices: Experience with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and modern software development practices
* Leadership: A solutions-driven, player-coach mindset — able to balance hands-on delivery with coordinating a team, providing feedback, and a commitment to growing your people-management skills
* Communication: Outstanding communication skills with the ability to conduct technical presentations and translate complex concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences
* Organization: Highly organized with attention to detail, able to prioritize and context-switch across simultaneous client engagements and deliver results that may impact schedules and costs
* Mindset: Independent, adaptable, and entrepreneurial with a strong work ethic, a bias for action, and a passion for client impact; thrives in ambiguous, fast-paced environments while maintaining high-quality standards

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

title: Senior Integration Health Engineer
description:
**Our Mission**
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a detail-oriented Senior Integration Health Engineer to ensure the stability, performance, and reliability of our system integrations. This role focuses on monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing integrations between various applications, platforms, and third-party services. The ideal candidate will proactively identify potential issues, resolve system errors, and work closely with development and operations teams to maintain seamless data flow and system connectivity. They will build and maintain secure Claude Code and Glean tooling that improves integration triage, troubleshooting, documentation, and QA while applying evidence-based verification, human review, and measurable quality controls. In addition to technical responsibilities, this role also includes leadership in process improvement, training, and communication across teams and stakeholders.
  
  
A Day in Your Life
  
  

* Monitor Integration Performance – Continuously oversee system integrations to detect anomalies, latency, or failures.

title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
**Senior Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - Data Platform**
**OpenSearch Must-Have | Kafka | Redis | Python Automation | Production Reliability**
**Level**
Senior DBRE (Senior Individual Contributor)
  
  
**Domain**
Distributed Data Infrastructure
  
  
**Primary Focus**
Hands-on reliability and operational ownership for assigned OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Kafka, and Redis services; Python automation and disciplined production execution
  
  
**Work Expectations**
U.S. Eastern Time business hours; on-call participation as required
  
  

* Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior DBRE to improve the reliability, performance, scalability, and automation of mission-critical distributed data platforms. OpenSearch/Elasticsearch is the core must-have technology, complemented by production experience with Kafka, Redis, Linux systems, observability, and Python automation.
  
  
This is a hands-on role. The Senior DBRE independently operates assigned clusters and services, troubleshoots production issues, performs upgrades and lifecycle work, builds practical automation, and contributes to platform design and production-readiness standards.
  
  

* Level Scope and Leadership Expectations

The Senior DBRE is a high-impact hands-on engineer focused on independent execution within an assigned platform scope. Senior engineers solve common and moderately complex production problems, improve automation and runbooks, and contribute to designs and standards while escalating broader architectural decisions appropriately.
  
  
**Expectation at This Level**
**Scope of Ownership**
Owns assigned clusters, services, maintenance activities, incidents, upgrades, backup/restore, capacity reviews, and operational improvements with limited supervision.
  
  
**Technical Depth**
Diagnoses common and moderately complex issues involving shards, indexing, search, Kafka lag, Redis memory behavior, JVM, Linux, storage, and networking.
  
  
**Automation**
Builds and maintains tested Python tools, operational CLIs, API integrations, dashboards, alerts, and runbooks that reduce recurring toil.
  
  
**Execution**
Executes migrations, rolling upgrades, scaling, and DR exercises with change-management discipline and appropriate technical review.
  
  
**Collaboration**
Partners with Lead and Staff engineers, SRE, application, infrastructure, storage, network, and cloud teams; documents findings and communicates risks early.
  
  
**Architecture Influence**
Contributes evidence and operational experience to design reviews; does not independently set enterprise-wide platform architecture.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* OpenSearch and Elasticsearch Operations
* Operate, scale, and improve assigned OpenSearch/Elasticsearch clusters and node topologies.
* Troubleshoot shard allocation, indexing throughput, slow search and aggregation workloads, cluster state, JVM heap/GC, disk, memory, and recovery issues.
* Implement and maintain index templates, shard strategies, ISM/ILM policies, rollover, retention, snapshot, restore, and rolling-upgrade procedures.
* Kafka and Redis Operations
* Operate Kafka topics, partitions, replication, retention, consumer groups, and broker health; diagnose lag, rebalance storms, and capacity bottlenecks.
* Operate Redis Cluster and Sentinel environments; address memory fragmentation, eviction behavior, persistence, replication lag, connection limits, and failover issues.
* Automation and Infrastructure as Code
* Develop clean, modular Python automation for health checks, maintenance, validation, reporting, and safe remediation.
* Use Terraform, Ansible, GitOps workflows, or Kubernetes operators where applicable to make platform operations repeatable.
* Reliability and Incident Response
* Instrument actionable metrics and alerts using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or comparable platforms.
* Participate in on-call, stabilize incidents, document root cause, and complete preventive actions.
* Contribute to capacity planning, production-readiness reviews, runbooks, and design reviews.
* Required Qualifications and Experience
* 5+ years of relevant DBRE, SRE, database, or distributed-systems operations experience in production environments.
* Strong hands-on OpenSearch and/or Elasticsearch experience, including shards, indexing, search, lifecycle management, JVM behavior, and snapshot/restore.
* Production experience with at least one of Kafka or Redis; experience with both is strongly preferred.
* Strong Linux and systems troubleshooting skills across CPU, memory, storage I/O, networking, and process behavior.
* Ability to write maintainable Python automation beyond simple one-off shell scripts.
* Experience with monitoring, incident response, controlled production changes, upgrades, and operational documentation.
* Clear communication, sound judgment, and willingness to escalate risk early.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Hands-on experience with both Kafka and Redis.
* Terraform, Ansible, GitOps, Kubernetes, ECK/OpenSearch, Strimzi, or Redis operators.
* Cloud-managed data services in AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Familiarity with ClickHouse, Pinot, vector databases, Flink, Spark Streaming, or Kafka Connect.
* Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months
* Establish measurable baselines and deliver material improvements in reliability, alert quality, MTTR, and recurring operational toil for assigned services.
* Automate high-frequency maintenance and validation workflows using maintainable Python tooling.
* Improve runbook coverage, upgrade readiness, backup/restore confidence, and capacity visibility.
* Contribute a well-supported evaluation or operational-readiness recommendation for one relevant emerging technology when business needs require it.
* What This Role Does Not Include
* This is not a people-management role.
* This is not passive monitoring, ticket routing, or a generic operations queue; hands-on troubleshooting and improvement are expected.
* This role does not independently own enterprise-wide architecture or technical strategy.
* This role does not own application code or product feature delivery, although close partnership with application teams is required.
* The role does not require equal mastery of every listed platform; OpenSearch/Elasticsearch is the anchor expertise, with complementary Kafka and/or Redis depth.
* Work Expectations and Location

This role requires working during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.

title: MSFDL-Manager - Data Audit Framework
description:

**Job Title: Manager – Data Operations**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Data Operations & Technical Oversight

+ Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
+ Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
+ Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
+ Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
+ Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
+ Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

* Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

+ Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
+ Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
+ Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
+ Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
+ Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

* Team Leadership & Talent Management

+ Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
+ Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
+ Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
+ Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

* Business & Stakeholder Management

+ Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
+ Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
+ Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
+ Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

* Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

+ Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
+ Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
+ Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to manage production data services against SLAs, prioritize incidents by business impact, and coordinate effective service restoration.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.
* Ability to interpret operational metrics, identify performance and capacity issues, and coordinate improvements with engineering and platform teams.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), finance data flows, and the importance of timely and accurate reporting is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, ERP-connected data pipelines, analytics platforms, or period-end reporting operations is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and collaboration skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain incidents, business impact, and resolution progress to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to remain organized under pressure, apply structured problem-solving, and balance hands-on troubleshooting with effective delegation.
* High ownership mindset focused on data reliability, service quality, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

You will leverage event-driven architectures to ensure seamless, high-throughput, and low-latency data movement between enterprise platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Pipeline Architecture & Development:**
  Design, build, and deploy robust, real-time, and batch data pipelines integrating disparate ERP with downstream data lakes and platforms.
* **Event-Driven Systems:**
  Leverage Apache Kafka, Kafka Connect, and stream processing engines (Kafka Streams or Apache Flink) to process and transform high-volume change data capture (CDC) and transactional data.
* **Service & API Engineering:**
  Build resilient microservices and integration layers using Java and Spring Boot to orchestrate complex data flows and enterprise APIs.
* **Containerization & Orchestration:**
  Package applications into Docker containers and manage scalable deployments, service discovery, and container orchestration via Kubernetes.
* **Data Modeling & Storage:**

* **DevOps & Automation:**

Project Role Description: Design, implement, and manage enterprise hybrid cloud storage solutions using Nasuni, AWS cloud-native backup services, with good-to-have skills in Dell EMC ECS and Tintri VM-aware storage. Act as a storage SME to identify, diagnose, and resolve complex storage incidents across critical business systems.
  
  
Must Have Skills: Nasuni Cloud Storage, AWS Storage & Cloud-Native Backup
  
  
Good To Have Skills: Dell EMC ECS (Elastic Cloud Storage), Tintri VM-Aware Storage
  
  
Minimum Experience Required: 5+ years of experience in enterprise storage administration
  
  
Educational Qualification: 15 years full time education (B.E. / B.Tech / MCA or equivalent)
  
  
**Summary**
Design, build, configure, and manage hybrid cloud storage environments integrating Nasuni cloud file services with AWS-native storage and backup solutions. The role involves administering storage platforms across cloud and on-premises infrastructure to meet business continuity, performance, and compliance requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
As an experienced Storage Administrator, the role will involve providing Storage technical administration support and storage development services. The person must possess confidence in technical abilities to perform day-to-day storage administration, project migration, and production issue troubleshooting.
  
  
Technical Experience:
  
  
Hands-on experience with Nasuni UniFS global file system, Edge Appliances, and Nasuni Management Console (NMC).
  
  
Expertise in AWS storage services: S3, EFS, AWS Backup, Data Sync, and Storage Gateway.
  
  
Deep knowledge of AWS cloud-native backup strategies including backup policies, lifecycle rules, cross-region replication, and disaster recovery.
  
  
Configure and manage Nasuni integration with AWS S3 as the cloud object storage backend.
  
  
Manage Nasuni snapshot versioning, ransomware protection, and global file locking for distributed environments.
  
  
Design and implement AWS IAM policies, S3 bucket policies, and Object Lock for data governance and compliance.
  
  
Experience in Nasuni migration activities from legacy NAS platforms (NetApp, Isilon, Windows File Server).
  
  
Automate storage operations using Python, PowerShell, Bash, Terraform, or AWS CloudFormation.
  
  
Good to have: Dell EMC ECS object storage cluster administration, namespace/bucket configuration, and S3-compatible API integration.
  
  
Good to have: Tintri VMstore administration, per-VM QoS, snapshot management, and VMware vCenter integration.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
Expected to perform independently and become an SME in Nasuni and AWS cloud storage domains.
  
  
Required active participation and contribution in team discussions, architecture reviews, and change advisory board (CAB) processes.
  
  
Contribute in providing solutions to work-related storage problems, including capacity planning and performance optimization.
  
  
Assist in monitoring system performance and proactively identify potential issues to prevent downtime across Nasuni, AWS, ECS, and Tintri platforms.
  
  
Support junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance on technical challenges related to cloud and on-premises storage.
  
  
Participate in the development and improvement of operational runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and storage automation scripts.
  
  
Engage in continuous learning to stay updated with Nasuni product updates, AWS storage services, and industry best practices.
  
  
Coordinate with vendors (Nasuni, AWS, Dell EMC, Tintri) for escalation, issue resolution, and product licensing.
  
  
Provide 24/7 on-call support for critical storage incidents and backup/restore operations.
  
  
**Professional & Technical Skills**
Must Have Skills:
  
  
Nasuni Cloud Storage: Proficiency in Nasuni UniFS, Edge Appliances, NMC, snapshot policies, ransomware recovery, and cloud backend integration.
  
  
AWS Storage & Backup: Expertise in S3, EFS, FSx, AWS Backup, DataSync, Storage Gateway, and cost optimization strategies.
  
  
Backup & Recovery: Strong understanding of backup architectures, RPO/RTO objectives, disaster recovery planning, and business continuity.
  
  
Protocols: Strong knowledge of NFS, SMB/CIFS, S3, iSCSI, and Fibre Channel storage protocols.
  
  
Security & Compliance: Understanding of data encryption (at-rest and in-transit), RBAC, IAM, and compliance frameworks (SOX, GDPR, HIPAA).
  
  
Monitoring: Experience with AWS CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, or equivalent monitoring and alerting platforms.
  
  
Active Directory & LDAP: Experience integrating file storage platforms with enterprise identity and access management systems.
  
  
Good to Have Skills:
  
  
Dell EMC ECS: Object storage administration, erasure coding, geo-distribution, and S3-compatible API integration.
  
  
Tintri Storage: VMstore administration, VM-aware QoS, ReplicateVM, Tintri Global Center (TGC) management.
  
  
**Additional Information**
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to think logically through complex storage problems. Must have the initiative, tenacity, and commitment to see problems through resolution.
  
  
Ability to work shift patterns and provide 24/7 support for critical storage and backup systems.
  
  
Good third-party liaison skills — able to engage effectively with suppliers of storage products, hardware vendors, and cloud service providers.
  
  
The candidate should have a minimum of 7 years of experience in Nasuni cloud storage and AWS cloud-native backup solutions.
  
  
Experience with Nasuni and AWS in production environments supporting large-scale, mission-critical workloads is highly preferred.
  
  
Strong documentation skills — ability to produce architecture diagrams, runbooks, capacity reports, and incident post-mortems.
  
  
A 15-year full-time education (B.E. / B.Tech / MCA or equivalent in Computer Science, IT, or Engineering) is required.

title: Associate Applications Engineer

This role is not limited to application support. It requires a combination of application support, troubleshooting, deployment, infrastructure knowledge, database skills, and basic coding/scripting knowledge. You will work with different technical teams to identify problems, implement solutions, automate repetitive tasks, and continuously improve application reliability.

* Review case backlogs and ensure timely updates and resolution.

* Develop automation where possible to improve application reliability and reduce manual effort.
* Understand application configuration, web applications, and basic software development concepts.

**Documentation and Continuous Improvement**

* Create and maintain SOPs, process documentation, and technical notes for client environments.

* Learn and support Momentive's association management products.

* Basic understanding of backups and recovery processes.
* Basic SQL Server knowledge, including writing and understanding simple SQL queries.
* Basic coding or scripting knowledge and the ability to understand or modify scripts.
* Experience with cloud-hosted applications or cloud environments.
* Experience using ticketing or IT service management systems.
* Knowledge of troubleshooting client environments, applications, servers, and networks.
* Experience supporting clients through phone, email, or ticketing systems.
* Understanding of change management and controlled deployment processes.
* Ability to analyze logs and troubleshoot technical issues systematically.
* Good communication and problem-solving skills.
* Engineering degree, MCA, MCM, or equivalent technical qualification.

**Nice to Have**

* AWS, Azure, or Microsoft certifications.
* PowerShell scripting experience.
* Knowledge of ITIL or Microsoft Operations Framework.
* Experience with change management tools.
* Experience monitoring and maintaining distributed applications or systems.
* Knowledge of security best practices and client data protection.
* Experience setting up websites and web applications.
* Basic understanding of firewalls, networking, DNS, and certificates.
* Experience working with APIs and application integrations.

**How You Work**
You build strong relationships with clients and colleagues and can work effectively both independently and as part of a team. You take ownership of issues, communicate clearly, and focus on delivering reliable solutions.
  
  
You are comfortable working on technical problems, learning new technologies, and going into the details when an issue is complex. You have a client-first mindset and are willing to support a rotational schedule and participate in on-call responsibilities.
  
  
**About Us**
Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com.

title: Cloud Migration Specialist - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced Cloud Migration Specialist to lead and manage the migration of applications, data and infrastructure from legacy or existing platforms to modern cloud environments. You will assess requirements, plan and execute migrations, and help ensure minimal disruption to business operations. Based in Pune, this role requires practical experience with cloud migration methodologies, infrastructure administration, security hardening, automation and advanced technical troubleshooting.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Assess, plan and execute migrations of applications, data and infrastructure to modern cloud platforms
* Perform migrations of virtual machines, databases, applications and data to Microsoft Azure using Azure Migrate, Azure Site Recovery and Azure Database Migration Service
* Collaborate with developers, database administrators, system administrators and other cross-functional stakeholders
* Monitor migrated environments to maintain performance, security, reliability and operational stability
* Troubleshoot migration-related issues, complete root-cause analysis and implement effective resolutions
* Deliver Level 3 infrastructure administration, including installation, configuration, monitoring and maintenance
* Identify, assess and remediate infrastructure vulnerabilities to support security compliance and reduce risk exposure
* Apply operating-system security-hardening practices in accordance with organisational and industry standards
* Use Bash, Python or similar scripting technologies to automate routine activities and support enterprise system automation
* Produce technical documentation and conduct knowledge-transfer sessions to enable ongoing maintenance and support

**Who You Are**

* You have hands-on experience migrating platforms to cloud services or managed-instance environments
* You understand cloud migration methodologies and tools, particularly within Microsoft Azure
* You have experience with infrastructure technologies such as Linux, VMware and vCenter
* You hold a cloud certification relating to Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform
* You possess broad IT knowledge, including service delivery, operations and emerging technologies
* You understand ITIL frameworks and their practical application within IT service management
* You are familiar with relevant compliance and governance requirements, including GDPR
* You apply strong analytical, problem-solving and advanced troubleshooting skills
* You communicate clearly in writing and conversation, build trusted stakeholder relationships and work collaboratively across teams
* You follow through reliably on agreed actions and focus on achieving timely outcomes

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* The opportunity to contribute to end-to-end cloud transformation and modernisation initiatives
* Practical exposure to business-critical migrations involving virtual machines, databases, applications and data
* Collaboration with multidisciplinary technology teams across development, database, systems and infrastructure functions
* Experience supporting secure, reliable and well-governed cloud environments
* Opportunities to apply automation, troubleshooting and infrastructure expertise to complex technical challenges

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced planning and execution techniques for large-scale cloud migrations
* Practical use of Azure Migrate, Azure Site Recovery and Azure Database Migration Service
* Cloud and infrastructure security, including vulnerability remediation and operating-system hardening
* Enterprise automation using scripting technologies such as Bash and Python
* Cross-functional stakeholder collaboration, technical documentation and knowledge transfer
* Operational monitoring and optimisation of migrated cloud environments

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

description:

At Syngenta, our goal is to build the most collaborative and trustworthy team in agriculture, providing top-quality seeds and innovative crop protection solutions that improve farmers' success. To support this mission, Syngenta’s IT & Digital team is seeking a Engineering Lead - Data & Analytics in Pune. This role will support the delivery for leading data and engineering teams within our Data Mesh platform, oversee product delivery, and spearhead the modernization of our AI, BI, and agentic analytics solutions.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role purpose**

* The Data Platform Engineer Manager is responsible for designing, building, operating, and continuously improving enterprise‑scale , Databricks based data mesh platform at Syngenta.
* This role focuses on platform reliability, scalability, security, and enablement of data engineers, analytics, and data science teams , enable domain autonomy to ingest, process, and share data using Databricks, while ensuring security, quality, and interoperability.

**Knowledge, Experience & Capabilities**

* Databricks Ecosystem: Expert-level knowledge of Databricks Lakehouse, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog etc.
* Programming: Proficiency in Python, PySpark, or Scala for ETL/ELT development.
* Cloud Platforms: Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and related data services. AWS Preferable.
* DevOps & Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Familiarity with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.

* Retry and backoff strategies

* Distributed locking
* Eventual consistency
* Saga and distributed transaction patterns
* Rate limiting and throttling
* API gateways
* Configuration and secrets management

The candidate should understand failure scenarios inherent in distributed systems, including
**network partitions, partial failures, duplicate messages, out-of-order processing, race conditions and consistency challenges**
.

**Cloud & Cloud-Agnostic Architecture**

Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform such as
**Azure, AWS or GCP**
, along with the ability to design applications without unnecessary dependency on proprietary cloud services.

The candidate should understand how to build platforms that can operate across:

* Public cloud
* Private cloud
* On-premises environments
* Hybrid environments
* Multi-cloud environments

**Strong understanding of:**

* Containers
* Kubernetes
* Docker
* Kubernetes networking
* Ingress and load balancing
* Persistent storage
* Auto-scaling
* High availability
* Multi-zone deployments
* Disaster recovery
* Infrastructure as Code
* Secrets and certificate management

The architect should be able to evaluate the trade-offs between using
**cloud-native managed services and cloud-agnostic technologies**
.

**Kubernetes & Distributed Deployments**

Strong practical understanding of production Kubernetes environments, including:

* Deployments
* StatefulSets
* DaemonSets
* Services
* Ingress
* ConfigMaps and Secrets
* Persistent Volumes
* Horizontal/Vertical Pod Autoscaling
* Pod disruption and availability
* Resource requests and limits
* Health/readiness/liveness probes
* Kubernetes networking
* Rolling deployments
* Zero/minimal-downtime upgrades
* Cluster and workload troubleshooting

Experience designing applications deployed across
**multiple Kubernetes nodes/clusters/sites**
is highly desirable.

**Messaging & Event-Driven Systems**

Strong experience with technologies such as:

* Apache Kafka
* RabbitMQ or equivalent messaging systems

Must understand:

* Topics and partitions
* Consumer groups
* Ordering guarantees
* Delivery semantics
* Offset management
* Message retries
* Dead-letter handling
* Backpressure
* Idempotent consumers
* Schema evolution
* Message duplication
* Large-scale event processing

**Data Architecture**

Strong understanding of both relational and NoSQL databases.

Experience with technologies such as:

* MySQL / SQL Server
* MongoDB
* Redis
* OpenSearch / Elasticsearch
* Analytical databases such as ClickHouse

Expected knowledge includes:

* Data modelling
* Indexing
* Query optimisation
* Replication
* Sharding/partitioning
* Transactions
* Consistency models
* Distributed caching
* Database scalability
* High availability and disaster recovery

The candidate should be capable of selecting the appropriate data technology based on the workload rather than applying a single database technology to every problem.

**Security Architecture**

Strong understanding of enterprise application security, including:

* OAuth 2.0
* OpenID Connect
* SAML
* JWT
* RBAC
* Authentication and authorization
* API security
* mTLS
* Certificate management
* Secrets management
* Encryption in transit and at rest
* Zero Trust principles
* Secure service-to-service communication
* OWASP security principles

Security must be considered as part of architecture and design rather than as a post-development activity.

**Observability & Production Engineering**

Experience designing production-grade observability covering:

* Structured logging
* Metrics
* Distributed tracing
* Application performance monitoring
* Health monitoring
* Alerting

Experience with technologies such as:

* OpenTelemetry
* Prometheus
* Grafana
* OpenSearch / Elasticsearch
* Jaeger or equivalent platforms

The architect should be capable of diagnosing complex issues spanning multiple services and infrastructure components.

**Performance, Scalability & Reliability**

Responsible for defining and reviewing:

* Performance requirements
* Scalability targets
* Availability targets
* Capacity planning
* Load and stress testing approaches
* Failure and recovery scenarios
* Disaster recovery strategy
* RPO/RTO requirements

Should understand architectural techniques for supporting
**high-throughput and high-concurrency systems**
.

**Engineering Leadership**

* Provide technical leadership to engineering teams.
* Mentor senior developers, technical leads and architects.
* Conduct architecture and design reviews.
* Review critical implementation and code where necessary.
* Establish coding and engineering standards.
* Challenge designs that introduce unnecessary complexity or technical debt.
* Conduct technical root-cause analysis for major production incidents.
* Drive architectural improvements based on production learnings.
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, DevOps, Security and QA teams.

The architect remains
**technically accountable for whether the architecture actually works in production**
.

**DevOps & Delivery**

Strong understanding of:

* CI/CD pipelines
* Git-based development workflows
* Infrastructure as Code
* Automated deployments
* Rolling deployments
* Blue/Green deployments
* Canary deployments
* Automated testing
* Release management
* Environment management

Experience with tools such as
**GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Terraform, Helm or equivalent technologies**
is desirable.

**Programming & Hands-on Technical Capability**

The candidate should have strong software engineering fundamentals and significant development experience in one or more modern languages such as:

* Go
* Node.js / TypeScript
* Python

Although this is an architect position, the candidate must be capable of
**reading, reviewing, debugging and, when necessary, writing production-quality code or proof-of-concept implementations**
.

**Architecture Documentation**

Expected to create and maintain:

* High-Level Designs (HLD)
* Low-Level Designs (LLD)
* Architecture Decision Records (ADR)
* Sequence diagrams
* Component diagrams
* Deployment architecture
* Data-flow diagrams
* API contracts
* Failure-flow documentation

Architecture documents must clearly communicate
**decisions, alternatives considered, trade-offs and rationale**
, rather than merely describing components.

**Required Experience**

  of overall software engineering experience.

We are looking for an experienced
**GCP Data Engineer**
to design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT frameworks on the Google Cloud Platform. The candidate will work extensively with
**BigQuery, Python/PySpark, Airflow/Cloud Composer, and Google Cloud Storage**
to process and transform large volumes of campaign, customer, and clickstream data.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in data engineering, excellent SQL and Python skills, and a good understanding of cloud-based data pipeline architecture. The role will involve building reliable production pipelines, optimizing BigQuery performance and costs, implementing automation, and supporting critical data workflows.

**Data Pipeline Development**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable data pipelines on GCP.
* Build batch and, where required, near-real-time data ingestion and transformation pipelines.
* Develop robust ETL/ELT frameworks for large volumes of structured and semi-structured data.
* Ingest data from multiple sources into Google Cloud Storage and BigQuery.
* Develop reusable and modular data engineering components.
* Implement appropriate error handling, retry mechanisms, logging, and data validation.

**BigQuery & Data Engineering**

* Develop complex and optimized SQL queries in BigQuery for data transformation and analysis.
* Optimize BigQuery performance through:

+ Partitioning
+ Clustering
+ Query optimization
+ Efficient table design
+ Appropriate data types and storage strategies

* Monitor and optimize BigQuery processing costs.
* Design scalable data models suitable for large-scale campaign, customer, and clickstream datasets.
* Troubleshoot data quality, performance, and pipeline-related issues.

**Airflow / Cloud Composer**

* Develop and maintain DAGs using Apache Airflow / Cloud Composer.
* Implement scheduling, dependency management, retries, failure handling, and alerting.
* Monitor production workflows and proactively resolve failed or delayed jobs.
* Build reusable operators and workflow components where required.
* Ensure critical data pipelines meet agreed SLAs.

**Python / PySpark**

* Develop data processing and transformation logic using Python and/or PySpark.
* Write clean, reusable, scalable, and production-ready code.
* Optimize PySpark jobs for performance and efficient resource utilization.
* Implement appropriate testing and validation for data transformation processes.

**GCP Services**
Work extensively with GCP services, particularly:
  
  

* Google BigQuery
* Google Cloud Storage (GCS)
* Cloud Composer / Airflow

Exposure to additional GCP services such as
**Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud Run, Secret Manager, IAM, or Cloud Monitoring**
would be an advantage.

* Automate deployment and execution of data engineering workflows.
* Work with Git-based development and version-control workflows.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins or equivalent.
* Follow code review, branching, deployment, and release-management processes.
* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for production data pipelines.

* Monitor daily data pipeline execution and resolve production issues within defined SLAs.
* Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, performance issues, and processing delays.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent fixes.
* Coordinate with application, analytics, infrastructure, and business teams to resolve data-related issues.
* Participate in production deployments and provide post-deployment support.

* Communicate technical issues, risks, dependencies, and delivery status effectively.

* Strong hands-on experience with GCP.
* Strong proficiency in SQL, preferably extensive experience with BigQuery SQL.

* Experience developing ETL/ELT data pipelines.

title: AI/ML Engineering Lead
description:
***Job Title:***
AI/ML Engineering Lead
***Company**
: Toro Technology Center India*
**Who Are We?**
The Toro Company is a homegrown, Minnesota-based company that has been in business since 1914. We pride ourselves on providing world-class equipment to help maintain the environment that we love, while putting an emphasis on giving back to the communities that surround us. From residential lawns and gardens to Golf Clubs and sports grounds we are a company with a global footprint and a passion for helping people beautify whatever landscape they may be in. With 100+ years of operation under our belt and an average employee tenure of 15 years, come find out what makes The Toro Company the best place to build a career.
  
  
**What Will You Do?**
In order to grow and build a successful career with The Toro Company, you will be responsible for:
  
  
AI/ML Engineer, EIT
  
  

* Design, develop, test, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions for predictive analytics, classification, recommendation, anomaly detection, forecasting, and other business use cases.
* Validate, optimize, and continuously improve models through feature engineering, experimentation, performance analysis, tuning, and evaluation to support production readiness and business outcomes.
* Build Generative AI, RAG, and agentic AI solutions, including conversational assistants, ML models, intelligent search, and multi-step intelligent workflows.
* Develop and optimize models, prompts, embeddings, retrieval strategies, and AI architecture based on accuracy, quality, latency, cost, security, explainability, scalability, and business value.
* Design scalable, secure, and maintainable AI services, APIs, data and feature pipelines, and enterprise application integrations using strong software engineering practices, including source control, code review, automated testing, and technical documentation.
* Implement MLOps and GenAIOps practices, including CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated deployment, rollback, and lifecycle management.
* Establish production monitoring and evaluation to track model performance, data and prediction drift, groundedness, bias, data quality, reliability, safety, usage, cost, and operational health, with appropriate alerting and retraining or remediation workflows.
* Implement Responsible AI, security, and governance controls, including risk assessments, human-in-the-loop oversight, access controls, data protection, traceability, and safeguards against hallucination, prompt injection, and data leakage.
* Troubleshoot production AI solutions, perform root-cause analysis, and continuously improve reliability, scalability, performance, and operational supportability.
* Translate business opportunities into well-defined AI problem statements, success measures, solution designs, and delivery plans, collaborating with Business, Data Science and Engineering, Architecture, Security, Legal, Compliance, and Governance teams to deliver production-ready solutions aligned with enterprise standards.

**What Do You Need?**
To be considered for this role, an individual should meet the following minimal requirements:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Mining, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or another quantitative or technical discipline.
* 6+ years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning, Data Science, AI Engineering, and/or advanced analytics.
* Hands-on experience developing and deploying machine learning solutions, including model development, validation, evaluation, optimization, and production monitoring.
* Experience building Generative AI or agentic AI applications using technologies and patterns such as RAG, vector search, embeddings, tool calling, structured outputs, and AI evaluation frameworks.
* Proficiency in one or more programming and analytical technologies such as Python, R, Spark, Scala, and SQL.
* Strong understanding of supervised and unsupervised machine learning techniques, including neural networks, XGBoost, support vector machines, gradient boosting, random forests, and related algorithms.
* Experience working with both structured and unstructured data, including feature engineering, information retrieval, dimensionality reduction, and feature extraction.
* Demonstrated problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across technical and business teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s or PhD in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Mining, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline.
* Experience with advanced analytics, predictive modeling, machine learning, statistical techniques, and data visualization.
* Advanced proficiency with Python/R, Spark, SQL, MLOps, GenAIOps, and agentic AI workflows.
* Experience designing and operating production Generative AI solutions utilizing RAG, embeddings, vector and semantic search, tool calling, orchestration, structured outputs, and AI evaluation frameworks.
* Experience with Snowflake Cortex, Microsoft Foundry, Azure ML, Azure AI Search, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agents SDK, Databricks, or comparable AI/ML platforms.
* Experience with Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, dbt, Azure DevOps, or comparable enterprise platforms.
* Experience with MLflow or comparable experiment tracking and model registry capabilities, containerization technologies such as Docker/Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code practices.
* Knowledge of enterprise identity and access management, privacy, data governance, model risk management, security, and Responsible AI controls.
* Experience operating production AI/ML solutions with model observability, service-level monitoring, cost controls, incident management, usage telemetry, and continuous performance improvement.

title: Senior Analyst, Data Management, IT
description:
**Job Description**
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale.
  
  
Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams.
  
  
As part of our IT team, your expertise will help Edwards strengthen trusted, governed, and high-quality master data across the enterprise. We are seeking a Senior Analyst, Data Management to support critical master data domains, including Healthcare Professional and Supplier Master, while helping modernize Edwards' Master Data Management capabilities from Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS toward a multi-domain Semarchy MDM platform on Snowflake. This role combines data stewardship, governance, data quality, business analysis, and operational support with direct partnership across global and regional business teams.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**

* Participate in the implementation and expansion of Semarchy MDM as a Snowflake-based, multi-domain enterprise Master Data Management platform.
* Support the onboarding of new master data domains and contribute to migration planning, business validation, testing, and user adoption as domains transition from Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS to the future-state platform.
* Partner with MDM leadership, architects, engineers, data stewards, application teams, and business stakeholders to define scalable master data processes, governance models, stewardship workflows, and platform requirements.
* Support Healthcare Professional and Supplier Master domains operating on Informatica IDMC MDM SaaS, including application enhancements, release validation, testing, and production support.
* Investigate and resolve master data issues, data quality exceptions, match and merge conflicts, hierarchy requests, workflow issues, and data synchronization problems across upstream and downstream applications.
* Engage directly with regional business teams to understand business processes, data challenges, and master data requirements across multiple geographies and time zones.
* Elicit, document, validate, and translate business requirements into scalable data management and MDM solutions that business and technical teams can execute.
* Define, document, and maintain business rules, data standards, critical data elements, data definitions, stewardship procedures, and data quality controls.
* Perform data profiling, analysis, root cause investigation, and remediation activities using SQL, Snowflake, and related data tools.
* Develop and monitor data quality metrics, dashboards, and governance scorecards that improve data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and accountability.
* Create and maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, governance artifacts, test evidence, and user guidance.
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve business processes, data quality, operational efficiency, and the user experience.

**What You Will Need (Required)**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Management, Business, Engineering, or a related field and a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in master data management, data governance, data quality, business analysis, or enterprise data operations.
* Practical experience supporting Master Data Management solutions, data stewardship processes, or governed enterprise data domains.
* Experience eliciting, documenting, and validating business requirements and translating them into functional data or application requirements.
* Experience with data profiling, root cause analysis, issue remediation, business rules, data standards, and data quality controls.
* Working proficiency in SQL and experience analyzing data in Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex data issues across connected systems and processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to facilitate discussions across business and technical teams.
* Ability to work independently under general direction, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively across global time zones.
* Adhere to all company rules and requirements, including Environmental Health & Safety rules, and take adequate control measures to prevent injuries, protect the environment, and prevent pollution under their span of influence or control.

**What Else We Look For (Preferred)**

* Hands-on experience with Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud MDM SaaS, Semarchy MDM, or another enterprise multi-domain MDM platform.
* Experience with Healthcare Professional, Supplier, Customer, Product, or other enterprise master data domains.
* Experience supporting an MDM modernization or migration program, including business validation, testing, cutover readiness, and user adoption.
* Experience with Snowflake-based data solutions and integrations among MDM, source applications, and downstream consumers.
* Experience developing data quality dashboards, governance scorecards, stewardship workflows, or operating procedures.
* Relevant industry experience in medical device, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or another regulated environment.

**Additional Information**

* Develops solutions to a variety of complex data management problems and exercises judgment in selecting methods and techniques after considering business, data quality, governance, and technical implications.
* Works with general direction focused on end results and may provide guidance to less-experienced team members or data stewards.
* Travel may be required up to 5%.

**Benefits And Equal Opportunity**
Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families.

title: Technology and Innovation - Data Engineering Manager
description:
**Data Engineering Manager**
Riveron is seeking a hands-on Data Engineering Manager to be part of our data engineering team in India. This is not a pure people-management role — you will be writing code, building pipelines, and architecting data platforms daily alongside your team. We're looking for someone who leads from the codebase, not just from a conference room. If you bring deep implementation experience across Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks and can pair strong architectural thinking with real delivery output, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* A data engineering professional with 8 to 12 years of experience, including 1-3 years balancing technical leadership with active, hands-on implementation — you've managed teams without stepping away from the keyboard.
* You write production-quality code daily. This role requires active coding and pipeline development — not just code reviews and architectural diagrams.
* Hands-on, implementation-level expertise with Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks is non-negotiable. You've personally built, deployed, and tuned production workloads on these platforms.
* Strong data architecture background spanning lakehouse design, medallion architecture, data vault, dimensional modeling, and enterprise data platform design — grounded in systems you've actually built, not just designed on paper.
* Deep proficiency in SQL and Python — you can write complex transformations, optimize query performance, debug pipeline failures, and build automation frameworks yourself.
* Proven experience building and shipping ETL/ELT frameworks using Azure Data Factory, dbt, Spark, and platform-native orchestration tools.
* Solid working knowledge of Azure cloud data services (Synapse Analytics, Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL Database) and comfort operating in multi-cloud environments.
* Well-versed in data governance, data quality frameworks, cataloging, lineage, and security best practices — with experience implementing these controls, not just defining policies.
* Proficient with Git-based version control, CI/CD pipelines for data workloads, and Infrastructure as Code — you commit code, open pull requests, and maintain deployment pipelines alongside your team.
* Comfortable working in Agile delivery environments and translating business requirements into scalable technical designs.

**What You'll Do**

* Spend a significant portion of your time writing code — building data pipelines, developing transformation logic, configuring platform services, and shipping production-ready solutions.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data engineers while remaining the team's strongest technical contributor and setting the standard through your own code and architectural decisions.
* Design and personally implement scalable data platforms on Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, and Databricks — selecting the right platform for each use case and building the solution end to end.
* Architect and build lakehouse and data warehouse solutions, defining and coding ingestion patterns, transformation layers, storage strategies, and consumption models.
* Own critical and complex implementation work — the toughest pipeline builds, the most challenging performance problems, and the architectural spikes that set direction for the team.
* Write and maintain shared libraries, frameworks, and reusable components that accelerate the team's delivery and enforce engineering standards.
* Conduct deep, line-level code reviews focused on correctness, performance, and maintainability — not just approval stamps.
* Partner with analytics, data science, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into engineered solutions and personally prototype key components.

title: Solution Engineer - Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems
description:
**Description**
At Envalior, we combine over a century of materials expertise with innovation and digital technology to help create sustainable, high-performance solutions for our customers around the world. As our laboratories, manufacturing sites, and quality organizations become increasingly digital, we are looking for a Solution Engineer who can help bridge business processes and technology across Quality, Research & Technology (R&T), and Operational Technology (OT) domains.
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to become a key technology partner for our global laboratory and quality functions, helping ensure that critical systems are reliable, compliant, efficient, and aligned with Envalior's business ambitions.
  
  
**The Role**
As a
**Solution Engineer – Quality, Laboratory & OT Systems**
, you will act as the subject matter expert and trusted advisor for a portfolio of laboratory, quality, and manufacturing applications, with a primary focus on
**Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)**
.
  
  
LIMS applications sit at the heart of Envalior's quality and laboratory operations. They support the management of laboratory samples, testing workflows, quality data, product specifications, and batch release activities across manufacturing and R&D environments. As the system owner and technical lead, you will ensure these platforms continue to deliver business value while supporting operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  
  
You will work closely with Quality, R&T, Operations, Manufacturing, Digital Solutions Delivery, and Technology Services teams worldwide to support existing solutions while identifying opportunities for innovation, automation, and simplification.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Own and Support Critical Laboratory & Quality Systems**

* Serve as the IT System Owner for Envalior's LIMS QA solutions.
* Manage the lifecycle of laboratory and quality applications, including enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and support activities.
* Ensure platforms remain secure, stable, and aligned with evolving business requirements.
* Act as the primary escalation point for complex application and process issues.
* Support business continuity across laboratory and quality operations globally.

**Partner with the Business**

* Develop a deep understanding of Quality, R&T, and Operational Technology processes.
* Collaborate with laboratory managers, quality teams, manufacturing stakeholders, and digital colleagues to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Translate business challenges into scalable digital solutions.
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders and effectively communicate the value of technology-enabled change.

**Drive Innovation and Digital Transformation**

* Propose innovative information solutions by combining existing systems with emerging digital technologies.
* Evaluate opportunities to improve laboratory efficiency, data management, automation, and operational performance.
* Simplify and modernize existing application landscapes.
* Eliminate waste, reduce complexity, and improve user experience through technology and process optimization.

**Enable Reliable Laboratory Operations**

* Support systems used for sample management, laboratory workflows, testing activities, and quality data management.
* Ensure effective system integrations between laboratory, manufacturing, and enterprise platforms.
* Help maintain accurate, timely, and accessible laboratory information across the value chain.
* Support the digital backbone that enables quality decision-making and product release activities.

**Lead Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to strengthen system performance and business processes.
* Promote best practices in application management, information architecture, and digital solutions.
* Support change management initiatives and user adoption activities.
* Drive a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement across supported domains.

**Requirements**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* Experience in application management, solution engineering, business analysis, or related digital roles.
* Experience supporting Quality, Manufacturing, Laboratory, R&T, or Operational Technology environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience working within global and cross-functional organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to lead change and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

**Preferred Technical Expertise -**
**Laboratory & Quality Systems**

* ZhuoMES
* GUSLAB / LABSQ
* Unilab
* Thermo Fisher SampleManager LIMS
* WinLIMS

**OT & Manufacturing Solutions**

* Eschbach Shiftconnector
* AssetWise

**Sustainability & Quality Platforms**

* Credit360
* Other Quality, OT, and R&T SaaS applications

**Additional Capabilities**

* Information architecture (data, process, and application landscape)
* Application lifecycle management
* Systems integration and interfacing
* Change management
* Technical project delivery
* Analytical problem solving
* Operations, Quality, and R&T process knowledge

**What Success Looks Like**
In this role, you will become the trusted digital partner for Envalior's Quality and Laboratory community. You will ensure our LIMS landscape delivers reliable support to laboratories worldwide while helping the business embrace new technologies and more efficient ways of working.
  
  
**You Will Be Successful If You Can**

* Balance technology expertise with business understanding.
* Influence stakeholders through collaboration and credibility.
* Simplify complex challenges into practical solutions.
* Drive operational efficiency through digital innovation.
* Continuously improve the applications and processes that support Envalior's quality and laboratory operations.

**Benefits**
**Competitive Compensation**
Join us at Envalior and enjoy competitive compensation packages, inclusive of a global bonus program and individual performance bonuses, ensuring your hard work is recognized and rewarded.
  
  
**Comprehensive Benefits**
Your well-being matters to us. At Envalior, we provide an array of benefits supporting your financial security, health, and overall well-being. This includes retirement plans, health programs, life insurance, and comprehensive medical care.
  
  
**Work-Life Balance & Flexibility**
Maintain a healthy balance between work and personal life with Envalior's commitment to supporting your schedule.
  
  
**Training & Development Opportunities**
At Envalior, your growth matters. We encourage and invest in your professional and personal development. We support our employees in their growth and personal development through ongoing investment in their knowledge and skills via training, coaching, and mentoring.

title: Infrastructure Engineer

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Databricks Architect - Senior Manager
description:
