And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics – Senior Manager - Databricks Architect**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Senior Data & AI Architect with 13+ years of experience in data engineering and data architecture, strong hands-on expertise in Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.
  
  
This role combines deep technical ownership of enterprise Lakehouse and data platform architecture with hands-on experience building Agentic AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions on Databricks. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing large-scale, production-grade data pipelines, architecting modern AI-driven solutions, and engaging directly with clients on strategic proposals and solution design.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, design, and deliver scalable Data & AI solutions on the Databricks Lakehouse platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, governance, and consumption layers.
* Design and optimize large-scale distributed data processing pipelines using Hadoop, Apache Spark, and PySpark.
* Build reusable, production-grade Python frameworks and pipelines for batch and streaming data engineering workloads.
* Define and implement cloud data architecture on AWS and/or Azure, covering storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring, with native Databricks integration.
* Own end-to-end ETL/ELT design, data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data quality frameworks across the platform.
* Design dimensional data models (star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension tables, SCD) to support analytical and reporting use cases.
* Design and build Agentic AI solutions on Databricks, including LLM integration, tool/function calling, agent workflows, guardrails, and enterprise data integration.
* Architect and implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions using Databricks — document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation.
* Establish and enforce engineering best practices for Git-based version control, code reviews, and CI/CD across development, test, and production environments.
* Lead performance optimization and production deployment of Databricks jobs, workflows, and pipelines at scale.
* Participate in strategic RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals, solution shaping, effort estimation, and architecture presentations.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor in customer workshops, translating business requirements into robust technical architectures.
* Mentor engineering teams on Databricks, Spark, cloud architecture, and modern AI/RAG engineering practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
13+ years of experience in Data Engineering / Data Architecture, with strong hands-on experience across Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.
  
  

* Databricks

+ Strong expertise in Databricks Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, and Unity Catalog.
+ Hands-on experience with Jobs/Workflows, performance optimization, and production deployments.

* Hadoop & Spark

+ Strong knowledge of the Hadoop ecosystem, HDFS, and Hive.
+ Strong hands-on experience with Apache Spark and PySpark for large-scale distributed data processi

* Python

+ Strong proficiency in Python for building scalable, reusable, production-grade data pipelines and frameworks.
+ Cloud
+ Strong experience with AWS and/or Azure, including cloud storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring.
+ Experience integrating Databricks with cloud-native services.

* Data Engineering

+ Expertise in ETL/ELT, batch and streaming processing, data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data quality.
+ Proven ability to design scalable, production-ready pipeline architectures.

* SQL & Data Modelling

+ Strong SQL skills, with experience in dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension models, SCD, and analytical data models.

* Agentic AI

+ Hands-on experience designing and building Agentic AI solutions with Databricks, including LLMs, tool/function calling, agent workflows, guardrails, and enterprise data integration.

* RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

+ Strong experience building RAG solutions using Databricks, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation.

* Git & CI/CD

+ Strong knowledge of Git, branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews.
+ Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment across multiple environments.
+ Experience with Databricks Asset Bundles and/or Terraform is a plus.

* Strategic RFPs & Solutioning

+ Ability to participate in strategic RFP/RFI responses, solution shaping, technical proposals, and effort estimations.
+ Experience delivering architecture presentations and leading customer workshops.

* Client Communication
* Strong client-facing and communication skills, with the ability to understand business requirements, translate them into scalable technical solutions, and clearly communicate architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Prior experience in a consulting, systems integrator, or client-facing delivery role.
* Relevant cloud or Databricks certifications (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer / Solutions Architect, AWS/Azure certifications).
* Exposure to enterprise data governance, MLOps, or LLMOps practices.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai

:

title: Offshore Data Modeler
description:
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Data Modeling & Design
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models for insurance applications and systems (claims, policy, underwriting, billing, reinsurance, etc.).
* Build and maintain enterprise data models aligned with insurance industry standards (e.g., ACORD).
* Define data dictionaries, metadata, and relationships to support data governance and consistency.
* Ensure data models are optimized for both transactional (OLTP) and analytical (OLAP) systems.

Insurance Domain Expertise
  
  

* Translate business requirements from claims, policy administration, underwriting, actuarial, and finance teams into scalable data solutions.
* Support regulatory and compliance reporting requirements (e.g., IRDAI, IFRS, Solvency II).
* Ensure models capture core insurance processes such as claims intake, adjudication, settlement, renewals, endorsements, and cancellations.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Partner with business analysts, data architects, and developers to deliver insurance-specific data solutions.
* Work with data warehouse, ETL, and BI teams to ensure seamless integration of insurance data.
* Collaborate with actuaries, claims specialists, and policy teams to validate data definitions and usage.

Governance & Standards
  
  

* Enforce data governance and quality standards across insurance systems.
* Document business rules, lineage, and data definitions for core insurance entities.
* Conduct impact analysis for changes in insurance processes and data flows.

**Qualifications**
Experience
  
  

* 4+ years of experience as a Data Modeler or Data Architect, preferably in the insurance industry.
* Strong hands-on experience with Erwin Data Modeler (or equivalent data modeling tools).
* Proven expertise in modeling insurance data entities such as Policy, Customer, Premiums, Claims, Payments, Underwriting, Reinsurance, and Agents/Brokers.
* Experience working with data warehouses, data lakes, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

**Skills**

* Strong knowledge of insurance domain data flows and regulatory needs.
* Expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical modeling.
* Proficiency in SQL for data analysis and validation.
* Familiarity with insurance standards (e.g., ACORD, ISO) is a plus.
* Understanding of data governance, metadata management, and lineage tracking.

Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related field.

**Preferred Certifications (not Mandatory)**

* Erwin Data Modeler Certification.
* Insurance certifications (e.g., AINS, CPCU) are highly desirable.
* Data management certifications (e.g., CDMP).

Key Attributes
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and compliance.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced insurance environment with multiple priorities.

title: Data Service Excellence Specialist, IT
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale.
  
  
Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams.
  
  
As part of our IT team, your expertise will help deliver reliable, customer-focused support for Edwards' global Data & Analytics platforms. We are seeking a Data Service Excellence Specialist to provide Level 3 support, access governance, incident resolution, user guidance, and operational coordination across Power BI, Qlik, Snowflake, and related services. This role is a hands-on escalation and resolution point that works directly with business users and partners with deeper platform and engineering specialists when a change to the underlying product or platform is required.
  
  
Shift Time - 3 PM IST to 12 AM IST
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**

* Provide Level 3 functional and technical support for Data & Analytics platforms, including Power BI, Qlik, Snowflake, and related services, resolving complex incidents and requests within the role’s area of expertise.
* Investigate incidents and service requests by gathering evidence, reproducing issues, analyzing business impact, troubleshooting root causes, implementing appropriate resolutions, and documenting outcomes.
* Own access requests and provisioning activities while ensuring alignment with security, governance, compliance, and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Act as the escalation point for front-line and offshore support resources, validating prior troubleshooting, improving escalation quality, and engaging platform engineering or product teams only when deeper code, infrastructure, or design changes are required.
* Monitor, prioritize, and coordinate incident and request workloads through ServiceNow, Jira, and established service management practices, with clear communication through resolution.
* Serve as a liaison among business users, technical teams, and Pune-based or offshore support resources to maintain effective communication and dependable service delivery.
* Coordinate day-to-day operational activities across distributed support resources, including work prioritization, knowledge transfer, onboarding, and readiness for new or changing services.
* Create, maintain, and improve knowledge articles, FAQs, runbooks, support documentation, onboarding materials, and operational procedures.
* Coach support team members on troubleshooting methods, platform knowledge, service standards, and effective customer communication without direct people-management responsibility.
* Analyze recurring incidents and support trends, perform root cause reviews, and recommend or implement improvements that reduce repeat demand and improve the user experience.
* Support training and enablement for analytics users and new support team members across technical and non-technical audiences.

**What You Will Need (Required)**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field and a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in data and analytics support, business systems analysis, application support, or a related role; or a Master's Degree and a minimum of 2 years of related experience.
* Hands-on experience supporting analytics platforms, with Power BI experience required and experience with Qlik, Tableau, Snowflake, or comparable platforms strongly valued.
* Experience resolving escalated application or platform incidents beyond basic intake and routing, including root cause investigation, documented resolution, and effective engagement of engineering teams when needed.
* Familiarity with ITIL service management practices, including Incident, Request, and Problem Management.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret incomplete or conflicting information.
* Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical users and manage multiple priorities independently.
* Strong documentation, organization, time management, stakeholder management, and customer service skills.
* Experience coordinating work, knowledge transfer, and operational readiness across geographically distributed teams.
* Ability to facilitate onboarding, training, and knowledge-sharing activities.
* Adhere to all company rules and requirements, including Environmental Health & Safety rules, and take adequate control measures to prevent injuries, protect the environment, and prevent pollution under their span of influence or control.

**What Else We Look For (Preferred)**

* Experience working in a global or matrixed environment and coordinating offshore or vendor-based support resources.
* Working knowledge of Snowflake roles and permissions and the ability to use simple SQL queries for investigation.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, GitLab, or comparable service management and version control tools.
* Understanding of data governance principles, analytics workflows, and access-control practices.
* Basic SQL or DAX knowledge, including simple queries, measures, or calculated columns.
* Experience developing runbooks, knowledge articles, support metrics, and service improvement plans.

**Additional Information**

* Works independently on Level 3 support activities with general supervision and applies judgment to select the appropriate resolution or escalation path based on technical findings and business impact.
* May provide functional guidance to lower-level or front-line support personnel while partnering with people managers or vendor leadership on formal people-management matters.
* Travel may be required up to 5%.

**Benefits And Equal Opportunity**
Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families.

description:
**About Position:**

We are seeking a highly experienced SQL Server Database Architect to lead the architecture, governance, modernization, and operational excellence of enterprise SQL Server platforms. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in SQL Server architecture, high availability, disaster recovery, performance engineering, database security, and operational resilience.

* **Role: SQL Server Database Architect**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 12 to 17 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**

**What You'll Do:**

* Define current-state, transition-state, and target-state architecture for SQL Server environments across on-premises and cloud platforms.
* Develop reference architectures, engineering standards, design patterns, and decision frameworks for SQL Server platforms.
* Establish standards for clustering, Always On Availability Groups, backup, recovery, monitoring, encryption, and privileged access management.
* Develop lifecycle management, capacity planning, modernization, consolidation, and database migration roadmaps.
* Act as the technical design authority for enterprise database solutions.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, resilience, data governance, and service management standards.
* Drive technical debt reduction and platform modernization initiatives.
* Design and implement High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions aligned to business requirements.
* Lead recovery planning, failover testing, restore validation, and resilience assessments.
* Define standards for indexing strategies, query optimization, workload management, and database performance tuning.
* Establish performance baselines, capacity models, and forecasting processes.
* Lead technical response during critical incidents and major platform outages.
* Drive root-cause analysis and implement long-term engineering improvements.
* Define database security architectures and governance standards.
* Implement controls for authentication, authorization, encryption, auditing, patching, hardening, secrets management, and service accounts.
* Partner with cybersecurity, audit, risk, and compliance teams to address control requirements and audit findings.
* Ensure database platforms comply with relevant regulatory and operational resilience requirements.
* Support data protection, retention, governance, and compliance initiatives across the organization.
* Provide architectural leadership and mentorship to database administrators and engineering teams.
* Review and approve complex implementation plans and solution designs.
* Drive automation initiatives using PowerShell and infrastructure automation tools.
* Evaluate database technologies, vendor solutions, and platform modernization opportunities.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, cloud, and security teams to manage technical dependencies.
* Maintain architecture repositories, service maps, support models, standards, and technical documentation.
* Contribute to strategic technology planning and database platform governance.

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

* 12 to 17 years of experience in Database Administration, Database Engineering, or Database Architecture roles.
* Extensive experience with SQL Server 2016, 2019, and 2022 in large enterprise production environments.
* Proven expertise in designing and implementing Always On Availability Groups and Windows Server Failover Clustering (WSFC).
* Deep understanding of High Availability, Disaster Recovery, Backup, Restore, and Business Continuity strategies.
* Strong experience supporting mission-critical business applications under formal change, incident, problem, and release management frameworks.
* Expertise in database modernization, upgrade, consolidation, and cloud migration programs.
* Advanced T-SQL development, execution-plan analysis, indexing, query optimization, and performance troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of Windows Server administration and supporting infrastructure technologies.
* Experience with Active Directory, Kerberos Authentication, storage systems, networking, virtualization, and monitoring platforms.
* Strong knowledge of SQL Server security architecture, auditing, and compliance requirements.
* Hands-on experience with automation using PowerShell and scripting technologies.
* Experience working with enterprise architecture frameworks and technical governance processes.
* Excellent stakeholder management, leadership, communication, and decision-making skills.

* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications

Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product
  
  
configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.

This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach. It also mentors less-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.

most complex government implementations across the United States
  
  

* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long-term maintainability before go-live

* Confirm and pressure-test customer requirements across both configuration and data,

resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design
  
  

* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and

migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go-live
  
  

* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder

like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision-makers, guiding them through the
  
  
deployment and integration process
  
  

* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross-functional teams to

simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
  
  

* Mentor and coach Associate and mid-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their

configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth
  
  

* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable

tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery
  
  

* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and

channel field feedback into the product roadmap

consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
  
  

* 3+ years of hands-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data

transformation, and reconciliation
  
  

* 2+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data-migration concepts

and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
  
  

* Experience implementing AI-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or

provide technical guidance to less-experienced engineers
  
  

* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on

data and configuration for accuracy
  
  

* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving

customer needs
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field

title: Sr Pharmacovigilance Data Migration Consultant – Oracle Argus Safety
description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
  
  
Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
  
  
**Job Description**
Technical Consultant plays a crucial role in pharmacovigilance, particularly in the context of the Argus Safety System data migrations. The responsibilities of an data migration consultant, as outlined, involve various aspects of data migration, data management, automation, and collaboration with clients and source application data provider teams.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Configure, maintain, and optimize Oracle Argus Safety to support pharmacovigilance operations and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Lead end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects involving migration of safety data from legacy safety systems databases into target safety systems.
* Perform source system assessment, data profiling, gap analysis, and migration impact assessments to define migration strategies and project deliverables.
* Analyze and convert PostgreSQL databases, schemas, tables, views, indexes, sequences, functions, triggers, and stored procedures into Oracle Database/Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB) while ensuring data integrity and optimal performance.
* Design and maintain source-to-target mapping documents, transformation rules, migration specifications, and data conversion documentation.
* Develop SQL and PL/SQL scripts to support data extraction, transformation, loading (ETL), reconciliation, validation, and migration reporting activities.
* Perform data extraction, cleansing, standardization, transformation, and loading activities while ensuring accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
* Execute database schema conversion and optimize migrated database objects for Oracle Database and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
* Conduct comprehensive data validation and reconciliation between source and target systems to verify successful migration of all pharmacovigilance data.
* Support migration of safety entities including Cases, Products, Events, Licenses, Studies, Regulatory Reports, Literature, Users, Workflow Data, Attachments, and Configuration Data.
* Develop and execute migration validation plans, reconciliation reports, exception reports, and post-migration verification activities.
* Participate and support in migration testing activities including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Performance Testing, and Production Validation.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve migration issues related to data quality, database conversion, mapping discrepancies, application configurations, and system integrations.
* Develop and maintain Oracle BI Publisher (BIP) reports and validation reports to support migration verification and operational reporting.
* Collaborate with Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, Business Analysts, Database Administrators, Validation Teams, and Oracle Support throughout migration projects.
* Support system integrations between Oracle Argus Safety and external applications using APIs, web services, and interface technologies.
* Ensure migrated data and system configurations comply with GxP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EMA, ICH E2B(R3), GAMP 5, and organizational validation standards.
* Prepare and maintain migration documentation including Migration Plans, Data Mapping Specifications, Validation Documents, Technical Design Documents, SOPs, and Migration Summary Reports.
* Support Oracle Argus upgrades, cloud migrations, and database modernization initiatives involving Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
* Mentor junior consultants and provide technical guidance on migration methodologies, database conversion techniques, and Oracle Argus best practices.
* Recommend automation opportunities and continuous improvements to enhance migration efficiency, quality, and compliance.

**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES**

* Participate in end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects, including data assessment, profiling, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Strong expertise in PostgreSQL database administration and development.
* Hands-on experience converting PostgreSQL databases to Oracle Database and Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB).
* Experience with PostgreSQL-to-Oracle schema conversion, including tables, indexes, constraints, sequences, views, triggers, stored procedures, and functions.
* Strong SQL and PL/SQL programming skills.
* Experience developing migration scripts, stored procedures, packages, and automation utilities.
* Experience using Oracle SQL Developer Migration Workbench or equivalent schema conversion tools.
* Strong understanding of Oracle Database architecture, Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB), and performance tuning.
* Experience with ETL processes, data transformation, and migration automation.
* Ability to optimize SQL queries and improve migration performance for high-volume datasets.
* Perform end-to-end data assessment, profiling, cleansing, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and migration activities.
* Develop and maintain source-to-target mapping documents and migration specifications.
* Execute complex SQL-based reconciliation and data validation activities.
* Identify and resolve migration defects, mapping inconsistencies, and data quality issues.
* Conduct pre-migration, mock migration, production migration, and post-migration verification.
* Support migration testing including SIT, UAT, Regression Testing, and Production Validation. Page 4 of 4 CONFIDENTIAL ERD-3-01b, Job Description Template, Rev. 13.0, Eff. 02/22/2023
* Perform record-level reconciliation to ensure completeness, consistency, and accuracy of migrated pharmacovigilance data.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree/Masters Degree in IT Stream
* 7+ years of relevant experience in safety IT Systems

**Additional Information**
**OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:**
**Patient Minded**
I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.
  
  
**Client Delight**
I own every client experience and its impact on results.
  
  
**Take Action**
I am empowered and empower others to act now.
  
  
**Grow Talent**
I own my development and invest in the development of others.
  
  
**Win Together**
I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.
  
  
**Communication Matters**
I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.
  
  
**Embrace Diversity**
I create an environment of awareness and respect.
  
  
**Always Innovate**
I am bold and creative in everything I do.

Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. * Exposure to EMR, Elasticsearch, Kinesis, DynamoDB, Athena, WAF, CloudHMS, Direct Connect, Glue, Load balancer
* Expertise in SPARK programming using Scala or Pyspark or Java
* Experience with cloud security architectures – Encryption (Rest & Motion)

**Azure Architect**

* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and a strong understanding of Azure capabilities and limitations with demonstrated experience in end-to-end deployment of MS Azure BI solution(s)
* Experience in migrating physical or virtualized workloads to the cloud.
* Experience in defining highly available, DR solutions in Azure
* Experience in assessing applications for cloud adoption and define Cloud strategy for enterprise
* Experience in using agile methodologies in implementing Azure solutions.
* Hands-on experience with Tools for system management, monitoring, automation, and agile development
* Design and develop robust, scalable solutions for collecting, analyzing large data sets, creating, and maintaining data pipelines, data structures and/or support of highly distributed applications
* Exposure to Microsoft Azure data platform, including Azure Data Factory (ADF),Azure Databricks, Azure Data Flow, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics / erstwhile Azure Data Warehouse (SQLDW), Event Hubs, Stream Analytics, Data Lake Store, Data Lake Analytics, U-SQL, HDInsight, Azure Analysis Services, Azure Purview, Power Apps, Power BI and PowerShell Scripting
* Configure large database solutions in Azure using SQL Server / Azure SQL DWH / Synapse and optimize the existing or new solutions as and when needed for optimum performance.
* Build data lake from multiple data sources with ingestion, data governance and auditing capabilities
* Experience in any of Programming/Scripting languages - Bash, PySpark, Scala, Python, PowerShell, Ruby – would be preferred
* Experience in defining cloud strategy for enterprise for but not limited to migrating physical or virtualized workloads to the cloud.

**GCP Architect**

* Experience in software development, professional services, solution engineering, and technical consulting with expertise in architecting and rolling out new technology and solution initiatives.
* Experience working with recommendation engines, data pipelines, or distributed machine learning and experience with data analytics and data visualization techniques and software.
* Experience in GCP Dataflow, BigQuery, Dataproc, Datalab, Dataprep, Pub/Sub and Genomics
* Experience with core Data Science techniques such as regression, classification or clustering, and experience with deep learning frameworks (such as TensorFlow, Torch, Caffe, Theano, etc).
* Develop a direction to manage the portfolio of to-be solutions in alignment with business outcomes
* Identify problem areas, perform root cause analysis of architectural design and provide relevant solutions to the problem
* Enable delivery teams and act as mentor by providing optimal delivery solutions with automations and frameworks for improved productivity
* Implement proof of concepts to validate cloud concepts, architecture and requirements and environments (such as Apache Beam, Hadoop, Spark, Pig, Hive, MapReduce, Flume).
* Develop a direction to manage the portfolio of to-be solutions in alignment with business outcomes
* Identify problem areas, perform root cause analysis of architectural design and provide relevant solutions to the problem
* Enable delivery teams and act as mentor by providing optimal delivery solutions with automations and frameworks for improved productivity
* Implement proof of concepts to validate cloud concepts, architecture and requirements.
* Knowledge of cloud computing includes virtualization, hosted services, multi-tenant cloud infrastructures, storage systems and content delivery networks.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in Cloud Computing (Public/Private/Hybrid) specifically on Cloud first application development
* Systematic problem-solving approach, coupled with strong communication skills and a sense of ownership and drive.
* Experience maintaining internet facing production-grade applications in virtualized environments in AWS Cloud Platform.
* Experience writing scripts in one or more languages such as Python, UNIX Scripting and/or similar.
* AWS/Azure/GCP Certified Associate or Professional

**Education**
:

Technical Skills

* Data pipeline development: Building scalable, maintainable ETL/ELT workflows (pandas, PySpark, or similar)

title: Sr. Support Engineer, ERP
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD is building a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
  
  
**This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune with 3-4 days of in-office collaboration per week.**
**Job Description**
The Senior Support Engineer, ERP role is a cornerstone within our organization, focused on delivering exceptional technical support for QAD and Progress products. In this role, you will engage directly with customers and partners through various communication platforms, such as CRM, telephone, email and internet-based tools, to address complex technical issues and inquiries related to QAD applications and Progress databases.
  
  
As an ERP Support Engineer, you will be responsible for diagnosing and resolving technical issues, ensuring seamless installations, upgrades, and configurations of QAD products. You will leverage your expertise to perform Progress DBA tasks, including database optimization, backups, and troubleshooting. This role also demands strict adherence to quality standards, processes, and tools established by the company, ensuring consistent delivery of high-quality support.
  
  
Your responsibilities extend to managing highly complex and escalated cases, requiring innovative problem-solving and a deep understanding of QAD and Progress Products. You will play a pivotal role in creating and maintaining detailed documentation of issues and resolutions, which will serve as a foundation for developing training materials and reusable solutions. These resources will be shared globally to empower customers, partners, and internal teams with actionable knowledge.
  
  
Collaboration is a key component of this role, as you will work closely with team leads, peers, and cross-functional teams, including R&D and Product Management, to devise effective solutions and uphold superior support standards. Additionally, you will contribute to team growth by developing and sharing training content, focusing on complex case resolution and technical troubleshooting.
  
  
Given that our support organization operates 24/7, this position demands a flexible approach to scheduling. You will be expected to participate in shift rotations, along with weekend shifts and potential on-call coverage as required. These elements are vital to providing continuous support to our global customer base. Your willingness to adapt to these scheduling requirements is crucial for the role.
  
  
In a structured team environment, you will be encouraged to engage in continuous learning and regular practice of existing product knowledge. This is necessary to stay prepared for any new challenges that might arise. As a Sr. Functional Analyst, you have a unique opportunity to grow professionally while significantly contributing to the success of our clients and the organization
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Technical Support and Troubleshooting:
* Provide comprehensive technical assistance for QAD products, including installations, configurations, upgrades, and administration tasks.
* Analyze and resolve technical issues, applying advanced troubleshooting skills and root cause analysis to deliver effective and timely resolutions.
* Handle complex and escalated cases that require innovative problem-solving, ensuring adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and maintaining high customer satisfaction.
* Perform Progress DBA tasks, including database optimization, backup/restore operations, and monitoring database performance to prevent disruptions.
* Incident Handling:
* Manage incoming support requests through established ticketing systems and communication channels, ensuring accurate categorization and prioritization of issues.
* Escalate unresolved issues appropriately, collaborating with team leads and cross-functional departments to ensure timely resolutions.
* Proactively monitor incidents to identify recurring patterns, applying preventive measures to reduce repeat occurrences.
* Ensure that support incidents are resolved in line with established Service Level Agreements.
* Documentation and Knowledge Sharing:
* Maintain detailed and accurate documentation of all troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and best practices for every case handled.
* Contribute to the organization's knowledge base by documenting verified solutions, technical insights, and reusable resources.
* Develop comprehensive guides and FAQs to support customers, partners, and internal teams, ensuring quick access to relevant information.
* Customer Engagement and Communication:
* Communicate effectively with customers and partners to provide regular updates on issue resolution progress.
* Explain technical concepts in a clear and concise manner, ensuring that both technical and non-technical stakeholders understand the issue and the resolution.
* Foster trust and transparency with customers by maintaining a proactive approach and ensuring their concerns are addressed promptly.
* Collaboration and Teamwork:
* Work closely with team leads, peers, and cross-functional departments, such as R&D and Product Management, to resolve complex issues.
* Engage with engineering teams to facilitate effective knowledge transfer and gain insights into product updates that may impact support processes.
* Actively participate in team meetings to share knowledge, discuss challenges, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Training and Development:
* Assist in developing and delivering training materials and sessions to enhance the skills and technical knowledge of team members.
* Mentor junior team members, providing guidance on complex cases and fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment.
* Stay updated on the latest developments in QAD and Progress products, engaging in continuous learning to improve personal expertise.
* Shift Coverage and Flexibility:
* Participate in shift rotations, weekend shifts, and on-call coverage to provide uninterrupted global support.
* Adapt to varying scheduling requirements to ensure timely assistance for customers in different time zones.
* Any Other Duties as Assigned:
* Fulfill additional responsibilities as needed to support organizational goals and priorities, ensuring alignment with the overall mission of delivering high-quality support.

**Qualifications**

* A Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent experience will be considered.

**Experience**

* 3-4 years of relevant experience in supporting enterprise products, demonstrating expertise in resolving complex technical issues, and delivering exceptional customer-focused solutions.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical skills and a proven ability to manage high-priority cases in a fast-paced, customer-centric environment.
* Hands-on experience in ERP support is highly preferred, including:
* Installing, upgrading, and configuring ERP systems such as QAD, SAP, Oracle ERP, or Dynamics 365.
* Troubleshooting and resolving system-level issues, including performance optimization and configuration challenges.
* Performing advanced troubleshooting and database management tasks, including backups, restores, and optimization of Progress or similar DB environments.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in debugging and troubleshooting Unix, Windows, internet, and network environments.
* Programming knowledge in C, C++, Unix scripting, and Progress for issue resolution.
* Expertise in Progress DBA tasks, including database optimization, backup/restore, and performance monitoring.
* Strong Linux skills and basic SQL knowledge for database queries and troubleshooting.
* Experience with QAD product installation, configuration, and administration.
* QAD PKS or other relevant industry certifications are a plus.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality service.

**Additional Information**

* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set

**About QAD**
QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
  
  
QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
  
  
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

title: Non-Production Application Support Engineer
description:
This is a seasoned technical professional responsible for providing end‑to‑end application support for Citi’s strategic platforms, with a strong focus on Non‑Production environments (DEV / SIT / UAT ) and DevOps-enabled delivery models.

Support applications running on Linux platforms, databases (Oracle, SQL Server, MongoDB), middleware, and web/application servers (Apache/Tomcat on Openshift, WebSphere).

title: Production Support Systems Intern
description:
**About Vcheck**
Vcheck was founded in 2012 on the belief that the investigative rigor of a boutique firm could be brought to scale through technology. Today, we run more than 25,000 investigations a year across six continents, helping financial institutions, private equity firms, and Fortune 500 companies see clearly through complexity and make decisions with confidence. Based in New York, with team members in the US, Canada, Romania, and India, we have earned a place on the Inc. 5000 for five consecutive years and are backed by Sunstone Partners as we enter our next phase of growth.
  
  
We are building something different: a portfolio risk management platform that pairs the rigor of an investigative shop with the efficiency of a modern technology company. Our team brings together talent from tech and SaaS companies with people from compliance, law enforcement, journalism, and many other fields. Whatever path brought each of us here, what unites us is curiosity, attention to detail, and a commitment to getting it right.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Production Support Systems Intern supports the team that keeps our production systems stable and available. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will learn how incidents, monitoring alerts, and escalations are handled in a live environment—starting by observing and following runbooks, and gradually taking on more of the triage yourself. You will get hands-on exposure to our AWS-hosted Python/Django/FastAPI backend and React JS frontend, and learn to track incidents via JIRA Service Management while monitoring system health through Sentry and CloudWatch. This is a paid internship with a monthly stipend and structured mentorship, and it offers a clear path to a full-time Production Support Systems Engineer role.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Monitor Sentry and CloudWatch dashboards for errors and anomalies under the guidance of a senior engineer
* Perform first-level triage of alerts and follow documented runbooks for known issues
* Create and update JIRA Service Management tickets with clear, complete incident details
* Escalate issues to the on-call engineer or Tier 3 with accurate, well-structured summaries
* Prepare shift handoff reports and join the overlap with the wider team
* Read CloudWatch Logs to identify ECS task errors, AWS Batch job failures, and Lambda/API issues
* Assist with restarting failed ECS tasks and retrying Batch jobs, as directed by the senior engineer
* Run start-of-shift and end-of-shift environment health checks and confirm nightly batch jobs have completed
* Learn to tell frontend (React JS) issues from backend API failures using Sentry error traces
* Run basic PostgreSQL/RDS checks and flag slow queries or connection issues to the team
* Verify that nightly backup and data replication jobs completed, and report any failure promptly
* Observe and support scheduled maintenance and deployments, including post-deployment monitoring
* Write simple Python scripts to automate repetitive checks and parse logs
* Document incident summaries, resolution steps, and learnings; help update runbooks and SOPs in the knowledge base

**About You**
****Key requirements:****
We're looking for someone who is passionate about joining a diverse team and is driven to achieve results through ownership, process optimization, and upstanding character. If this describes you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed.
  
  

* We're looking for someone who is curious, eager to learn, and driven to grow through ownership, attention to detail, and upstanding character. No prior production support experience is needed. If this describes you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed.
* Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field
* Foundational understanding of cloud concepts; exposure to AWS (EC2, S3, CloudWatch, RDS) through coursework, projects, or certifications is a plus
* Basic proficiency in Python for scripting and log parsing
* Basic understanding of SQL/PostgreSQL and how web applications and REST APIs work
* Familiarity with Linux command line and Git fundamentals
* Awareness of Docker and containers is a plus; exposure to Django, FastAPI, or React JS is a plus
* Curiosity about monitoring and incident management tools such as Sentry, JIRA, or similar; prior use is a plus
* Calm, methodical, and attentive to detail when things go wrong
* Strong written communication skills for incident notes and shift handoffs
* Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and ask for help or escalate when unsure
* Prior internship, academic project, or hands-on lab experience in IT support, DevOps, or NOC environments is a plus
* AWS Cloud Practitioner or ITIL Foundation certification (or willingness to pursue one) is a plus

****Why us?****
You Will Be Joining a Cutting-edge Company, Where You Will Tackle Complex Challenges And Work With The Very Best In The Industry. In Addition, We Offer
  
  

* Competitive compensation package, including equity
* Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, & vision insurance coverage for you & your loved ones
* 401k plan with a 4% employer match
* Flexible vacation policy, encouraging you to take the time you need
* Annual wellness allowance to support your health and well-being
* Quarterly team events to keep us connected in a hybrid environment
* Playing a vital role in shaping our company's future
* A fun and collaborative work environment where you'll be supported by a team of dedicated and collaborative colleagues

Please be aware that Vcheck uses AI-powered note-taking, interview recording, and transcription tools to ensure accuracy and efficiency during our talent acquisition processes. By participating in the application and interview stages, you acknowledge and consent to the use of these technologies.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, and training.**

title: FinOps Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**
Responsible for defining, building and communicating a shared technical and architectural vision for a Product Team to help ensure the system or solution is fit for its intended purpose.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Defines, explores, and supports the implementation of enablers to evolve solution intent, working directly with Product teams to implement them; Guides enablers through planning and enablement, and work with customers and suppliers to help ensure fitness for purpose. Enables the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and DevOps - advocates for and steers the development and improvement of the Continuous Delivery Pipeline, as well as helps architects to enable Release on Demand. Defines & implement subsystems and their interfaces, allocate responsibilities to subsystems, understands solution deployment, and communicates requirements for interactions with solution context, defines Nonfunctional Requirements (NFRs). Participates in planning, definition, and high-level design of the solution and explore solution alternatives. Works with Product Owners to determine the capacity allocation for enablement work; Participates in Planning, Pre- and Post-PI Planning, System and Solution Reviews, and Inspect and Adapt Events. Delivers solution adhering to standards and leveraging re-use of components; Provides oversight and fosters Built-In Quality and Team and Technical Agility; Adopts new mindsets and habits in how people approach their work while supporting decentralized decision making. Assists in technical analysis of potential solutions including evaluating the technical fit and viability of commercial-of-the-shelf products versus custom built solution. Proactively seeks opportunities to enhance efficiency in the build and deploy processes, promote reusability of component designs to reduce costs and shorten time to deliver solutions by leveraging automation where possible. Create high-level and detail design of infrastructure, interfaces, extensions, and workflows while meeting architecture, security, performance, scalability, and maintainability requirements. Maintain strong relationships to deliver business value using relevant Business Relationship Management practices.
  
  
**Competencies**
Business insight - Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals.
  
  
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.
  
  
Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.
  
  
Agile Architecture - Designs the fundamental organization of a system embodied by its components, their relationships to each other and to the environment to guide its emergent design and evolution.
  
  
Agile Systems Thinking - Embraces a holistic approach to analysis that focuses on the way that a system's constituent parts interrelate and how systems work over time and within the context of larger systems to ensure the economic success of the solution.
  
  
Business Architecture Design - Defines and creates business capability maps using standards, templates, tools and methodologies to provide a common understanding of key capabilities aligned to strategic objectives and tactical demands.
  
  
Continuous Delivery Pipeline - Implements the workflows, activities, and automation by providing the enterprise with the capability to shepherd a new piece of functionality all the way from ideation to an on-demand release of value to the end user.
  
  
Lean Agile and SAFe Mindset - Advocates for and leads others in the concepts of the Agile Manifesto and Lean thinking in support of adopting and applying the 9 SAFe principles and practices for the organization.
  
  
Regulatory Risk Compliance Management - Evaluates the design and effectiveness of controls against established industry frameworks and regulations to assess adherence with legal/regulatory requirements.
  
  
Release Planning - Plans and manages the release of capabilities, features or products using inputs from the prioritized roadmap, planning, available resources and skills to communicate expected availability and releases of capability.
  
  
System Solution Architecture - Creates solution designs and patterns using the Cummins Technical Reference Model (CTRM), CLEAN standards, and existing reference patterns to maintain alignment to Cummins standards.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
**Education, Licenses, Certifications**
College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Business or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
Google, AWS, Azure, Oracle, Docker, Kubernetes, Puppet, CompTIA, and other Cloud Development Certifications are preferred.
  
  
**Experience**
5+ years of relevant experience required. Experience in IT utilizing a broad knowledge base in fundamental IT skills, modern development and deployment practices, DevSecOps tooling and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) knowledge preferred. Hands on experience as an IT Architect preferred.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**FinOps Platform Engineer**

**5+ years of experience**
in cloud financial operations, this role supports end-to-end FinOps delivery—spanning budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation, optimization strategies, and data-driven decision support. **Role Overview:**

**Requirements**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end SAP Data Migration workstream.
* Facilitate workshops on Data migration requirements and align with client data requirements.
* Define and implement the Data Migration Strategy, Data Quality Strategy, and Migration Approach.
* Analyse legacy HR and Payroll data and map it to SAP SuccessFactors target objects.
* Define migration objects, transformation rules, validation criteria, and reconciliation processes.
* Manage data profiling, cleansing, enrichment, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Coordinate business users for data collection, validation, and sign-off. Coordinate with integration teams to validate migrated data across downstream and upstream systems.
* Plan and execute mock migrations, dress rehearsals, production migration, and cutover.

Strong experience with:
**Preferred Experience:**

* SAP Migration Cockpit
* SAP Data Services (BODS)
* SAP LSMW
* SQL
* ETL tools

* Strong knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, and Cutover Planning.
* Experience in Data validation and reconciliation techniques, Audit and Compliance controls. Familiar with GDPR and Data privacy regulations
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

Previous experience delivering SAP SuccessFactors migration or implementation programmes is highly preferred.
  
  
Experience with SAP Employee Central, Employee Central Payroll, and SAP S/4HANA migration projects.
  
  
Experience working in Agile and SAP Activate delivery environments.

title: Oracle Cloud Infra Admin-Oracle and SQL Database Administrator-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – EBS DBA / OCI Senior Position**
Over the last decade, enterprise application modernization and cloud adoption have become critical to ensuring scalability, availability, and cost optimization for global organizations. To support this fast paced and evolving digital landscape, EY leverages Oracle E Business Suite (EBS) expertise combined with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and automation driven database practices to deliver secure, high performance, and resilient solutions for mission critical business applications.
  
  
As part of our global EY GDS team, you will work as a Senior EBS DBA / OCI professional, supporting large scale Oracle EBS environments across on premises and cloud deployments. You will be involved in solving complex technical challenges, including EBS migrations to OCI, database upgrades, high availability design, and performance optimization, while contributing to the development of next generation EBS and OCI platforms in a collaborative, international delivery environment.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are offering you a demanding role. You will use your advanced expertise in Oracle Database, SQL Database and Cloud Infrastructure OCI/Azure to deliver secure, scalable, and high availability solutions for mission critical enterprise applications. This position provides the opportunity to collaborate with global stakeholders and supporting large scale cloud migration, database modernization, and operational excellence initiatives.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Overseeing Oracle EBS database administration and OCI implementation, and identifying opportunities for performance, scalability, and availability improvements.
* Accountable for ensuring database standards, cloud architecture guidelines, and operational processes are followed across on premise and OCI environments.
* Act as the first level technical escalation point for EBS database and OCI related issues for mission critical systems.
* Perform and support end to end database and application migrations from on premises environments to OCI, guiding teams through design, execution, and stabilization.
* Responsible for technical decision making, solution design, environment optimization, and supporting implementation activities for EBS and Oracle database workloads.
* Accountable for collaborating with Cloud Infrastructure teams, supporting instance provisioning, virtual network design, routing rules, security configurations, and database deployments.

**Strong understanding of:**

* Oracle Database upgrades (9i/10g/11g to 12c/18c/19c)
* SQL Server DBA experience (SQL Server 2008–2019/2022)
* OCI networking, security, and database services
* Production support and cross platform migrations on Cloud

**Execute end to end database migrations, including:**

* Virtual network design
* Routing rules
* Security configuration
* Compute instance creation
* Database deployment and configuration
* Responsible for ensuring database configurations, operational guidelines, and technical documentation are maintained and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Support database upgrades, patching, maintenance, and performance tuning for Oracle databases (12c, 18c, 19c) running on on prem and OCI platforms.
* Work with additional database technologies such as MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
* Perform gap analysis against best practices and recommend improvements related to database performance, availability, security, and cloud architecture.
* Identify at risk environments or migration challenges and work with relevant teams to mitigate risks proactively.
* Perform technical reviews and identify corrective actions to improve database reliability and operational efficiency

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team-player and self-started attitude.
* Ability to create documentation for Technical Proof of concept (POC).
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 2-6 years of relevant experience in architecting, designing, implementing, and/or supporting highly distributed applications.
* Extensive experience working on at least one Public Cloud – Oracle/Azure/Google. Oracle Cloud is preferred .
* BTech / MTech / MCA / MBA
* Technical lead for engagements such as Proof of Concepts and Architectural Design Sessions to define and design a complete solution using best practices on Oracle Cloud
* System administration experience (Linux, Solaris)

**Additionally, Good To Have**

* Certificated in Public Cloud – Oracle/AWS/Azure/Google Cloud Certified Architect Professional
* Technical – Experience in Designing, Developing, Deploying and/or Migrating mission critical business applications to Cloud environments including re-platform of such systems
* Expertise in architecting best technical solutions based on customer requirement
* Experience giving presentations to executive audiences and explaining the benefits of the platform and service solution over competitors

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Possesses good communication skills to coordinate, resolve queries of both external and internal customers
* Self-motivator and result oriented to complete task as per timelines
* Must have good analytical and problem-solving skills
* Good written/Verbal Communication, Presentation, Interactive skills with team across geography.
* Flexible to work either independently or work in tandem with Cloud Infrastructure team to identify and implement the most efficient cloud-based solutions for the company.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1000+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Oracle and Enterprise Applications practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a Data Platform Engineer with 3-6 years of experience to support the design, operation, and improvement of a modern data platform. You will work with Snowflake and related data engineering tools to enable high-quality, secure, and well-governed data consumption for analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders. This is a hands-on role focused on reliability, access patterns, and platform enablement.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, and operate a secure and scalable data platform in Snowflake.
* Support governed data consumption by implementing reliable structures, access patterns, and platform controls.
* Collaborate with data consumers to understand needs and remove friction in how they access and use data.
* Develop and maintain data pipelines, transformations, and supporting workflows for analytics use cases.
* Implement secure access patterns for humans, applications, and AI-driven tools.
* Monitor platform health, troubleshoot issues, and improve performance, stability, and usability.
* Support the Posit (RStudio) platform used by data scientists and advanced analysts.
* Document platform processes, data workflows, and operational standards.
* Work closely with analytics, engineering, and business teams to support data quality and platform adoption.

How You Will Do It
  
  

* Own the outcome with accountability by delivering reliable, secure, and well-controlled platform services.
* Stay close to the work by understanding how analysts, data scientists, and business teams actually use the platform.
* Look for root causes, improve the platform continuously, and address issues with candor and practical problem-solving.
* Work as one team by partnering across technical and business groups, sharing context, and building trust.
* Balance speed and control so the platform remains useful, safe, and maintainable as demand grows.
* Use clear documentation and disciplined operating practices to support consistency and handoffs.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3-6 years of experience in data engineering, data platform engineering, or a closely related role.
* Hands-on experience with Snowflake and modern cloud data platform concepts.
* Strong SQL skills for data manipulation, validation, and troubleshooting.
* Experience building or supporting data pipelines, transformations, or analytics data models.
* Working knowledge of data governance, secure access, and data quality practices.
* Experience collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with Posit (RStudio), Python, or other analytics development environments.
* Exposure to Azure Data Factory, Fivetran, Snowpark, dbt, or Airflow.
* Experience supporting workforce analytics or other business intelligence environments.
* Familiarity with CI/CD practices, Git, or Azure DevOps.
* Exposure to secure access patterns for application, service, or AI-based data consumption.

description:
**Our Purpose**

****Title And Summary****
Lead Platform Engineer
  
  
Lead Platform Engineer (Database, Cloud & DevOps)
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in over 200 countries and territories worldwide. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible.
  
  
The Database & Platform Engineering team is responsible for building and operating secure, scalable, highly available, and automated database platforms that support Mastercard's mission-critical payment systems. We are seeking a Lead Platform Engineer to drive the engineering, automation, reliability, and operational excellence of Oracle and PostgreSQL platforms across on-premises and AWS cloud environments.
  
  
This role combines deep database expertise, cloud engineering, DevOps automation, and technical leadership to deliver resilient platforms that enable Mastercard's next generation of payment solutions.
  
  
Role
  
  
**As a Lead Platform Engineer, You Will:**
Lead the design, build, automation, and support of Oracle and PostgreSQL database platforms.
  
  
Engineer highly available and resilient solutions using Oracle RAC, Data Guard, GoldenGate, PostgreSQL Replication, and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL.
  
  
Drive AWS cloud adoption and modernization initiatives across database and infrastructure platforms.
  
  
Develop Infrastructure-as-Code and automation solutions to improve provisioning, deployment, patching, monitoring, and recovery processes.
  
  
Implement and enhance CI/CD pipelines to accelerate delivery while maintaining security and compliance.
  
  
Partner with Software Engineering, SRE, Security, and Product teams to deliver reliable and scalable services.
  
  
Lead performance optimization, capacity planning, observability, disaster recovery, and operational excellence initiatives.
  
  
Provide technical leadership during major incidents, root cause analysis, and platform improvement activities.
  
  
Mentor engineers and champion engineering best practices, automation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**All About You**
Extensive hands-on experience with Oracle Database administration and engineering, including RAC, ASM, RMAN, Data Guard, and GoldenGate.
  
  
Strong expertise in PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, including performance tuning, replication, backup, recovery, and high availability.
  
  
Experience designing and supporting large-scale production platforms in AWS, including Aurora, RDS, EC2, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and S3.
  
  
Strong DevOps and automation experience using Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or similar technologies.
  
  
Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Shell, Bash, or PowerShell.
  
  
Experience implementing monitoring and observability solutions such as OEM, Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Splunk, or CloudWatch.
  
  
Strong understanding of database security, operational resilience, disaster recovery, and compliance requirements.
  
  
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on technical execution in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience within financial services, payments, or other high-volume transaction processing environments.
  
  
Knowledge of Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, and cloud-native platform technologies.
  
  
Experience with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices and platform modernization initiatives.
  
  
AWS, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or related cloud certifications.
  
  
**Experience Driving Automation, Self-service Platforms, And AI-assisted Operational Capabilities.**

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Come With An Inherent Risk To The Organization. Every Person Working For Or On Behalf Of Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:

This position offers the opportunity to shape the future of Mastercard's database and cloud platforms while driving innovation, automation, and operational excellence at global scale.
