Who you are
  
  

* You have 6-8 years of Telecom IT, BSS or enterprise application-operations experience, including at least 4 years of hands-on production support involving Oracle WebLogic and Order Management or OSM platforms
* You have practical expertise in Oracle WebLogic Server administration and production support, including domains, clusters, managed servers, Node Manager, JVM, JDBC, JMS, threads and heap analysis
* You understand Telecom Order Management or Oracle OSM operations, including COM/SOM/TOM concepts, order orchestration, order states, fallout and recovery
* You understand order capture, decomposition, fulfilment, provisioning and service activation
* You have experience troubleshooting WebLogic and application logs, performance issues and production incidents
* You are proficient in Oracle SQL/PLSQL for operational analysis, reconciliation and controlled data validation
* You have Unix/Linux, Shell scripting and preferably WLST experience
* You can troubleshoot integrations across CRM, OMS/OSM, SOA/OSB/AIA, UIM, ASAP and downstream provisioning platforms
* You understand REST/SOAP services, XML/XQuery, queues, adapters and message-based interfaces
* You have hands-on experience with observability platforms such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Splunk, Kibana, Grafana or Zabbix
* You understand Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change and Service Request management, alongside ITIL practices and SLA/KPI management
* You have contributed to automation, observability or continual-improvement initiatives
* You can communicate clearly when coordinating technical activities, service restoration and operational governance
* Practical exposure to AIOps, anomaly detection, intelligent alert correlation, AI-assisted RCA or incident summarisation is beneficial
* ITIL Foundation certification and exposure to Oracle SOA/OSB/AIA, Oracle OSM, UIM, ASAP and SRE practices are preferred
* Experience supporting high-availability telecom order-fulfilment services is advantageous

Not a Perfect Fit?
  
  
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**

* The opportunity to work hands-on with business-critical, high-availability telecom Order Management services
* Exposure to complex customer-order journeys spanning CRM, middleware, Order Management, provisioning and activation platforms
* Opportunities to contribute to SRE-based reliability improvements, observability and operational automation
* Practical involvement in approved AI/AIOps use cases, including anomaly detection, incident summarisation, probable-cause analysis and order-fallout classification
* The opportunity to influence measurable improvements in service availability, MTTD, MTTR, order fulfilment and operational efficiency

**What Skills You Will Learn**
Building on your existing production-support expertise, the role provides opportunities to further develop:
  
  

* Advanced WebLogic and Telecom Order Management troubleshooting
* End-to-end analysis of integrated telecom order-fulfilment journeys
* Observability, event correlation and proactive service monitoring
* WLST, Shell and SQL/PLSQL-based operations automation
* SRE and continual service-improvement practices
* Responsible application of AI/AIOps within production operations
* Cross-functional incident coordination, RCA and service-governance capabilities

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can be truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

description:

As we continue to embed AI into how we work, we do so thoughtfully, enhancing human potential, supporting better decision-making, and prioritizing appropriate oversight, privacy, and fairness.
  
  
At Assent, we value your privacy and are committed to maintaining transparency in how we handle your personal information. As part of our talent acquisition and management processes, we may use AI technologies to support activities such as resume screening, candidate communication, and talent analytics.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
The Senior Cloud Operations Specialist is a senior technical owner for the stability, security, governance, and resilience of Assent's enterprise AWS environment and SaaS production systems. The role combines hands-on cloud operations with solution architecture, technical leadership, and sound risk-based decision making across a large multi-account AWS estate.
  
  
Working within the SaaS Product Infrastructure group, this individual partners with Engineering, Product, Corporate Security, and IT to design and operate secure, highly available cloud services. The successful candidate works independently at a high level, turns business and technical requirements into practical solutions, and constructively challenges decisions that introduce unnecessary risk, operational burden, or architectural debt.
  
  
This role follows a strict code-first and least-privilege operating model. Infrastructure changes are codified, peer-reviewed, and delivered through approved pipelines. Privileged access is exceptional, time-bound, auditable, and used only when required.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Architecture Technical Leadership and Decision Making**

* Lead the design and delivery of secure, scalable, resilient, and supportable AWS solutions from initial requirements through production operation.
* Translate business, security, compliance, and operational requirements into architecture decisions, implementation plans, and reusable platform patterns.
* Evaluate technical options and make clear, risk-based recommendations that balance security, reliability, maintainability, delivery speed, and cost.
* Question assumptions and respectfully challenge designs or delivery approaches that conflict with enterprise standards, least-privilege principles, reliability objectives, or long-term platform health.
* Participate in architecture and design reviews, document key decisions and tradeoffs, and ensure operational readiness before production adoption.
* Act as a senior technical escalation point, lead complex infrastructure initiatives, and coach team members through design and operational decisions.

**AWS Platform Governance Identity and Privileged Access**

* Own and continuously improve Assent's AWS multi-account environment using AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, organizational units, account lifecycle controls, guardrails, and Service Control Policies.
* Architect and operate AWS IAM Identity Center, IAM roles and policies, permission sets, trust relationships, permission boundaries, federation, and cross-account access patterns.
* Apply least privilege by default. Ensure elevated access is approved, time-bound where supported, protected by strong authentication, logged, regularly reviewed, and separated from day-to-day identities.
* Maintain controlled break-glass access and prevent shared credentials, unmanaged access paths, unnecessary standing privilege, and unreviewed administrative changes.
* Lead account provisioning, compliance assessments, access reviews, drift detection, and remediation across the AWS organization.
* Partner with Corporate Security on identity governance, audit readiness, cloud control design, and the implementation of enterprise security requirements.

**Enterprise AWS Networking**

* Design, operate, and troubleshoot enterprise AWS network architectures across accounts and regions, including VPCs, subnets, route tables, security groups, network ACLs, and shared network services.
* Own connectivity and traffic-flow patterns using services such as Transit Gateway, VPC peering, PrivateLink, VPN, Direct Connect, Route 53, Elastic Load Balancing, API Gateway, and CloudFront.
* Design secure ingress, egress, segmentation, DNS, and service-to-service connectivity patterns using AWS Network Firewall, AWS WAF, VPC endpoints, flow logs, and centralized inspection where appropriate.
* Diagnose complex routing, name resolution, load-balancing, firewall, latency, and cross-account connectivity issues and drive permanent corrective action.
* Maintain current network diagrams, traffic-flow documentation, connectivity standards, and recovery procedures.

**Infrastructure as Code Automation and Delivery**

* Provision and govern AWS platform resources through Terraform using reusable modules, secure remote state, controlled workspaces, and maintainable multi-account patterns.
* Use GitHub Actions as the primary delivery mechanism for infrastructure and governance changes, with peer review, validation, security checks, approvals, and traceable deployment records.
* Uphold a no unmanaged changes standard. Use AWS console access only for approved operational needs, and codify or reconcile any necessary emergency change promptly.
* Build automation with Python, PowerShell, Bash, Lambda, Ansible, Semaphore, or similar tools to reduce manual effort, enforce consistency, and improve recovery time.
* Review infrastructure code and automation for security, reliability, maintainability, and alignment with enterprise standards.

**Cloud Operations Reliability and Incident Response**

* Operate and improve core AWS services across compute, containers, databases, storage, messaging, DNS, content delivery, security, and monitoring.
* Install, configure, secure, patch, and troubleshoot Linux and Windows workloads in cloud environments.
* Establish effective monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and automated remediation using CloudWatch, OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, New Relic, PagerDuty, or comparable platforms.
* Lead or support high-severity incident response, communicate clearly under pressure, restore service safely, and coordinate across technical and business teams.
* Conduct root-cause analysis and ensure corrective actions address underlying technical and process failures rather than only immediate symptoms.
* Participate in the on-call rotation and planned off-hours work required to support production infrastructure.

**Security Compliance Resilience and Operational Ownership**

* Maintain enterprise standards for encryption, key management, audit logging, configuration compliance, vulnerability remediation, and evidence collection using services such as KMS, CloudTrail, and AWS Config.
* Support internal and external audits and provide clear evidence of cloud controls, access governance, and operational processes.
* Design, implement, and test backup, business continuity, disaster recovery, and multi-region resilience capabilities.
* Create and maintain accurate documentation for cloud architecture, governance controls, operational procedures, automation workflows, and support handoffs.
* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned platforms and initiatives, surface risks early, and follow decisions through implementation and operational acceptance.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Requirements**

* 7 or more years of relevant experience in cloud operations, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or systems administration, including substantial hands-on responsibility for enterprise AWS environments.
* Proven long-term ownership of a multi-account AWS organization using AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, and AWS IAM Identity Center.
* Deep experience with enterprise AWS governance, including organizational design, account provisioning, Service Control Policies, guardrails, configuration compliance, and drift remediation.
* Advanced knowledge of AWS identity and access management, including least privilege, privileged-access controls, federation, cross-account access, permission sets, IAM policies and roles, and emergency access practices.
* Strong AWS networking experience, including multi-account and multi-region network design, routing, DNS, load balancing, private connectivity, segmentation, and network security controls.
* Strong Terraform experience, including reusable modules, multi-account deployment patterns, secure remote state in Amazon S3, code review, testing, and lifecycle management.
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining GitHub Actions pipelines for infrastructure deployment, policy enforcement, and operational automation.
* Demonstrated ability to architect solutions and carry them through implementation, validation, documentation, and production support.
* Sound judgment in ambiguous or high-pressure situations, with the confidence to challenge proposals, explain risk clearly, and make defensible technical decisions.
* Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Working knowledge of Linux and Windows administration in production cloud environments.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, security stakeholders, leadership, and vendors.
* Ability to work independently as part of a globally distributed team and to participate in on-call and planned off-hours work.
* University degree, college diploma, or equivalent practical experience.
* AWS certification at the Associate level or higher, or equivalent demonstrated enterprise AWS expertise.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Account Factory for Terraform or Customizations for AWS Control Tower.
* AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Advanced Networking Specialty, or Security Specialty certification.
* Experience with ECS or Fargate, EC2, RDS for PostgreSQL or SQL Server, S3, SQS, SNS, SES, Amazon MQ, API Gateway, CloudFront, and Route 53.
* Experience with enterprise configuration management and automation using Ansible, Semaphore, or comparable tooling.
* Experience with OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, New Relic, PagerDuty, Datadog, SolarWinds DPA, or comparable observability and performance platforms
* Familiarity with Auth0 or other enterprise identity providers.
* Experience designing and testing disaster recovery across AWS accounts and regions.
* Experience in enterprise SaaS, regulated industries, or high-security cloud environments.

**Additional Information**
**Life at Assent**

title: Data, Graph & ML Platform Engineer with Freight MNC - Remote
description:
Looking for A data engineer who models data as carefully as they run infrastructure, has dealt with revisions and point-in-time correctness in real pipelines, and has operated a graph database in production.

Responsibilities

● Data landing: connector framework with data contracts, delivery ledger, validation and quarantine; connectors for licensed vendor files and open sources; every record stamped with its three clocks (period, knowledge time, question time).

● Point-in-time store on object storage (Delta Lake): append-only revisions and vintages, an as-of read path that cannot return later-published information, staleness caps, lineage.

● Reference and identity layer: airports, lanes, corridors, regions, index hierarchy; identity resolution across sources with validity windows (Splink or rule-based).

● Graph layer (owner): generate the property-graph schema from the ontology (schema-as-code, LinkML); deterministic projections per as-of date; load and operate Neo4j (Aura) with a read-only product projection; write graph features back into the feature store as as-of columns; enforce that no licensed raw value or forecast leaks into the graph; keep the rebuild to one command and the GPU/graph-ML path open.

● Platform: Terraform on Google Cloud (or Azure/AWS), container jobs, Postgres with row-level security, orchestration with as-of partitions (Dagster or comparable), MLflow, CI/CD gates, observability, secrets, backups, cost control; keep the repository agent-ready (dev container, fixtures, contract tests, leak scans).

Must have

● Strong Python and SQL; DuckDB/Polars/Pandas; larger data pipelines with data contracts, schema evolution and data-quality checks.

● Point-in-time data correctness: as-of reads, publication lags, vintages and revisions, reproducibility.

● Production experience with Neo4j and Cypher: property-graph data modelling, loading at scale, query performance, operating a managed instance; understands the graph as a projection of tabular truth, not a system of record.

● Docker, GitHub Actions, Terraform, one major cloud (GCP preferred), PostgreSQL, Parquet/Delta Lake, Dagster/Airflow, MLflow, logging and monitoring.

● Can turn "build a new macro-data connector" into a controlled agent workflow: spec → connector → fixtures → contract tests → data quality → CI → documentation → pull request.

title: Data & Integration Analyst
description:
****Overview****

We need a data enthusiast who pairs sharp analytical capabilities with the leverage of modern AI tools. As our organization harmonizes multiple disparate systems, data sources, and analytics platforms into a single operational home, this role will lead and orchestrate the collection, cohesion, and maintenance of our core data models (unified accounts, contacts, candidates, deals, activity, and work records).

You will design and oversee the foundational data layer that allows future AI agents to read seamlessly across all entity data without an integration tax, setting the groundwork for our incoming ERP consolidation.

****What You Own****

* ****Canonical Data Model:****

  Define entity structures, relationships, and identity-resolution logic across accounts, contacts, candidates, deals, projects, and work records.
* ****Validation at Ingest:****

  Establish upfront validation rules that prevent low-quality records from entering systems, shifting focus from post-hoc error reporting to preventative data hygiene.
* ****Integration Layer Coordination:****

  Collaborate with full-stack engineers to maintain an adaptable integration layer, ensuring vendor replacements require simple configuration rather than a full code rewrite.
* ****Reporting & Dashboards Foundation:****

  Build and govern the modeled semantic layer beneath our Power BI transition, unifying legacy reports and setting up actionable dashboards for the future ERP.
* ****Agent Data Access:****

  Architect clean, permissioned, and documented read paths so internal AI agents consume structured data directly rather than scraping front-end source systems.
* ****Data Quality Ownership:****

  Serve as the direct point of contact and owner for recurring systemic data defects.
* ****Migration Strategy:****

  Lead data migration paths off retired legacy systems while preserving historical continuity and audit trails.
* ****Lean AI & Continuous Improvement:****

  Apply Lean principles and AI tools to reduce data failure points, detect early warning indicators, and define KPIs/SLAs to optimize organizational performance.
* ****Unstructured Data Insights:****

  Monitor, analyze, and process speech, text, and sentiment analysis inputs across business channels.

****Requirements****

* ****4+ years****

  of hands-on experience in data and analytics, featuring heavy data-modeling responsibilities.
* Proven track record of designing a canonical data model across multiple source systems, with the ability to articulate trade-offs in identity resolution and deduplication.
* Deep knowledge of
  ****PostgreSQL****

  (schema design, normalization trade-offs, database migrations, query performance tuning).
* ****SQL proficiency****

  for data exploration, auditing, reconciliation, and cross-database validation.
* ****Python expertise****

  for developing transformation scripts and data pipelines.
* Demonstrated experience building and supporting integrations with commercial SaaS APIs (handling rate limits, unexpected schema updates, and partial failures).
* Strong understanding of data-layer security, designing models where authorization and field-level restrictions are enforced structurally.
* Proactive adoption of AI tools to accelerate pipeline creation, audit data quality, and enrich datasets.
* Inherent curiosity and rigor for inspecting, validating, and establishing trust in business metrics.

****Strong Preferences****

* Direct familiarity with core enterprise data models across
  ****ERP, HRIS, WFM, or CRM platforms****

  (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Genesys, Oracle, or Aspect).
* Experience using tools like
  ****dbt****

  (or comparable transformation and automated testing frameworks).
* Hands-on experience working with
  ****Tableau, Power BI****

  , or similar analytics stacks, specifically using AI to extract insight from structured datasets.
* Practical experience consolidating legacy commercial systems onto unified or in-house platforms.
* Exposure to recruitment, workforce, or operations data, including handling
  ****candidate PII and data retention****

  requirements.
* Prior experience preparing database schemas or data warehouse layers specifically to feed LLMs, AI workflows, or autonomous agent routines.

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.
  
  
Couchbase Engineer - Assistant Vice President
  
  
A
**Couchbase Engineer**
is a specialized database professional responsible for designing, deploying, managing, and optimizing Couchbase Server clusters. Couchbase is a distributed, high-performance NoSQL document database that combines a flexible JSON model with a powerful SQL-like query language (N1QL) and an integrated caching layer.
  
  
To be successful, a Couchbase Engineer must possess a blend of core database administration (DBA) skills, NoSQL data modeling expertise, system performance tuning capabilities, and modern DevOps/automation skills.
  
  

* Core Couchbase Administration & Architecture
* Multi-Dimensional Scaling (MDS): Ability to design and configure clusters where specific services (Data, Query, Index, Search, Eventing, Analytics, Backup) are assigned to dedicated nodes to optimize resource utilization and prevent resource contention.
* Cross-Datacenter Replication (XDCR): Expertise in setting up, monitoring, and troubleshooting high-performance, low-latency replication across geographically distributed clusters (active-active or active-passive) for disaster recovery and localized data access.
* Cluster Operations: Proficiency in node initialization, joining nodes to existing clusters, rebalancing data across nodes, and performing rolling upgrades without downtime.
* Security & Compliance: Implementing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), configuring TLS/SSL certificates for secure node-to-node and client-to-node communication, and managing administrative secrets securely.
* Data Modeling & Query Optimization
* JSON Document Design: Designing efficient document schemas, understanding document keys, sub-documents, and choosing between referencing (normalization) and embedding (denormalization) based on access patterns.
* N1QL (SQL for NoSQL): Writing and optimizing complex queries using N1QL, understanding query execution plans (using EXPLAIN), and leveraging query parameters.
* Global Secondary Indexes (GSI): Creating and managing indexes, understanding index partitioning, and choosing the appropriate index storage engine (Standard GSI vs. Memory-Optimized GSI).
* Full-Text Search (FTS) & Analytics: Configuring search indexes for natural language queries and setting up the Analytics service for complex, ad-hoc analytical queries without impacting operational workloads.
* Performance Tuning & Sizing
* Memory Quota Allocation: Sizing and allocating RAM quotas for different services (Data, Index, Search, Eventing, Analytics) based on workload requirements.
* Eviction Policies: Understanding and configuring bucket eviction policies (Value Eviction vs. Full Eviction) and choosing between Couchbase buckets and Ephemeral buckets (in-memory only).
* Disk I/O & Storage Paths: Configuring custom disk paths for data, indexes, eventing, and analytics to optimize disk write queues and read performance.
* Operating System Tuning: Configuring Linux system limits (ulimits), such as soft/hard user processes and soft/hard open files, to handle high concurrent connections and file descriptors.
* DevOps, Automation & Infrastructure (Enterprise Context)

Modern enterprise environments require Couchbase Engineers to automate database lifecycles:
  
  

* Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Ansible:

+ Automating Couchbase installation, cluster initialization, node management, bucket creation, user provisioning, backups, and upgrades.
+ Familiarity with Ansible catalog roles such as couchbase\_install, couchbase\_cluster, couchbase\_node, couchbase\_rebalance, couchbase\_bucket, couchbase\_user, couchbase\_backup, couchbase\_upgrade, and couchbase\_upload\_logs.
+ Managing hosts inventories and group variables (e.g., hosts.yaml, all.yaml, cb\_cluster.yaml) to define cluster topologies and service allocations.

* Containerization & Orchestration: Deploying and managing Couchbase on Kubernetes or Red Hat OpenShift using the Couchbase Autonomous Operator (CAO).
* Linux Administration: Strong command of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 7/8), including package management, systemd service configuration, network troubleshooting, and log analysis.
* General NoSQL & Distributed Systems Concepts
* CAP Theorem: Understanding the trade-offs between Consistency, Availability, and Partition Tolerance in distributed databases.
* Consistency Models: Configuring write durability and read consistency levels (e.g., eventual consistency vs. strong consistency).
* ACID Transactions: Implementing multi-document ACID transactions in Couchbase when strong transactional guarantees are required.

title: Senior Specialist, Provider Data Operations (US Healthcare Insurance)
description:
**Our Mission**
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
As an Insurance Senior Specialist, you will serve as the subject matter expert for Zocdoc's insurance taxonomy and related systems. You will own the policies, processes, and quality standards that ensure our insurance data is accurate, scalable, and aligned with product strategy. This role combines deep expertise in the U.S. health insurance landscape with strong analytical thinking to improve the patient search experience and strengthen the integrity of our insurance database.
  
  
You will partner closely with Product, Operations, and Engineering teams to define insurance policies, monitor database health, and drive continuous improvements. Your work will directly influence how patients find in-network care by ensuring that our insurance taxonomies, carrier and plan coverage, and provider matching systems remain accurate, scalable, and responsive to changes in the healthcare market.
  
  
**A Day in the Life of a Product Operations Specialist:**

* Define Insurance Policies & Standards: Own the policies governing insurance carriers and plans across the Zocdoc marketplace. Define and maintain rules for adding, modifying, and removing insurance carriers and plans, as well as thresholds for performance-based retention or removal.
* Monitor Insurance Market Trends: Stay informed about developments in the U.S. health insurance landscape, including new carrier launches, plan introductions, mergers, and regulatory changes. Evaluate their impact on Zocdoc's insurance database and recommend proactive updates.
* Drive Cross-functional Strategy: Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Data & Analytics teams to ensure insurance taxonomies support product strategy and accurate patient search experiences. Translate complex insurance policies into clear product requirements, data models, business rules, and acceptance criteria. Advise senior Product and Engineering leaders on recommendations and tradeoffs, influence roadmap priorities, and shape taxonomy architecture, validation logic, tooling, and system controls. Define reporting and monitor performance, while leading incident reviews and escalations involving inaccurate insurance availability or provider matching to identify root causes and mitigate future risk.
* Own Insurance Database Health: Define, monitor, and report on key insurance database health metrics. Conduct regular reviews with Product, Operations, and Data partners to identify trends, prioritize improvements, and maintain high data quality.
* Improve Processes & Quality: Identify systemic issues affecting insurance data quality and lead continuous improvement initiatives. Refine policies and operational processes to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and increase accuracy across workflows.
* Perform Quality Assurance & Expert Reviews: Act as the organization's expert on U.S. health insurance, review and validate outputs from operational teams for new insurance plan additions and complex taxonomy decisions. Serve as the final escalation point for policy interpretation and insurance-related quality questions.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree from a reputed institution with a strong academic record.
* 5+ years of experience in the U.S. healthcare industry, with deep expertise in Insurance Payor Management, Payor Analytics, Database
* Management or related functions at payor or plan level.
* Strong understanding of U.S. commercial insurance plans, carriers, provider networks.
* Strong analytical mindset with experience using metrics and data to drive strategic decisions and operational improvements.
* Experience partnering cross-functionally with Product, Operations, Analytics, and Engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions.
* Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to balance strategic thinking and operational execution.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to influence stakeholders across functions.
* Experience with SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, Looker or other analytical tools is a must.
* Familiarity and proven usage of AI-driven tools and workflow automation is a must.

**Benefits**

* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare/creche facility for kids
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check-ups
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2025-2026

**About Us**
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.
  
  
Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values -
*Together, Not Alone*
, we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and modern ML tooling (e.g., MLflow, SageMaker, or equivalents)

**Bar Raiser Expectations**
This role is a Bar Raiser hire. The successful candidate will:
  
  

* Hold themselves and others to high standards of technical quality, data integrity, and operational accountability
* Demonstrate strong judgment when making platform and technical tradeoffs, especially those that affect campaign performance, lead data quality, or system reliability.
* Raise the performance of those around them through mentorship, rigorous code reviews, and clear documentation.
* Simplify complexity, translating ambiguous marketing requirements into clean, maintainable technical solutions.
* Challenge assumptions respectfully and bring data into technical decisions.
* Leave every system, process, and team they touch stronger than they found it.

**AI Expectations**
Avalara is an AI-first company. This role is expected to be an
**AI Bar Raiser**
, not a casual user of AI tools, but someone who embeds AI into how MarTech work gets done and elevates the AI capability of the team.
  
  
**Specifically, This Role Is Expected To**

* Use AI to accelerate development and troubleshooting, including AI-assisted code generation, API debugging, and automated testing for MarTech integrations.
* Apply AI to lead intelligence, leveraging AI/ML-based lead scoring and intent signal processing to improve pipeline quality and Sales efficiency.
* Automate content and campaign operations using AI tools to reduce manual effort in asset creation, QA, and campaign setup within Marketo and Workfront.
* Identify and quantify AI-driven improvements, e.g., reduction in lead processing time, improvement in MQL-to-SQL conversion, or hours saved through intelligent workflow automation.
* Share AI best practices with the MarTech team and Marketing Operations, helping peers adopt AI tools responsibly and effectively.
* Apply AI responsibly, with awareness of data privacy, governance, and ethical use standards relevant to marketing data and customer information.

Candidates who cannot demonstrate specific, measurable AI impact in prior roles do not meet Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard.
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

title: Manager, Data Operations
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a Manager, IBOR Operations, based in Pune, to lead the team responsible for the accuracy and timeliness of Addepar's Investment Book of Record (IBOR) — spanning Corporate Actions, Investment Accounting, Investable/Safe Cash, and Performance & Valuation. This role owns the operational integrity of positions, transactions, and reconciliations across custodial, aggregator, and trading data feeds, and acts as the senior escalation point for complex data and reconciliation issues. Reporting into Data Operations leadership, this person will manage a team made up of a Lead and Analysts, partner closely with Product and Engineering to evolve IBOR tooling, and represent Data Operations to senior stakeholders across the business.
  
  
Do you enjoy the ability to work and build your career in an exciting, fast-growing environment? If so, you’ll fit in with our open and inclusive culture that is disrupting the wealth management and financial services industry.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the operational integrity of Addepar's IBOR — positions, transactions, corporate actions, tax lot accuracy, trade static data, trade enrichment, and market claims — across custodial, aggregator, and trading data feeds
* Lead and develop a team comprising a Data Operations Lead and Analysts, setting priorities, quality standards, and performance expectations
* Establish and maintain process controls and metrics that track reconciliation break resolution, data quality, and SLA performance across the IBOR function
* Serve as the senior escalation point for complex trade lifecycle, corporate actions, reconciliation, and trade fail issues that affect IBOR accuracy, partnering with clients and custodial/data providers to drive resolution
* Partner with Product and Engineering to define requirements and prioritize tooling that improves IBOR data quality, automates reconciliation, and scales operations
* Drive cross-functional initiatives with other Operations, Product, and Engineering leaders on data strategy and new platform capabilities
* Own hiring, onboarding, mentorship, and career development for the Lead and analysts within the team

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or equivalent experience
* 9+ years of experience in investment/portfolio operations, middle office, custody, or trading operations, with direct exposure to IBOR, OMS/EMS, or custody data feeds
* Background in asset management or the sell side of custody/fund administration, with solid grounding in capital markets fundamentals
* Strong working knowledge of corporate actions processing, position/cash/trade reconciliation, and tax lot accounting, including tax lot relief methods and tax-loss harvesting mechanics
* Understanding of the trade lifecycle and trading process end-to-end; a trading qualification (e.g. Series 7/63 or equivalent) is a plus
* Comfortable with SQL and Python for data analysis, break investigation, and process automation; familiarity with database management a plus
* Familiarity with IBOR or portfolio accounting platforms (e.g. SimCorp, Eagle, Aladdin, Charles River) is a plus
* Proven experience managing and developing a team directly, including through a Lead, with a track record of coaching individuals to grow in their roles
* Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to represent Data Operations to senior internal and external audiences
* Excellent judgment under pressure, with a track record of driving process improvement in a high-throughput, deadline-driven environment
* Strong communication skills, able to convey complex ideas clearly across cultural and functional boundaries
* Experience working with globally distributed teams and clients is mandatory

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

**Description**
***Join Envalior – Imagine The Future!***
Are you passionate about pioneering change in a constantly evolving environment? At Envalior, we are seeking a talented Process and Data Officer to join our dynamic Supply Chain team.
  
  
At Envalior, the future of high-performance materials isn't just being shaped; it's being pioneered. A belief in fostering an environment where every voice is heard and ideas are valued is integral to our culture. Empowerment is the driving force behind our pioneering spirit, allowing our teams to take initiative, explore new solutions, and revel in the thrill of constant innovation.
  
  
Join us and be a part of a team committed to making a positive impact—where safety, sustainability, collaboration, and empowerment intersect to drive innovation.
  
  
**Requirements**
Purpose of the position
  
  
The Process & Data Officer serves as a subject matter expert for master data across multiple business processes. The role ensures high-quality master and configuration data and supports agile, accurate processing of master data requests. The job holder must possess solid knowledge of key business processes (PtP, OtC, SCM) to provide the right data foundation for efficient and compliant process execution.
  
  
**The Key Areas Of Accountability/responsibility**
Governance (approx. 10%)
  
  

* Validate whether correct and complete master data requests have been submitted.
* Assess whether email-based requests can be executed directly or require workflow routing.
* Identify and clean up non-used master data elements; align conditions and decisions with relevant stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement (approx. 15%)
  
  

* Simplify complex processes, automate routine activities, and proactively eliminate redundancies.
* Identify repetitive business activities and transfer them into automated tasks using available tooling (e.g., RPA).

Reporting (approx. 15%)
  
  

* Monitor and report data quality based on business rules describing logical relationships across data fields.
* Develop detailed reports to support clean-up actions beyond high-level KPIs.
* Provide ad hoc reporting to support projects, issue resolution, and fact-based decision making.

Project Support (approx. 20%)
  
  

* Contribute to project activities; master data is critical to all process and system implementations.
* Support data preparation, data mapping, and validation activities.
* Play an active role during UAT and be a key contributor during cutover planning and execution.

Operational Support (approx. 40%)
  
  

* Support SAP users in understanding and applying master data correctly.
* Assist in troubleshooting by identifying root causes, even when issues are not directly data-related.
* Interpret incoming requests and determine which master data objects require updates (vendors, customers, materials, contracts, info records, source lists, etc.).
* Choose the most effective data entry method (manual entry vs. upload tools).
* Maintain shipment routes across multiple regions.
* Maintain approval tables (SAP/SRM) and the department’s SharePoint environment.
* Maintain the PANDA master data workflow application (users, roles, tasks, workflows).
* Ensure timely responses to all support questions submitted through the central mailbox.

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE**
Core Competencies
  
  

* Analytical & Conceptual Thinking
* Stakeholder Management & Influence
* Process Discipline & Quality Orientation
* Problem-Solving & Troubleshooting Mindset
* Ownership & Accountability
* Continuous Improvement Attitude
* Communication & Service Orientation

Technical Skills
  
  

* SAP Master Data Expertise
* Data Quality & Reporting Tools
* Workflow & Process Tools
* Basic Automation or Scripting Knowledge (advantage)
* Documentation Skills.

**Additional Requirements**

* Strong command of English (written and verbal); additional languages are an asset.
* Ability to work effectively in a global environment across multiple time zones.
* High level of organization and ability to manage high request volumes (6,000+ emails, 10,000+ workflows annually).
* Ability to balance standardization with practical support in a non-harmonized business environment.

**Benefits**
**WHY ENVALIOR?**
**Competitive Compensation**
Join us at Envalior and enjoy competitive compensation packages, inclusive of a global bonus program and individual performance bonuses, ensuring your hard work is recognized and rewarded.
  
  
**Comprehensive Benefits**
Your well-being matters to us. At Envalior, we provide an array of benefits supporting your financial security, health, and overall well-being. This includes retirement plans, health programs, life insurance, and comprehensive medical care.
  
  
**Work-Life Balance & Flexibility**
Maintain a healthy balance between work and personal life with Envalior's commitment to supporting your schedule.
  
  
**Training & Development Opportunities**
At Envalior, your growth matters. We encourage and invest in your professional and personal development. We support our employees in their growth and personal development through ongoing investment in their knowledge and skills via training, coaching, and mentoring.
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
At Envalior, our people drive our success, so it’s only right that we provide a diverse and inclusive working environment and foster a culture of belonging, openness, and respect. We value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We are committed to nurturing and empowering every individual to reach their full potential.
  
  
**APPLY NOW!**
Ready to pioneer change with Envalior? Join us in our mission to drive innovation, sustainability, and excellence. Apply today and become a part of our transformative journey towards a more sustainable future.
  
  
Submit your application online by sending your CV and motivation letter in English through our career portal. If you have any questions, feel free to connect directly with our recruiter at Deepanshu.Tripathi@envalior.com
  
  
*Envalior is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.*
If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at Talent.Acquisition@Envalior.com.
  
  
**OUR HERITAGE**
With a combined heritage of over 100 years, Envalior brings together two established global materials players: DSM Engineering Materials and LANXESS High Performance Materials. Our unique combined portfolio of longstanding material-, application-, and design expertise enables our customers to develop and launch sustainable future-proof designs. Envalior is the brand new materials powerhouse that was Launched in early 2023.
  
  
We aim to be a global leader in sustainable and high-performance engineering materials. We imagine the future by shaping the world of today and tomorrow. We’re conscious that this is both a privilege and a responsibility – so, when we imagine the future, we’re guided by our key values to help us create a better world.

title: Cloud Storage and NetApp ONTAP Administrator - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced Cloud Storage and NetApp ONTAP Administrator to join our team in Pune. You will administer and optimise enterprise storage and backup environments across cloud and file-services platforms. The role requires 5–6 years of relevant experience, with practical knowledge of NetApp ONTAP, NetApp Cloud Volumes ONTAP, Amazon FSx, Commvault and Azure or AWS backup services.
  
  
You will help maintain the performance, scalability, reliability and security of storage services while supporting data protection, disaster recovery and operational requirements.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Administer, configure and maintain NetApp ONTAP file services, NetApp Cloud Volumes ONTAP, Amazon FSx and other cloud-storage solutions
* Monitor storage capacity, availability and performance, identifying and resolving operational issues promptly
* Optimise storage configurations to improve performance, scalability and reliability
* Implement and manage snapshots, backups and disaster-recovery solutions using Commvault and Azure or AWS backup services
* Troubleshoot storage and backup incidents and contribute to effective problem and root-cause management
* Apply data encryption, access controls and other measures required to meet security and compliance expectations
* Work collaboratively with IT, development and operations teams to deliver storage requirements and support technical projects
* Maintain accurate documentation covering storage configurations, operating procedures and recommended practices

**Who You Are**

* You have 5–6 years of experience administering and optimising cloud-storage solutions
* You have practical knowledge of NetApp storage products and file services
* You have experience administering NetApp ONTAP and Cloud Volumes ONTAP
* You understand Amazon FSx and cloud-based storage environments
* You have experience with Commvault Backup and familiarity with Azure or AWS backup services
* You understand snapshots, backup management and disaster-recovery practices
* You can monitor performance, tune configurations and troubleshoot storage-related incidents
* You understand storage security principles, including encryption and access control
* You communicate clearly and work effectively with cross-functional teams
* You take a solution-focused approach and use sound judgement when supporting service delivery and product development

**Not a perfect fit?**
Worried that you don’t meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* The opportunity to work across enterprise storage, backup and cloud technologies
* Exposure to NetApp ONTAP, NetApp Cloud Volumes ONTAP, Amazon FSx, Commvault and Azure or AWS services
* Collaboration with IT, development and operations teams on storage requirements and technical projects
* Experience supporting business-critical storage performance, availability, security and data protection
* Opportunities to broaden your knowledge across hybrid-cloud storage, disaster recovery and operational service delivery

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced administration and optimisation of NetApp ONTAP and cloud-storage environments
* Operational knowledge of Amazon FSx and NetApp Cloud Volumes ONTAP
* Backup and recovery management using Commvault and Azure or AWS backup services
* Storage performance monitoring, configuration tuning and incident troubleshooting
* Data-protection practices involving snapshots, backups and disaster recovery
* Security and compliance practices for encryption and storage-access control

title: Packaged/SaaS Application Engineer
description:
**Project Role :**
Packaged/SaaS Application Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Configure and support packaged or SaaS applications to adapt features, manage releases, and ensure system stability. Use standard tools, APIs, and low-code platforms to align solutions with business needs while preserving compatibility and performance.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Site Reliability Engineering
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Packaged or Software as a Service Application Engineer, a typical day involves configuring and supporting packaged or SaaS applications to meet evolving business requirements. This role requires managing application features, overseeing release processes, and ensuring the overall stability and performance of systems. The engineer works with various tools, application programming interfaces, and low-code platforms to tailor solutions that align with organizational goals while maintaining compatibility across different environments. Collaboration with multiple teams and continuous monitoring of application health are integral parts of daily activities to deliver seamless user experiences.
  
  
**Experience Required**
5–7+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, DataOps, or Platform Engineering
  
  
Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with Terraform and AWS-based data platforms
  
  
Minimum 2 years of experience with at least two of the following: Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, Immuta, or Astronomer/Airflow

The Cloud & Data Site Reliability Engineer will design, automate, and operate secure, scalable, and highly reliable cloud-native data platforms across multi-account and multi-region AWS environments. The role combines Cloud Engineering, DataOps, DevOps, observability, automation, and SRE practices to support enterprise analytics, AI/ML, and data modernisation initiatives.
  
  
The engineer will be responsible for platform availability, infrastructure automation, incident management, performance optimisation, data governance, security, cost control, and integration across AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, Immuta, and Astronomer/Airflow.

title: Technical Consultant
description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
  
  
Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
  
  
**Job Description**
**THE POSITION**
**:**
**Technical Consultant**
plays a crucial role in pharmacovigilance, particularly in the context of the Argus Safety System. The responsibilities of an Argus administrator, as outlined, involve various aspects of configuration, data management, automation, and collaboration with case processing teams.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Configure, maintain, and optimize Oracle Argus Safety to support pharmacovigilance operations and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Analyze business requirements and implement Argus configurations aligned with regulatory standards and industry best practices.
* Design, develop, and enhance Argus workflows, business rules, and automation solutions to improve operational efficiency.
* Participate in end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects, including data assessment, profiling, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Collaborate with business, safety, and technical teams to define migration requirements and source-to-target mapping specifications.
* Perform data extraction, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities to ensure accurate and compliant migration of safety data into Argus Safety.
* Develop and execute SQL queries for data analysis, reporting, migration validation, and issue investigation.
* Identify and resolve application, configuration, integration, and data-related issues within the Argus Safety environment.
* Support system integrations between Argus Safety and external applications using web services and related technologies.
* Develop, customize, and maintain reports and dashboards using Oracle BI Publisher (BIP) to support operational and regulatory reporting needs.
* Participate in testing activities, including system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), and migration validation testing.
* Ensure system configurations, migrated data, and business processes comply with global pharmacovigilance regulations, including FDA, EMA, and other applicable requirements.
* Support validation documentation and compliance activities for audits, inspections, system upgrades, and regulatory reviews.
* Collaborate with Oracle Support and internal stakeholders for incident management, patch deployments, and system enhancements.
* Provide end-user support, training, and documentation to promote effective system utilization and knowledge sharing.
* Monitor regulatory updates, Argus product enhancements, and industry trends to recommend continuous process and system improvements.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

*Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.*
**Qualifications**
The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.
  
  

* Participate in end-to-end pharmacovigilance data migration projects, including data assessment, profiling, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory Affairs, and IT teams to gather migration and reporting requirements.
* Develop and maintain source-to-target mapping documents, data migration specifications, and reconciliation reports.
* Execute data extraction, transformation, cleansing, and validation activities to ensure data quality and integrity throughout the migration lifecycle.
* Perform SQL-based data analysis, data validation, reconciliation, and issue investigation to support migration and reporting activities.
* Identify, analyze, and resolve data discrepancies, mapping issues, and migration defects.
* Support migration testing activities, including System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and post-migration validation.
* Conduct data reconciliation between source and target systems to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance of migrated data.
* Design, develop, customize, and maintain Oracle BI Publisher (BIP) reports, line listings, and regulatory outputs based on business requirements.
* Create and optimize complex data models, templates, and report layouts within Oracle BI Publisher.
* Support generation and validation of operational, regulatory, and management reports using BIP and database queries.
* Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and scripts to support reporting, migration, and data analysis requirements.
* Collaborate with technical teams to support integrations, data interfaces, and reporting solutions across pharmacovigilance systems.
* Participate in system upgrades, enhancements, and migration projects, ensuring reporting and data validation requirements are met.
* Prepare and maintain migration documentation, validation evidence, test scripts, SOPs, and technical specifications.
* Ensure migrated data and reporting processes comply with pharmacovigilance regulations and organizational data governance standards.
* Provide end-user support and training related to migration deliverables, reporting solutions, and BI Publisher reports.
* Monitor reporting performance and recommend process improvements to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and compliance.
* Stay current with Oracle BI Publisher enhancements, data migration best practices, and emerging pharmacovigilance technologies.
* PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
* Bachelor’s degree/Masters Degree in IT Stream
* 3+ years of relevant experience in drug safety IT Systems

**Additional Information**
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.
  
  
From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

title: Data Architect
description:
**The Role**
We are building our enterprise data platform from the ground up and need a Data Architect to own it. This is a greenfield, hands-on leadership role — not a consulting engagement. You will define the architecture, make the
  
technology decisions, build the foundation, and be accountable for outcomes. You will report directly to the CTO and
  
partner closely with a Senior Data Engineer on the same hiring cycle. The platform will serve business analytics, operational reporting, and AI-driven capabilities across multiple markets andenterprise clients. A key deliverable is enabling AI applications and agents to consume trusted enterprise data securely viaAPIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  
  
**What You Will Own**
Data platform architecture — Data Lake, Lakehouse, semantic layers, and data consumption patterns across
  
structured, semi-structured, and event-based sources.
  
Ingestion and transformation pipelines — batch, streaming, and CDC-based, with proper orchestration, observability, and failure handling.
  
Data modelling — scalable analytical models covering core business domains: orders, inventory, fulfilment,
  
logistics, marketplaces, billing, and platform performance.
  
Business analytics — governed KPI definitions, dashboards, and self-service capabilities that replace manual
  
reporting.
  
AI data enablement — architecture for exposing authoritative, governed data to AI agents through MCP and APIs, with appropriate access controls and tenant isolation.
  
Data governance and compliance — data quality, lineage, PII classification, and controls that meet enterprise
  
security and privacy obligations across multiple jurisdictions.
  
Platform reliability — monitoring, SLAs, incident management, and operational runbooks so the platform runs as a
  
production service.
  
  
**What We Expect**
First 90 days: Weeks 1–4: Assess the data landscape, produce an enterprise architecture proposal.
  
Weeks 5–8: Deliver the first production pipeline and a priority BI dashboard.
  
Weeks 9–12: Define common KPI models for two business domains and deliver the first MCP-based data capability for an AI agent.
  
6–12 months: Production data platform operational with automated pipelines for priority datasets.
  
Governed business models and trusted KPI definitions in active use by the business.
  
Dashboards live and replacing manual reporting. Architecture for secure AI data consumption implemented, with initial MCP capabilities in production.
  
Platform operational practices — quality, lineage, monitoring, cost controls — established and running.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**
10+ years across data engineering, data platforms, or data architecture — with real architecture ownership, not just
  
delivery.
  
Proven experience designing and building enterprise Data Lake, Warehouse, or Lakehouse platforms.
  
Strong SQL, data modelling, pipeline design, and cloud-native (preferably AWS) skills.
  
Experience with governance, data quality, lineage, and compliance — including PII and privacy controls.
  
Hands-on enough to validate designs and build in the early phase; structured enough to define standards that
  
scale.
  
Experience in eCommerce, logistics, marketplace, or B2B SaaS is strongly preferred — the domain is complex and
  
ramp time matters.
  
  
**Desirable:**
Practical experience with MCP, LLM/AI integration, semantic layers, RAG, or secure enterprise data access for AI systems.
  
**The Opportunity**
This is a founding role. The data platform does not yet exist. You will define what good looks like at Anchanto — and build
  
it.
  
If you are energised by greenfield architecture, comfortable with high ownership, and capable of moving fluently from
  
business question to data pipeline to AI consumption — we want to talk.
  
  
  
Benefits
  
  
  
**Why Join Anchanto**
  
  
  

At Anchanto, we believe in creating an environment where people can build meaningful careers, continuously develop their capabilities and gain exposure to a truly global business.

* **Global Exposure:**
  Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment.
* **Learning & Development:**
  We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth.
* **International & Onsite Opportunities:**
  Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets.
* **Medical Insurance:**
  Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support you & your families health and well-being.
* **Comprehensive Leave Benefits:**
  Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments.
* **Recognition for Long-Term Contribution:**
  Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution.
* **Flexibility & Work-Life Balance:**
  A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities.
* **Meaningful Career Growth:**
  Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.
