title: Application Development & Support Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Position Overview
  
  
The Data Quality Developer will play a hands-on technical role in implementing and maintaining data quality controls, monitoring frameworks, and integration solutions across our enterprise MDM ecosystem. This position requires a strong technical background combined with excellent communication skills to work effectively with business stakeholders across the globe.
  
  
Working closely with the Data Governance Council Lead, this role will be responsible for configuring data quality platforms, implementing validation rules and workflows, developing dashboards and reports, and remediating data quality incidents across customer, supplier, contact, and item domains.
  
  
Two Data Quality Developers will be hired — one focused primarily on the Ataccama platform (configuration, rules, profiling, monitoring) and the other focused on data quality operations outside of Ataccama (cross-system reconciliation, integrations, dashboards, remediation). Both developers serve as each other's backup and are expected to be cross-trained across all responsibilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities Data Quality Platform Configuration & Customization
  
  

* Configure and customize data quality platforms (primarily Ataccama) to ensure optimal user experience for data management
* Implement data quality rules, validation logic, and automated controls within the DQ platform
* Develop and maintain workflows to manage reference data across systems
* Build monitoring capabilities for operational processes and data quality metrics
* Perform data profiling and analysis using platform-native tools to identify data quality issues and patterns
* Configure DQ platform integrations with MDM, Snowflake, and enterprise source systems

Data Quality Analysis & Remediation
  
  

* Run reports across systems to calculate data quality dimensions (completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness)
* Execute data reconciliation reports across multiple systems (MDM, ERP, CRM, data lake)
* Remediate data quality incidents in a timely manner — triage, investigate root cause, and resolve
* Identify recurring incidents and implement permanent fixes to resolve root cause issues
* Manage incident resolution using ServiceNow to meet SLAs
* Collaborate with MDM developers and integration developers to trace data quality issues across system boundaries
* Analyze logs and data flows to isolate where quality degradation occurs in the pipeline

Dashboard & Reporting Development
  
  

* Implement and maintain data quality dashboards using Power BI
* Create business-friendly visualizations of data quality findings and trends
* Develop reports to track quality metrics across all domains (customer, supplier, contact, item)
* Build monitoring reports for operational processes and controls
* Design health scoring dashboards that provide at-a-glance quality status for each domain

Data Integration & Synchronization
  
  

* Implement data integrations to synchronize data across systems for quality monitoring and reconciliation
* Develop ETL processes to support data quality and reconciliation needs (e.g., Informatica PowerCenter, IICS, or platform-native connectors)
* Work hands-on with MDM, Snowflake, and related systems to implement quality controls
* Ensure data consistency and accuracy across the enterprise data landscape
* Build automated data validation checks within integration pipelines

Stakeholder Collaboration & Requirements Gathering
  
  

* Participate in requirements gathering sessions with business users
* Elicit and document data quality requirements from stakeholders
* Present data quality findings in a business-friendly format
* Conduct meetings with large audiences independently
* Work effectively with business users across multiple regions and time zones

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Identify opportunities to enhance data quality processes and controls
* Contribute to the evolution of data quality maturity in the organization
* Support the long-term data quality roadmap
* Stay current with data quality best practices and emerging technologies

**Required Qualifications Experience**

* 8+ years of total experience in data quality, data development, or related fields, preferably in an MDM and data governance environment
* 5+ years hands-on experience with at least one data quality platform (e.g., Ataccama, Informatica Data Quality, Talend Data Quality, or similar)
* 5+ years advanced SQL proficiency for data analysis, profiling, quality checks, and reconciliation (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake)
* 4+ years ETL development experience for data integration and transformation (e.g., Informatica PowerCenter, IICS, Talend, or platform-native connectors)
* 3+ years experience building reports and dashboards using Power BI or similar visualization tools
* 3+ years experience with data profiling tools and techniques for root cause analysis
* 3+ years experience with data reconciliation across multiple systems (MDM, ERP, CRM, data lake)
* 2+ years experience with incident management and SLA-driven resolution using ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira)
* Experience working with business stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones
* Proven track record of implementing data quality solutions and controls

Communication & Collaboration
  
  

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to translate technical concepts into business-friendly language
* Experience presenting to diverse audiences including business stakeholders and leadership
* Proven ability to conduct meetings with large audiences independently
* Strong requirements elicitation and documentation skills
* Comfortable working across global teams and time zones

Security & Compliance
  
  

* Working knowledge of data security, information security practices, and SOX compliance procedures for data quality changes

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Ataccama Experience: Hands-on experience with Ataccama ONE platform (DQ rules, profiling, monitoring, workflows)
* Multi-Domain MDM Experience: Experience working with customer, supplier, contact, or item master data domains
* Manufacturing Industry: Background in manufacturing industry, particularly across multiple countries
* Snowflake / Data Lake: Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms for data quality monitoring and reconciliation
* ServiceNow: Experience using ServiceNow for incident management and meeting SLAs
* MDM Platforms: Familiarity with MDM platforms (e.g., Informatica MDM, Reltio) and how DQ integrates with MDM workflows
* Certifications: Data quality or data management certifications (e.g., CDMP, vendor-specific certifications)
* Additional Tools: Experience with data governance tools, metadata management platforms, or data catalogs

title: Senior System Administrator - Windchill
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale.
  
  
Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams.
  
  
The Senior System Administrator is responsible for defining, administering, and maintaining the hardware, software, and environments for PLM, Regulatory, R&D and Clinical systems required to support Edwards’ business transformation from development through production. This role collaborates with Architects and Application Owners to create and manage system environments, supports administration and maintenance, defines release management, source code control, build and deployment procedures, and ensures environments are available, secure, compliant, and performing as expected. The role works closely with cross-functional IT, Infrastructure, Compliance, Configuration, Development, vendor, and business teams to maintain system availability, support upgrades, execute deployments, manage backups and disaster recovery planning, and maintain infrastructure-related validation documentation.
  
  
**How will you make an impact:**

* Administer, install, update, optimize, debug, and maintain PTC Windchill applications and related system environments across development, test, certification, and production.
* Lead and Manage application administration activities across the lifecycle, including vendor coordination, installation, data import, upgrades, user issue resolution, permissions and roles, backups, automation, and application retirement.
* Define, maintain, and execute source code management, release management, deployment, and configuration management work instructions to support Configuration and Development teams.
* Build releases, including weekly, on-demand, and snapshot releases for local instances, and support code deployments, configuration changes, code review, and test coordination.
* Plan, configure, document, and support high availability, backup, security, SSL certificate, HTTPS, LDAPS, disaster recovery, and environment readiness requirements.
* Provide guidance on non-functional requirements, including performance, load testing, benchmarking, scalability, resilience, and operational readiness.
* Perform Windchill system maintenance activities, including upgrades, patches, security vulnerability remediation, new release installation, daily and weekly maintenance plans, WinDU, WinRU, revaulting, and environment refresh or rehosting.
* Maintain Windchill vault space, administer CAD and Office workers, perform log and temporary file cleanup and rotation, and support remote file server setup and maintenance.
* Review Server Manager, Method Server, and other Windchill logs for issues; administer, monitor, and report through PTC System Monitor.
* Write and maintain deployment scripts, coordinate environment resources and schedules, monitor CPU, RAM, and disk space growth, and plan for expansion or cleanup as needed.
* Lead and Perform issue resolution, root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement to strengthen system stability and reduce recurring issues.
* Support coordinated patching, hotfix, and vulnerability remediation activities for Oracle RDC/Clinical and SAS Analytics platforms across OS, application, and database layers, partnering with IT Database and Infrastructure teams to strengthen compliance, stability, and risk mitigation.
* Author and maintain system administration, infrastructure, validation, work instruction, deployment, and environment maintenance documentation to support compliance and audit readiness.
* Provide on-call critical support and partner with Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts, application users, vendors, and cross-functional teams to resolve issues and maintain service levels.
* Lead and mentor junior/new team members by providing technical guidance, ensuring adherence to support processes, and driving the creation and maintenance of high-quality technical documentation, knowledge articles, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

**What you'll need (Required):**

* Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related IT discipline.
* 5–7 years of related working experience in PTC Windchill v12.0.1 or above system administration.
* 5–7 years of IT experience demonstrating solid performance while working with cross-functional IT and business teams on enterprise-level or complex system implementations.
* Hands-on experience administering Windchill environments across development, test, certification, and production, including installation, upgrades, patching, configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
* Experience with Windchill maintenance and administration activities such as WinDU, WinRU, revaulting, vault space management, CAD and Office worker administration, remote file server maintenance, and log review.
* Experience supporting source code management, release management, build and deployment procedures, deployment scripting, environment refreshes, and configuration changes.
* Experience supporting high availability, backup, security, SSL certificate, HTTPS, LDAPS, disaster recovery, performance, load testing, and system monitoring requirements.
* Experience supporting Oracle RDC/Clinical and SAS Analytics platform patching or hotfix activities across OS, application, and database layers, including coordination with IT Database and Infrastructure teams on implementation, vulnerability remediation, compliance, stability, and risk mitigation efforts.
* Strong troubleshooting, debugging, analytical, detail-oriented, organizational, and information-seeking skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal relationship skills, and ability to interact professionally with all organizational levels.

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Experience working in multi-workstream development environments using DevOps CI/CD tools and methodologies, with working knowledge of JIRA and GitLab.
* Experience in Codebeamer administration, configuration, workflow management, or integration with enterprise engineering and ALM processes.
* Technical skills in Java, JSP, JavaScript, XML, JSON, SQL, PL/SQL, SOAP, RESTful Web Services, Python, and relevant code development languages and concepts.
* Experience with enterprise application and platform administration across Windows Server, IIS Web Server, Apache Tomcat, RHEL/Linux administration, Microsoft .NET, SSL certificate management, load balancers, routing, firewall concepts, access control, networking, and communication protocols.
* Working knowledge of Oracle SQL queries, Oracle APEX administration, Oracle DB 19c, SOLR or search engine indexing concepts, Aras PLM, SAS Administration, AWS servers, and patch management.
* Experience in medical device, pharmaceutical, highly regulated, or corporate enterprise environments.
* Excellent organization and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and work toward long-term goals.
* Strong relationship management, negotiation, and collaboration skills, with the ability to drive achievement of objectives across teams.
* Substantial knowledge and understanding of computer science fundamentals.
* Strict attention to detail and ability to work independently in a complex enterprise support environment.

title: AVP,  Data Architect (L11)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Data Architect (L11\)**
**Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
   

  

 Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The AVP, Data Architect owns how data is sourced, modeled, governed, and delivered for analytic workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI solutions. The Data Architect will need to develop intimate knowledge of SYF key data domains (originations, loan activity, collection, etc.) and maintain a holistic view across SYF functions to design performant, resilient and cost\-effective data solutions.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on experience for preparing data for AI data pipelines so agents can reliably access high\-quality, compliant information. The role partners closely with the data engineering team, AI Platform team, the data governance team, data science/analytics teams, and business stakeholder teams to define data architecture, standards, and operating models that enable scalable, secure, and cost\-effective analytics and AI workloads. This leader combines deep data architecture skills, strong understanding of different data model methodology, ETL pipelines, AI/LLM/RAG patterns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define logical, physical data model structure, integrate, govern, and store data in the enterprise repositories for supporting analytics/data science workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI workloads.
* Execute POCs and prototypes in sandbox and lab environments to propose solutions for AWS cloud workloads and AI solutions using data on AWS.
* Document data flow diagrams. Ensure discipline in the creation of Logical Data Models and their later implementation as Physical Data Structures.
* Define the target\-state Data \& AI Foundations architecture supporting agentic AI use cases, enterprise knowledge graph or metadata layer, data products, and AI\-ready datasets.
* Assist in developing the strategy and roadmap for making key enterprise data sources "AI\-ready": curation, quality, metadata, access patterns, latency requirements, and retention.
* Partner with source system owners (core servicing, CRM, collections, risk, fraud, etc.) to define data contracts, SLAs, and integration patterns that support downstream analytics.
* Establish data preparation and curation pipelines for model fine\-tuning, including dataset selection, labeling strategies, quality validation, versioning, and compliance with model risk policies.
* Define and enforce data governance policies for AI: data classification, lineage, access controls, PII handling, retention, and usage logging for AI workloads.
* Partner with AI Governance/Model Risk and InfoSec/AppSec to ensure data usage in prompts, context, and tools adheres to policies, including regulatory, privacy, and model risk requirements.
* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong experience with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., data warehouses like Redshift/Snowflake/BigQuery, relational databases like PostgreSQL, and object storage) and their use in analytics and AI.
* Demonstrated expertise in enabling data readiness for agentic AI from existing data stores in front\-end (OLTP) applications or analytical (OLAP) applications like data lake and warehouses. Strong hands\-on experience on designing data models (star schema, 3NF) for raw, standardized and curated data products for optimal performance and scalability of data applications for AI.
* Strong hands\-on experience in generating semantic layers for the data products that serve multiple consuming applications on AWS.
* Proven experience building data pipelines for AI/ML use cases including ETL/ELT workflows, streaming data integration, and data preparation for model training and fine\-tuning.
* Strong experience with Lakehouse architecture using S3, Apache Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog, Redshift
* Strong Python skills for building data processing, evaluation, and automation pipelines, plus familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment management).
* Good understanding of identity and data security architecture \- IAM, IAM Identity Center, cross account data access patterns, identity propagation for AI agents and services
* Good understanding of AWS infrastructure concepts (networking, security, storage, compute) and how they apply to data and AI workloads.
* Experience working with ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming data, and integration technologies (e.g., CDC, APIs, event buses) for both batch and real\-time use cases.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary teams and influence across platform, AI, data, and business stakeholders.


**Desired Skills/ Knowledge**
* Experience implementing or leveraging knowledge graphs, entity resolution, or semantic search to power AI and RAG use cases.
* Solid understanding of LLM and agentic AI patterns (prompts, tools, RAG, memory) and how data quality and structure impact AI behavior and performance.
* Background in building data products specifically targeted for AI/ML (feature stores, labeled datasets, evaluation datasets, fine\-tuning corpora).
* Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF) as they apply to data and AI.
* Prior experience in financial services, credit, payments, or similar domains where data lineage, explainability, and audit trails are critical.
* Basic AWS solution architecture knowledge including core services, AWS S3, Redshift, Amazon Bedrock, and Bedrock AgentCore so they can collaborate effectively with platform and agent teams.
* Good understanding of enterprise data governance and access controls like AWS Lake Formation, Glue Data catalog and metadata management frameworks.
* Team player, strong engagement, positive attitude and natural curiosity are highly desired.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong familiarity with streaming through Kafka and other Data Lake technologies and techniques.
* Strong familiarity with data governance, data lineage, data processes, DML, and data architecture control execution
* Strong experience with business analysis \- Requirements analysis and conversion to data models.
* Must be able to develop creative solutions to problems.


**Work Timings: 2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. **We are looking forward to hire Master Data Management (MDM) Professionals in the following areas :**
**Experience Level 4\+ Years**
**Job Title: MDM Quality Engineer / Test Engineer –**
****Role Overview****
 We're looking for a detail\-oriented Quality Engineer with experience in Master Data Management testing to ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of our MDM platform. You'll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across data models, integrations, match \& merge rules, workflows, and data quality processes — ensuring that master data is accurate, consistent, and fit for business use.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Design, develop, and execute test strategies and test plans for MDM implementations, including unit, functional, integration, regression, and performance testing.
* Validate Reltio data models, entity configurations, relationships, attributes, and reference data for accuracy and completeness.
* Test match \& merge rules, survivorship logic, and deduplication processes to ensure golden record quality meets business expectations.
* Validate integration pipelines (batch and real\-time) between Reltio and source/target systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) for data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
* Perform data quality testing — profiling, validation, and reconciliation — across source systems and the Reltio MDM hub.
* Test Reltio workflows, business rules, stewardship processes, and exception handling scenarios.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts for regression and data validation testing using tools such as Python, SQL, or Selenium.
* Perform API testing of Reltio REST APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or similar.
* Conduct performance and load testing on Reltio integrations and platform configurations.
* Log, track, and manage defects through the full lifecycle using JIRA or similar tools, working closely with developers to ensure timely resolution.
* Collaborate with business analysts, data stewards, and developers to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria.
* Validate data migration activities — pre\-migration, mid\-migration, and post\-migration — ensuring data integrity and completeness.
* Participate in UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and support business stakeholders during testing cycles.
* Develop and maintain test documentation including test cases, test scripts, test data, and test summary reports.
* Contribute to the definition and enforcement of QA best practices within MDM projects.


****Required Skills \& Experience****
* 3\+ years of experience in software or data quality engineering, with at least 1–2 years of exposure to MDM platforms (Reltio preferred, or Informatica MDM, Semarchy, SAP MDG, Stibo STEP, or similar).
* Hands\-on understanding of Reltio MDM concepts — entities, relationships, match \& merge, survivorship, hierarchies, and workflows — sufficient to design meaningful test cases.
* Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and querying across relational/cloud databases.
* Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or similar API testing tools.
* Experience with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar).
* Familiarity with ETL/integration testing (validating data pipelines, transformation logic, and data flow accuracy).
* Experience with data quality testing concepts — completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to define test scenarios from complex business and data requirements.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working within sprint\-based delivery teams.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience with test automation frameworks (Selenium, PyTest, or similar) and scripting in Python or Groovy.
* Exposure to performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, or similar) for MDM and integration pipelines.
* Reltio platform certification or formal training is a plus.
* Experience testing Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP data platforms integrated with Reltio.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.) for automated testing workflows.
* Experience with data migration testing in large\-scale MDM implementation projects.
* Knowledge of data privacy/compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA) and their impact on data quality and testing requirements.
* Experience in industries such as Manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, retail, or financial services.


**Key Competencies**
* Meticulous attention to detail and strong data analytical mindset.
* Ability to understand complex data relationships and identify edge cases in match/merge scenarios.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to work across data engineering, business, and architecture teams.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple test deliverables across concurrent project tracks.
* Proactive in identifying risks, raising issues early, and proposing pragmatic testing solutions.

**About Role**
 Slb has an opening in Coimbatore / Pune, India and Bogota, Columbia for a Technical Lead who will work on the Development / configuration for all modules / capabilities, changes and bug fixes related to Planisware and Microsoft .Net suite of applications in the Product and Service Delivery Function under Enterprise Solutions.

* Work on roll\-back scenarios and identify cases where roll\-backs are necessary

* Proven experience in designing and deploying Planisware for large\-scale organizations, particularly in product or project management. Familiarity with enterprise architecture and software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies
* Manage risks and resolves issues that affect release scope, schedule and quality
* Ensure technical documentation is kept up to date by the development team
* Proactively identify and implement procedures to streamline the build process which may drive the development and maintenance of an automated build process

* Should have a thorough understanding and working knowledge of ITIL processes including Application Change and Release Management
* Experience working on multiple releases/projects as a subject matter expert and as a technical leader. Should have worked on complex projects that require expertise across multiple disciples and environments

* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum/Kanban environment

* Experience of providing overall process improvements adopting to the release process
* Advanced knowledge of Software Development Lifecycle

**Other Skills And Abilities**

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 EY Consulting is a fast\-moving, high\-growth area with huge potential. We are currently recruiting for a Seniors to join our team. This team offers variety, challenge, responsibility and the opportunity to realize your leadership potential. Being a member of our Consulting team means you will specialize in a particular competency \- Risk, Technology Consulting, or IT Risk \& Assurance. Our Technology Consulting team is focused on helping clients improve operational efficiency and security, while also reducing costs and managing risk.
   

  

 In this role, we are looking for an experienced SAP TRM Manager to join our growing SAP Finance team. As an SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) Manager you will oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of SAP S/4HANA treasury solutions, focusing on cash management, transaction management, and risk analysis. They lead teams, manage stakeholder relationships, map business processes, and ensure regulatory compliance for treasury operations.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Conduct Business Blueprint design workshops to gather requirements and understand the client's business processes.
* Lead end\-to\-end SAP TRM implementations, including Blueprinting, Configuration, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Optimize cash management, liquidity planning, bank communication, and hedge accounting.
* Utilize Market Risk Analyzer and Credit Risk Analyzer to mitigate financial risks.
* Prepare functional gaps analysis by identifying areas where standard SAP S4 HANA TRM functionalities need enhancements or customization
* Handle complex enhancements in TRM requirements, ensuring the solution aligns with the client's business requirements.
* Provide guidance and support to end\-users during testing, training, and post\-go\-live phases.

* Must be able to prepare the materials for the design workshops independently (Mandatory skill)
* Must send out the Meeting Minutes of the Workshop post each workshop that he/she leads (Mandatory skill)
* Follow up on the action items from the workshops
* Advanced knowledge and experience with SAP S4 HANA TRM Module.
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills, coupled with a strong interest in further developing and integrating enterprise domain knowledge with technology skills.


**What We Look For**
* Candidate must be a qualified CA / ICWA / MBA Finance/M. Com in a reputed institution with a sound industry/domain experience and SAP relevant experience between 7 to 11years
* Must have at least 2 end\-to\-end implementation experience and strong hands\-on experience in SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM) module.
* Proficiency in S/4HANA Finance with a focus on Treasury, Cash, and Liquidity Management
* Experience in Cash Management, Bank Communication Management (BCM), and In\-House Cash (IHC)
* Good understanding of Credit Risk, financial instruments, and exposure management.
* Familiarity and Hands on experience with SAP FICO concepts, including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting.
* Knowledge of integration with FI, CO, MM, and external banking systems.
* Candidate should be capable to understand the existing Legacy as\-is application \& business set up and implement in SAP all the sub\-modules of SAP treasury.
* Should participate in BPP workshops, design \& implement solutions in SAP.
* Should provide architectural suggestions on set up and integration between existing SAP \& non\-SAP systems.
* Should be able to lead a team of functional \& technical consultants.
* Should be able to draw up proposals \& plans for the project.
* SAP Certification in Treasury and Risk Management is preferable

title: Technical Database Architect -Vice President
description:
**Job Description:**
 The Technical Database architect is a senior\-level position responsible for bridging the gap between complex business requirements and technical data solutions, leveraging advanced analytical and technical skills to develop data\-driven solutions, with a focus on regulatory reporting and liquidity risk initiatives. This role will liaise extensively with business stakeholders and technology teams to articulate data needs, extract insights, and ensure data quality and integrity.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Consult with business clients to determine system functional specifications and partner with multiple management teams and other units to meet organizational objectives.
* Define, document, and validate detailed data requirements, data flows, and data lineage for new or enhanced systems and applications.
* Provide technical input during the development and implementation phases, including formulating and defining systems scope, data objectives, and necessary data architecture enhancements for complex, high\-impact projects.
* Design and develop robust data models (conceptual, logical, physical) to support reporting, analytics, and business processes.
* Prepare and curate data for AI/ML model development, working closely with AI engineers to ensure data quality, feature engineering, and model validation.
* Utilize advanced SQL for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis from various relational databases, data warehouses, and Big Data platforms.
* Develop and maintain data visualization dashboards and reports using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or QlikView, translating complex data into understandable business insights.
* Lead the analysis of complex data sets to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies relevant to regulatory reporting, liquidity risk, and other critical financial functions.
* Identify and communicate data\-related risks and impacts and propose risk mitigation options, considering business implications of the application of technology to the current business environment.
* Evaluate new data technologies, analytical tools, and evolving business requirements, and recommend appropriate systems alternatives and/or enhancements to current systems by analyzing business processes, systems and industry standards.
* Serve as advisor or coach to new or lower\-level analysts.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


**Qualifications:**
* 11\+ years of experience as a Technical Database Analyst or similar role within the Financial Services industry, preferably in regulatory reporting (e.g., Basel, CCAR, FR 2052a) and liquidity risk.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL for complex data querying, analysis, and optimization across large datasets.
* Strong experience with relational databases (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, DB2\) and data warehousing concepts (e.g., dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas).
* Demonstrated expertise with Big Data technologies including Hadoop, Spark (PySpark/Scala Spark), Kafka, and cloud\-based data platforms (e.g., AWS S3, Databricks).
* Demonstrated experience with data modeling tools and techniques.
* Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, QlikView) and strong Excel skills for data manipulation and presentation.
* Experience with scripting languages for data analysis (e.g., Python, R) is highly desirable.
* Experience with data preparation for AI/ML models and understanding of core AI/ML concepts and workflows is highly desirable.
* Comprehensive knowledge of data analysis principles, methodologies, and data governance frameworks.
* Experience across all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), with a focus on data\-centric projects.
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication.
* Demonstrated problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage deadlines or unexpected changes in expectations or requirements.


**Education:**
* Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience.
* Master's degree preferred.

* Develop and maintain data access layers and interfaces (e.g., APIs, middleware, data services), ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance of integrated systems.
* Enable AI and automation use cases by structuring and exposing ERP data in a usable and governed manner for advanced analytics and intelligent platforms.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (e.g., Product Owners, Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Automation teams) to translate business and technical requirements into integration solutions aligned with enterprise architecture.
* Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance across integrations, adhering to internal standards, data governance frameworks, and IT security policies.
* Manage and resolve integration incidents and defects, proactively monitoring interfaces and ensuring continuity of critical data flows.
* Document integration solutions and data models, supporting maintainability, knowledge transfer, and audit readiness.
* Drive continuous improvement of integration frameworks, identifying opportunities to standardize, automate, and optimize data connectivity across systems.

* Relevant Previous experience (minimum years of experience to competently carry out the role, not total year of experience)

+ Hands\-on experience integrating ERP systems, preferably SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA

* Knowledge areas/Skills (minimum level of knowledge to fullfil the role’s responsibilities)

+ Experience with SAP integration technologies (e.g., ABAP interfaces, IDocs, RFCs, OData, BAPIs)
+ Knowledge of integration platforms/tools (e.g., SAP PI/PO, SAP BTP, MuleSoft, Azure Integration Services)
+ Familiarity with data structures, databases, and data modelling

+ Ability to collaborate across business and IT teams globally

description:

That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.
   

  

 Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing:**
 Job Summary:
   

  

 As a Database Administrator, you are a recognized technical expert responsible for the end\-to\-end performance, availability, security, and cloud modernization of critical enterprise database and data platform systems. You support and maintain database migration projects, engineer high\-availability architectures, perform deep performance diagnostics, integrate database operations into modern DevOps/DataOps and Data Engineering workflows, and contribute to Fabric/Azure data platform maturity. You bridge database administration and engineering teams raising the technical standard of the team.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Lead complex administration and optimization of mission\-critical SQL Server and Azure SQL environments; architect and configure Always On Availability Groups, geo\-replication, Azure failover groups, and HADR workflows to meet RPO/RTO objectives.
* Lead database migration projects (on\-premises SQL Server to Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure SQL Database, or IaaS), utilizing Azure Database Migration Service (DMS) and hybrid network integration patterns.
* Perform advanced performance engineering: deep wait\-stat analysis, blocking/deadlock mitigation, complex T\-SQL tuning, Query Store and Extended Events diagnostics, and index strategy redesign.
* Implement and enforce advanced security controls: Always Encrypted, Dynamic Data Masking, Row\-Level Security (RLS), Azure Key Vault integration, Purview sensitivity labeling, and STIG/SOC 2 baseline configurations.
* Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployment pipelines using Terraform or Bicep; integrate database schema migrations and deployments into Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows.
* Configure and operate Microsoft Fabric workspaces, Lakehouses, Warehouses, and integration pipelines; manage Fabric capacity scaling, workspace access models, and operational support runbooks.
* Partner with data engineering, architecture, governance, and application teams to improve data quality, lineage tracking, metadata completeness, and platform service delivery.
* Contribute to governance execution by configuring Microsoft Purview data cataloging, verifying data lineage, and enforcing data classification standards.
* Conduct root cause analysis for complex incidents; lead post\-incident reviews and present findings and remediation plans to technical stakeholders.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on production database administration and cloud data platform experience in enterprise environments.
* Mastery of SQL Server internals: locking, blocking, latching, memory pressure, tempdb contention, and execution plan deep\-dives.
* Experience with Azure SQL PaaS services, including Azure SQL Database, Managed Instance, Elastic Pools, and Hyperscale, as well as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Cosmos DB. Familiarity with hybrid cloud networking concepts such as VNets and Private Endpoints.
* Hands\-on experience with IaC tools (Terraform, Bicep) and CI/CD platforms (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
* Practical experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Warehouse, pipelines) and Azure data services (Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, or Databricks).
* Experience implementing enterprise security frameworks including RBAC, Always Encrypted, DLP, Purview sensitivity labels, and audit configurations.
* Strong ability to communicate root cause findings, technical recommendations, and platform updates to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate (DP\-300\)


 To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in\-person I\-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.
   

  

**Mandatory Requirements:**
 Employees must have a high\-speed broadband internet connection with a minimum speed of
 **50 Mbps** 
 and the ability to set up a wired connection to their home network to ensure effective remote work. These requirements may be updated as needed by the business.
   

  

**Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.** 
**If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact recruitingteam@evolent.com for further assistance.**
 The expected base salary/wage range for this position is $. As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.

**Job Description**
**Job Description Summary**
 We are seeking
 ***VP Database Operations Manager***
 to join our
 ***GTI ( Global Technology Infrastructure)***
 in Global Technology \& Operations.
   

  

**Team/Group Description**
 This position operates in a fast\-paced, innovative, and globally distributed environment with On\-Call responsibilities for critical incidents. If you are a passionate technical leader with deep SQL Server, Oracle and Azure expertise, strong automation capabilities, and a desire to drive excellence within the DBMS Operations group, this role offers an outstanding opportunity to lead enterprise database strategy and deliver transformative business value
   

  

**Role Description**
 The Enterprise Database Operations Lead is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the database administration team and ensuring the high availability, security, performance, and scalability of enterprise database platforms across the global organization. This role combines hands\-on expertise in relational database management systems (strong emphasis on Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL in Azure, Oracle and Sybase) with strategic oversight and team management to drive operational excellence, innovation, and alignment with business objectives in a fast\-paced, mission\-critical environment.
   

  

**Applications And Business Or Enterprise Functions The Role Supports**
 Working closely within the Global Technology Infrastructure group, the candidate will collaborate extensively with various support groups, such as Unix and Windows Administration, Storage Management, and global application support teams. This role underpins support for mission\-critical enterprise RDBMS systems, that include financial trading systems, accounting, brokerage, business intelligence and advanced analytics, regulatory compliance and data governance, customer\-facing applications, and disaster recovery/business continuity operations. By maintaining robust, high\-availability database infrastructures, optimizing performance at scale, and enabling seamless data integration, the role minimizes business disruptions, supports real\-time global decision\-making, powers enterprise\-wide reporting and analytics, and enables strategic initiatives such as cloud platform modernization, large\-scale data platform modernization / migrations, and adoption of advanced data services
   

  

**Key Job Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Leading, managing, and mentoring a team of Database Administrators within the DBMS Operations group, including performance evaluations, coaching, resource planning, and fostering a high\-performance, collaborative culture centered on knowledge sharing and continuous technical growth.
* Serving as the organization’s primary subject matter expert on database platforms, diagnosing and resolving complex issues, establishing and enforcing best practices, and ensuring rapid, effective incident response to maintain minimal business impact.
* The candidate will be responsible to manage scalable, resilient database solutions, including advanced high\-availability configurations, disaster recovery strategies, and integration of modern technologies—in close partnership with the broader DBMS Engineering group and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Developing and maintaining sophisticated automation frameworks using advanced scripting (PowerShell, T\-SQL) and tools (SQL Agent \& ControlM scheduler) to streamline critical operations such as backups, patching, monitoring, alerting, capacity management, and routine maintenance.
* Collaborating intensively with application development, infrastructure, and business teams to optimize database design, query and indexing strategies, performance tuning, and application\-database integration while safeguarding data integrity and compatibility.
* Driving proactive performance and tuning, capacity planning, monitoring, and bottleneck resolution using enterprise\-grade tools to deliver optimal system efficiency and reliability.
* Championing knowledge transfer, technical training, and continuous improvement initiatives within the DBMS Operations group; analyzing performance metrics and trends to identify and implement impactful enhancements.
* Providing strategic technical guidance and roadmap input to the enterprise application teams on database platform evolution, including Azure cloud adoption (IaaS/PaaS), platform upgrades/migrations, and evaluation of emerging data technologies to support long\-term organizational objectives.


**What Makes This Role Unique Or Interesting**
 This role combines strong technical leadership with operational responsibility inside the Global Technology infrastructure team, giving you real influence over our enterprise\-scale data infrastructure.
   

  

 You'll gain deep expertise in advanced data server management, large\-scale automation, and modern observability/logging systems — while guiding a talented team through complex, high\-impact challenges.
   

  

 With global scope, mission\-critical systems, and the chance to shape the future of our DBMS strategy, this position bridges hands\-on operations with strategic business impact. It's both highly rewarding and intellectually stimulating.
   

  

**Professional development value of this role**
 Working within Global Technology Infrastructure group this role accelerates growth in advanced technical domains (SQL Server high availability/business intelligence stack, Azure PaaS/IaaS database services, enterprise automation, performance and tuning, Database Virtualization \- such as Delphix) and observability, while significantly strengthening leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic planning capabilities. You will gain experience leading in a sophisticated, global operations environment, handling enterprise\-scale complexity, and driving innovation in cloud and data platform modernization. These experiences position the candidate exceptionally well for future advancement into senior roles such as Senior DBMS Architect, Cloud Data Platform Lead, or broader data/infrastructure leadership positions.
   

  

**Job Qualifications (The Ideal Candidate Should Have The Following)**
 The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
   

  

* Demonstrated success leading large\-scale, global or multi\-site database environments with strong emphasis on high availability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and mission\-critical system reliability.


**Qualifications, Experience, Education**
 The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
* 15\+ years of progressive, hands\-on experience in database administration and engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership or team lead role managing database professionals in an enterprise setting.


**Skills**
* Proficiency across RDBMS platforms (Microsoft SQL Server primary; Oracle, PostgreSQL, with some knowledge of Sybase \& IQ, Redis Cache experience beneficial)
* Expert knowledge of SQL Server technologies, including Failover Clustering, AlwaysOn Availability Groups, Log Shipping, SSIS (Integration Services), SSRS (Reporting Services), and SSAS (Analysis Services).
* Advanced programming skills in PowerShell and T\-SQL for sophisticated automation, scripting, and query optimization; familiarity with .NET development is advantageous.
* Strong experience with performance monitoring and management tools (e.g., SCOM, Foglight, or equivalent enterprise solutions). Knowledge in database virtualization techniques such as Delphix
* Deep understanding of Windows Server, Linux and Solaris operating systems.
* Proficiency with Cloud (Azure) technologies, including IaaS and PaaS database offerings, virtual machine sizing, disk and storage management, and related cloud infrastructure components.
* Knowledge of Splunk and other logging/observability technologies for centralized monitoring, alerting, and root\-cause analysis.
* Advanced SQL skills for complex data manipulation, performance tuning, indexing strategies, query plan analysis, and optimization.


**Soft Skills And Other Requirements**
* Exceptional communication skills, with proven ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences (engineers, architects, executives, and non\-technical stakeholders), produce clear documentation, and facilitate productive cross\-team collaboration.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, rapid adaptability in high\-pressure situations, and the ability to balance independent initiative with effective teamwork.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Microsoft SQL Server\-related certifications, Azure Database Administrator Associate (or equivalent), Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), or relevant Azure/AWS cloud database certifications.

* Advanced experience with BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) for data visualization, reporting, and dashboard creation.

* Efficient, optimized database design and development with high\-performance queries.
* Successful development and management of ETL processes, ensuring smooth data flow between systems.

**Job Description:** 




 We are looking for a highly skilled
 **Backup \& Storage Management Architect/SME** 
 to lead and optimize our Pure Storage, Cohesity, and Rubrik environments. The role involves ensuring robust backup strategies, efficient storage management, and strong disaster recovery readiness. The ideal candidate will bring deep hands\-on expertise, strong troubleshooting skills, and the ability to align data protection solutions with business needs.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities** 




**Cohesity \& Rubrik Management** 



* Monitor backup job status, alerts, and troubleshoot failed or incomplete backup jobs.
* Validate replication and archival jobs to cloud targets to ensure data integrity and availability.
* Perform test restores for non\-production environments to ensure backup reliability.
* Review and clear alerts related to Cohesity/Rubrik clusters, health issues, or protection groups.
* Ensure adherence to defined SLAs and retention policies across all backup configurations.



**Pure Storage Management** 



* Monitor Pure Storage array health using Pure1 or the management console.
* Validate replication and snapshot schedules to ensure successful execution.
* Track storage utilization, capacity trends, and trigger proactive capacity planning.
* Perform routine mapping/unmapping of storage volumes based on approved requests.



**Weekly / Scheduled Tasks** 



* Generate weekly reports on backup success/failure with trend analysis.
* Review storage consumption growth and prepare capacity forecasts.
* Validate snapshot retention and cleanup activities per policy.
* Conduct scheduled test restore drills and document results.
* Confirm backup coverage for newly added VMs, databases, and volumes.
* Track and document protection policy or dataset changes.



**Monthly / Periodic Tasks** 



* Update documentation for Cohesity protection groups, storage provisioning, and associated policies.
* Perform monthly license utilization and capacity reviews for Cohesity and Pure Storage.
* Deliver monthly performance reports (IOPS, throughput, latency) for storage arrays.
* Assess readiness for Cohesity/Rubrik patches or upgrades.
* Validate DR readiness by checking replication and remote cluster sync status.



**Automation \& Reporting**

* Automate storage usage reporting via Pure1 and generate forecast alerts.
* Integrate backup job failure alerts with ITSM tools for automated ticket creation.

* Oversee storage provisioning activities for business applications and critical workloads.
* Manage Cohesity cluster upgrades, expansions, and firmware updates.

title: Data Quality Engineer
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Data Quality Engineer / Quality Engineering Lead** 
 to join our Data, Analytics \& AI organization in Pune.
 



 The role will be responsible for ensuring that data, analytics, reporting, and AI\-enabled products are
 **accurate, reliable, scalable, secure, and production\-ready** 
 . You will work closely with business, product, data engineering, analytics, technology, and Data Platform teams in India and the U.S.
 



 You will own the end\-to\-end quality engineering lifecycle — from requirements and test strategy through test automation, data validation, defect management, release certification, and production validation.

 **large datasets, complex enterprise systems, SQL, data pipelines, Power BI, APIs, cloud platforms, automation frameworks, GitHub, and CI/CD environments** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities :** 




  





 1\. Quality Engineering \& Test Strategy
 


* Partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics, IT, and Business teams to define quality standards, acceptance criteria, and release\-readiness requirements.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive testing strategies and quality frameworks for Data, Analytics \& AI products.
* Translate business requirements into structured testing approaches covering functionality, reliability, performance, data quality, and usability.
* Own independent regression testing and release certification.
* Lead defect triage, root\-cause analysis, prioritization, remediation tracking, and release sign\-off.
* Establish risk\-based testing approaches and ensure appropriate quality controls are applied throughout the development lifecycle.



 2\. Data, Analytics \& BI Testing
 


* Independently test and validate
 **KPIs, business metrics, data transformations, semantic models, dashboards, reports, and analytical products** 
 .
* Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, reconciliation, and integrity across source systems, integrations, data warehouses, data lakes, and reporting environments.
* Perform advanced SQL\-based data validation using complex joins, subqueries, CTEs, window functions, and other data\-quality techniques.
* Test enterprise reporting and analytics platforms, including
 **Power BI and governed semantic models** 
 .
* Identify data\-quality issues and work with Data Engineering and Data Platform teams to perform root\-cause analysis and drive remediation.
* Validate that analytical solutions perform reliably and consistently in production environments.



 3\. Test Automation \& Quality Engineering
 


* Design, build, and maintain automated testing frameworks for Data, Analytics, and AI products.
* Develop automation using technologies such as
 **Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, PyTest, TestNG, JUnit** 
 , or equivalent frameworks.
* Integrate automated testing into
 **CI/CD pipelines** 
 to enable continuous testing and faster, more reliable releases.
* Drive automation\-first and shift\-left quality engineering practices.
* Establish testing metrics, quality KPIs, defect trends, automation coverage, and other measures of testing effectiveness.
* Continuously improve testing processes, frameworks, tools, and engineering practices.



 4\. GitHub, DevOps \& Release Management
 


* Establish and maintain GitHub repository standards for Data, Analytics, and AI solutions.
* Support repository management, branching strategies, pull requests, merge validation, release tagging, and source\-control governance.
* Integrate automated quality checks and testing into
 **GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines** 
 .
* Partner with engineering and delivery teams to ensure appropriate quality gates are incorporated into release processes.
* Support release validation, deployment readiness, and production quality controls.



 5\. AI \& Advanced Analytics Validation
 


* Independently test AI\-enabled applications, recommendation engines, predictive solutions, and Generative AI use cases from a quality, reliability, integration, and production\-readiness perspective.
* Validate data flows, application behavior, integrations, performance, and operational reliability of AI\-enabled solutions.
* Partner with analytics and data science specialists who own model accuracy, statistical validity, and business/model outcomes.
* Ensure AI\-enabled solutions meet defined functional, technical, and operational quality standards before production release.

* Act as the
 **quality owner for solutions transitioning from Innovation Lab/PoC environments into production or Factory environments** 
 .
* Define and manage Factory Acceptance Criteria covering functionality, data quality, performance, governance, supportability, monitoring, and operational readiness.
* Review test evidence, deployment plans, support documentation, monitoring processes, and quality metrics before production approval.
* Provide independent quality sign\-off for production readiness.
* Partner with Factory and production teams to ensure solutions can be supported, monitored, maintained, and scaled effectively.



 7\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 


* Work closely with U.S.\-based business, technology, product, analytics, engineering, and Data Platform stakeholders.
* Communicate testing outcomes, quality risks, defects, dependencies, and release\-readiness clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Build strong working relationships across geographically distributed teams.
* Support data\-driven and risk\-based decision\-making through transparent quality reporting and objective testing outcomes.



  





**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

 , with at least
 **6 years in Quality Engineering, QA, Data Testing, Test Automation, or related roles** 
 .
* Strong experience as a Senior Individual Contributor, Lead, or Quality Engineering Lead owning testing strategy and release quality.
* Experience testing
 **enterprise data, analytics, BI, reporting, data engineering, ML, or AI solutions** 
 .
* Advanced SQL skills, including:

 **Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, PyTest, TestNG, or JUnit** 
 .
* Experience with
 **Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jira, CI/CD pipelines, and release management** 
 .
* Hands\-on experience with
 **GitHub Enterprise** 
 , including repositories, branching, pull requests, merge validation, release tagging, and source\-control governance.

title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer
description:
**Location: Pune**
* Are you curious, excited by experimentation and always looking to innovate?
* Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands\-on experience?
* Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?


 If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Modulr is the payments automation platform that streamlines money movement with accuracy, control and reliability — built to scale. We process more than 200m transactions and over £180bn in payment value on an annualised basis, and we’re trusted by over 6,000 businesses from fast\-growing SMEs to global enterprises.
   

  

 We automate how money moves into and out of a business — payroll, supplier payments, spend management and payment collection — through a single platform, connected to the accounting and payroll systems finance teams already use and underpinned by principal memberships of Visa and Mastercard and direct access to central bank infrastructure.
   

  

 As a regulated payments provider with over a decade of experience, we’re the platform finance teams trust to run mission\-critical operations. Modulr is backed by PayPal, FIS, General Atlantic, Blenheim Chalcot, Frog Capital and Highland Europe, with over 400 employees across London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Mumbai and Pune.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Modulr is a B2B embedded\-payments platform operating at scale in a regulated environment. As we evolve our core data architecture, we’re hiring our first dedicated Database Reliability Engineer to raise the operational resilience of our payments platform.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role for someone who thinks like a Site Reliability Engineer but has deep database expertise — someone who wants to make a large, busy production estate observable, diagnosable, and safe to operate, and to be the database voice that shapes how we scale. It carries a clear path toward a data\-architecture mandate as the platform matures.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the reliability, performance, and observability of our production databases (primarily PostgreSQL / Amazon Aurora), so that issues are seen and understood in minutes, not hours.
* Lead deep\-dive diagnosis of production incidents — query performance, lock and wait\-event analysis, connection\-pool behaviour, blocking sessions — and turn findings into lasting fixes and runbooks.
* Build proactive guardrails: query and statement timeouts, connection\-pool standards, slow\-query and contention alerting, capacity and saturation monitoring.
* Partner with engineering squads to design schemas, indexes, and access patterns that scale, and to enforce safe database practices in their services.
* Contribute the database\-reliability perspective to significant platform\-evolution work, including separation of read and write paths and the decomposition of shared database components.
* Improve our database observability tooling and dashboards so reliability is measurable and trends are visible before they become incidents.
* Help embed a culture of operational excellence, blameless post\-incident review, and continuous improvement.


**Person Specification**
**Essential**
* Substantial hands\-on experience operating production PostgreSQL (Aurora / RDS a strong plus) at meaningful scale.
* Genuine SRE mindset: comfortable with observability tooling, metrics and tracing, alerting, automation, and infrastructure\-as\-code — not just database administration.
* Demonstrable strength in performance diagnosis: reading query plans, identifying lock contention and blocking, resolving connection\-pool exhaustion, and tuning for throughput and latency.
* Experience supporting high\-availability, low\-tolerance systems where correctness and uptime both matter.
* Clear, calm communicator who can lead a live incident and explain root cause to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Scripting/automation ability (e.g. Python, Bash) and working familiarity with AWS and Kubernetes\-based environments.


**Desired**
* Exposure to payments, fintech, or other regulated, high\-availability domains.
* Experience with data\-observability or lineage tooling and with connection\-management layers such as PgBouncer / RDS Proxy.
* Familiarity with decomposing monolithic databases and introducing read/write separation.


**ModInclusion**
 Modulr is a leading fintech platform providing Payments Automation and enterprise payment solutions. We serve high\-growth businesses across multiple verticals including Lending, Travel, Banking, and Core Business Payments, operating across India, the UK, Europe, and beyond. Our mission is to simplify and automate payments for our customers, and we're building a diverse, talented team to support that mission. Our people are central to our success, and we're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

 We are looking for Associate Manager \- Data Engineering. title: Implementation Engineer II

Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Implementation Engineer II partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go\-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
   

  

 Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer II understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands\-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer\-first approach.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long\-term maintainability before go\-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source\-to\-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit\-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data
* Confirm and pressure\-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go\-live
